# file opened: zpolice.asm
   1  0000              ;==============================================================================
   2  0000              ; Z-POLICE  -  3D vector city flight for the ZX Spectrum Next
   3  0000              ;
   4  0000              ;  Z80N assembler (sjasmplus --zxnext).  Layer 2 256x192x8bpp, double buffered.
   5  0000              ;  The 3D viewport is the top 256x128; the bottom third is an instrument panel.
   6  0000              ;  Maths: world positions are 16-bit integers (one city cell = 256 units),
   7  0000              ;         trig values are S7.8 fixed point (1.0 = $0100).
   8  0000              ;  Hidden line removal: painter's algorithm. Buildings are walked over the
   9  0000              ;  grid far-to-near (no sort needed). Each visible face is filled in its
  10  0000              ;  shade (roof lighter, side turned away darker) and optionally outlined, so
  11  0000              ;  nearer buildings overwrite those behind them. Faces with every corner on
  12  0000              ;  screen use cached projections; faces crossing the view frustum are
  13  0000              ;  clipped in 3D (Sutherland-Hodgman, 5 planes). Rasterisation then only
  14  0000              ;  ever sees on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
  15  0000              ;
  16  0000              ;  Controls: Q/A speed up/down   Z air brake O/P turn left/right
  17  0000              ;            W/S climb/descend   E/D nose up/down
  18  0000              ;            SPACE fire          1-5 select weapon slot
  19  0000              ;            0 change the centre slot's weapon
  20  0000              ;
  21  0000              ;  Source files: zpolice.asm (resident main code), memory_bank_defs.asm
  22  0000              ;  (slots and pages).  Game logic pages, swapped into slot 6 at $C000:
  23  0000              ;  player.asm (input/movement), weapons.asm, menu.asm (main menu).  Core
  24  0000              ;  function pages, swapped into slot 7 at $E000: city.asm (Layer 2
  25  0000              ;  drawing), hud.asm (ULA HUD), input.asm (redefinable keys, joysticks), sprites.asm
  26  0000              ;  (hardware sprites).  Always mapped: zombie.asm at $2000, human.asm and
  27  0000              ;  map.asm (the city map) at $7000.
  28  0000              ;
  29  0000              ;  Memory while running:
  30  0000              ;    $0000-$1FFF  Layer 2 back buffer, one 8K section at a time (slot 0)
  31  0000              ;    $2000-$3FFF  zombie page (slot 1)
  32  0000              ;    $4000-$7FFF  occlusion data; cell colours, humans, map (slots 2-3)
  33  0000              ;    $8000-$9FFF  ULA screen (slot 4)
  34  0000              ;    $A000-$BFFF  resident code, tables, variables, stack (slot 5)
  35  0000              ;    $C000-$DFFF  game logic page (slot 6)
  36  0000              ;    $E000-$FFFF  core function page (slot 7)
  37  0000              ;==============================================================================
  38  0000
  39  0000                      DEVICE ZXSPECTRUMNEXT
  40  0000                      SLDOPT COMMENT WPMEM, LOGPOINT, ASSERTION
  41  0000                      CSPECTMAP zpolice.map
  42  0000                      OPT --zxnext=cspect --syntax=a --reversepop
  43  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  44  0000              ; Build options
  45  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  46  0000              ; DRAW_LINES: outline building faces with EDGE_COL vectors.  Comment it out for solid-colour buildings only; the HUD
  47  0000              ; is always drawn.  Can also be set from the command line: -DDRAW_LINES
  48  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_LINES
  49  0000
  50  0000              ; WAIT_FOR_VBLANK: wait for the raster to leave the display area before
  51  0000              ; flipping the Layer 2 buffers (no tearing).  Comment it out to flip as soon
  52  0000              ; as a frame is drawn: faster, but the flip may tear mid-screen.
  53  0000              ; Command line: -DWAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  54  0000                      ;DEFINE WAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  55  0000
  56  0000              ; DRAW_FPS: measure frames per second from the raster (vtick) and show it at
  57  0000              ; the top left of the ULA screen.  Comment it out to drop the measuring and
  58  0000              ; the display.  Command line: -DDRAW_FPS
  59  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_FPS
  60  0000
  61  0000              ; SKY_IS_WALL: the camera can never rise above the perimeter wall, so fill
  62  0000              ; the sky in the wall's colour and draw wall cells only up to camera height
  63  0000              ; (their top edge is then exactly the horizon).  No sky is ever seen.
  64  0000              ; Command line: -DSKY_IS_WALL
  65  0000                      DEFINE SKY_IS_WALL
  66  0000
  67  0000              ; OCCLUSION_CULL: in level flight, record the buildings, then cull those
  68  0000              ; completely hidden behind nearer ones (a per-column cover buffer, front to
  69  0000              ; back) before drawing the rest.  Uses pages PAGE_OCC0/1 at $4000-$7FFF.
  70  0000              ; Command line: -DOCCLUSION_CULL
  71  0000                      DEFINE OCCLUSION_CULL
  72  0000
  73  0000              ; LEVEL_FAST_PATH: while pitch is 0 (level flight) a building's top corners
  74  0000              ; have the same camera X and Z as the bottom corners below them, so each top
  75  0000              ; corner reuses its bottom corner's screen x and 1/Z and only works out its
  76  0000              ; screen y.  Comment it out to project every corner in full.
  77  0000              ; Command line: -DLEVEL_FAST_PATH
  78  0000                      DEFINE LEVEL_FAST_PATH
  79  0000
  80  0000              ; CLIP_2D: a face that crosses only the screen's sides, top or bottom, and is
  81  0000              ; within a guard band (|X| <= 2Z, |Y| <= Z), has its corners projected to
  82  0000              ; 16-bit screen coordinates and is clipped against the screen in 2D, not in
  83  0000              ; 3D (no new points to project, one multiply per new point, not three).
  84  0000              ; Faces crossing the near plane, or outside the guard band, are clipped in
  85  0000              ; 3D as before.  Comment it out to clip every face in 3D.
  86  0000              ; Command line: -DCLIP_2D
  87  0000                      DEFINE CLIP_2D
  88  0000
  89  0000                      INCLUDE "memory_bank_defs.asm"  ; MMU slots, registers, addresses, pages

   1+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 0000              ; Z-POLICE - memory bank definitions
   3+ 0000              ;
   4+ 0000              ; The Next maps its RAM into the Z80's 64K as eight 8K MMU slots, each set by
   5+ 0000              ; a NextReg ($50-$57) to an 8K page (page n = half of 16K bank n/2).  This
   6+ 0000              ; file names the slots, their registers and addresses, what each slot is
   7+ 0000              ; used for, and which page holds what.  Use:
   8+ 0000              ;   nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_CITY            ; page the city code in at $E000
   9+ 0000              ;   MMU CODE_SLOT e, PAGE_CITY, CODE_ADDR ; (sjasmplus) assemble into it
  10+ 0000              ;
  11+ 0000              ; Memory map (see README.md):
  12+ 0000              ;   slot 0 $0000  Layer 2 sections (32 rows each) while drawing; the sine
  13+ 0000              ;                 table (PAGE_SIN) whenever get_sin reads it
  14+ 0000              ;   slot 1 $2000  zombie page, always mapped: zombies, humans, the HUD
  15+ 0000              ;                 map, the IM 2 table
  16+ 0000              ;   slot 2 $4000  occlusion data
  17+ 0000              ;   slot 3 $6000  the city bank (always mapped): city_col at $6000,
  18+ 0000              ;                 city_map at $7000, loaded from the level's city file
  19+ 0000              ;   slot 4 $8000  ULA screen (page 10, the first half of bank 5)
  20+ 0000              ;   slot 5 $A000  resident main code, variables, stack (page 11, the unused
  21+ 0000              ;                 second half of bank 5)
  22+ 0000              ;   slot 6 $C000  game logic pages, swapped: player, weapons, menu, level
  23+ 0000              ;                 loading
  24+ 0000              ;   slot 7 $E000  core function pages, swapped: city (Layer 2 drawing), HUD,
  25+ 0000              ;                 keys, sprites; a sprite bank while it is loaded; the
  26+ 0000              ;                 start-up set-up (initialise.asm) once
  27+ 0000              ; So game logic in slot 6 can call any core page in slot 7: main_loop pages
  28+ 0000              ; the keys in at $E000 while the player and weapons pages run at $C000.
  29+ 0000              ; At start-up the NEX loader's default mapping is in place (slot 6 = page
  30+ 0000              ; 0), so the entry point is a stub in PAGE_BOOT at $C000 (boot, zpolice.asm)
  31+ 0000              ; that maps the resident page into slot 5 and jumps to start.
  32+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
  33+ 0000
  34+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  35+ 0000              ; MMU slots: number, NextReg, address
  36+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  37+ 0000              MEMBANK_SIZE            equ $2000       ; 8K a slot / page
  38+ 0000
  39+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0              equ 0
  40+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1              equ 1
  41+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2              equ 2
  42+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3              equ 3
  43+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4              equ 4
  44+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5              equ 5
  45+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6              equ 6
  46+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7              equ 7
  47+ 0000
  48+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER     equ $50
  49+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER     equ $51
  50+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER     equ $52
  51+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER     equ $53
  52+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER     equ $54
  53+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER     equ $55
  54+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER     equ $56
  55+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER     equ $57
  56+ 0000
  57+ 0000              membank0                equ $0000
  58+ 0000              membank1                equ $2000
  59+ 0000              membank2                equ $4000
  60+ 0000              membank3                equ $6000
  61+ 0000              membank4                equ $8000
  62+ 0000              membank5                equ $A000
  63+ 0000              membank6                equ $C000
  64+ 0000              membank7                equ $E000
  65+ 0000
  66+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  67+ 0000              ; What each slot is used for: <use>_SLOT, <use>_MMU (its NextReg) and
  68+ 0000              ; <use>_ADDR (the ORG of code or data assembled for it)
  69+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  70+ 0000              ; slot 0: one 32-row section of a Layer 2 buffer at a time (seg_map etc.)
  71+ 0000              L2SEC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_0
  72+ 0000              L2SEC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  73+ 0000              L2SEC_ADDR              equ membank0
  74+ 0000              ; slot 0 also: the sine table, paged in by get_sin (resident).  Only the
  75+ 0000              ; game logic calls it, never the drawing, and every Layer 2 writer maps its
  76+ 0000              ; own section first, so the two never meet.  Nothing may write to
  77+ 0000              ; $0000-$1FFF while it is mapped.
  78+ 0000              SIN_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_0
  79+ 0000              SIN_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  80+ 0000              SIN_ADDR                equ membank0
  81+ 0000
  82+ 0000              ; slot 1: zombie.asm, human.asm, map.asm, interrupts.asm, always mapped
  83+ 0000              ZOMBIE_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_1
  84+ 0000              ZOMBIE_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER
  85+ 0000              ZOMBIE_ADDR             equ membank1
  86+ 0000
  87+ 0000              ; slot 2: occlusion buffer, draw list and building records (OCCLUSION_CULL)
  88+ 0000              OCC_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_2
  89+ 0000              OCC_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER
  90+ 0000              OCC_ADDR                equ membank2
  91+ 0000
  92+ 0000              ; slot 3: the city bank, always mapped: city_col at $6000, city_map at
  93+ 0000              ; $7000, read from the level's city file (level_load.asm) in one go
  94+ 0000              TABLES_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_3
  95+ 0000              TABLES_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER
  96+ 0000              TABLES_ADDR             equ membank3            ; city_col
  97+ 0000              CITYMAP_ADDR            equ membank3+$1000      ; city_map
  98+ 0000
  99+ 0000              ; slot 4: the ULA screen (bank 5's first 8K: bitmap and attributes)
 100+ 0000              ULA_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_4
 101+ 0000              ULA_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 102+ 0000              ULA_ADDR                equ membank4
 103+ 0000
 104+ 0000              ; slot 5: resident main code (zpolice.asm), tables, variables, stack
 105+ 0000              MAIN_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_5
 106+ 0000              MAIN_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER
 107+ 0000              MAIN_ADDR               equ membank5
 108+ 0000
 109+ 0000              ; slot 6: game logic pages, swapped (player, weapons, menu)
 110+ 0000              LOGIC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_6
 111+ 0000              LOGIC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER
 112+ 0000              LOGIC_ADDR              equ membank6
 113+ 0000              ; slot 6 at start-up: the boot stub (the NEX loader maps page 0 there)
 114+ 0000              BOOT_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_6
 115+ 0000              BOOT_ADDR               equ membank6
 116+ 0000
 117+ 0000              ; slot 7: core function pages, swapped (city / Layer 2, HUD, keys, sprites)
 118+ 0000              CODE_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_7
 119+ 0000              CODE_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 120+ 0000              CODE_ADDR               equ membank7
 121+ 0000              ; slot 7 also: a sprite pattern bank (sprite_data.asm), paged in to run
 122+ 0000              ; its own loader, spr_load_bank
 123+ 0000              SPRBANK_SLOT            equ MMU_SLOT_7
 124+ 0000              SPRBANK_MMU             equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 125+ 0000              SPRBANK_ADDR            equ membank7
 126+ 0000
 127+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 128+ 0000              ; 8K pages
 129+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 130+ 0000              PAGE_BOOT               equ 0           ; the NEX entry stub (slot 6 at load)
 131+ 0000              PAGE_CITY               equ 1           ; city.asm: Layer 2 drawing (slot 7)
 132+ 0000              PAGE_HUD                equ 2           ; hud.asm: ULA (Layer 1) HUD (slot 7)
 133+ 0000              PAGE_PLAYER             equ 3           ; player.asm: input, movement,
 134+ 0000                                                      ; collision (slot 6)
 135+ 0000              PAGE_WEAPONS            equ 4           ; weapons.asm: player weapons (slot 6)
 136+ 0000              PAGE_ZOMBIE             equ 5           ; zombie.asm (slot 1, always)
 137+ 0000              PAGE_OCC0               equ 6           ; occlusion buffer, draw list and
 138+ 0000                                                      ; building records (slot 2)
 139+ 0000              PAGE_OCC1               equ 7           ; the city bank: city_col and
 140+ 0000                                                      ; city_map (slot 3, always)
 141+ 0000              PAGE_MENU               equ 8           ; menu.asm: main menu (slot 6)
 142+ 0000              PAGE_SPR0               equ 9           ; sprite_data.asm: sprite pattern
 143+ 0000                                                      ; bank 0 (slot 7 while loading);
 144+ 0000                                                      ; more banks: the next free pages
 145+ 0000              PAGE_ULA0               equ 10          ; the ULA screen, bank 5 (slot 4)
 146+ 0000              PAGE_MAIN               equ 11          ; zpolice.asm, resident (slot 5): the
 147+ 0000                                                      ; second half of bank 5
 148+ 0000              PAGE_INPUT              equ 12          ; input.asm: keyboard, joysticks (slot 7)
 149+ 0000              PAGE_SPRITES            equ 13          ; sprites.asm: hardware sprites
 150+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 7)
 151+ 0000              PAGE_SIN                equ 14          ; sin_tables.asm: the sine table
 152+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 0, read by get_sin)
 153+ 0000              PAGE_INIT               equ 15          ; initialise.asm: start-up set-up,
 154+ 0000                                                      ; initgame (slot 7, once)
 155+ 0000              PAGE_FILE               equ 16          ; file_handler.asm: SD card loading
 156+ 0000                                                      ; and saving (slot 7)
 157+ 0000              PAGE_AUDIO              equ 17          ; audio.asm: sound set-up (slot 7)
 158+ 0000              PAGE_SPECIAL            equ 31          ; specials.asm: special monsters
 159+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 6)
 160+ 0000              PAGE_LOADOUT            equ 32          ; loadout.asm: the load-out screen
 161+ 0000                                                      ; between levels (slot 6)
 162+ 0000              PAGE_KEYDEF             equ 33          ; keydef.asm: the redefine keys
 163+ 0000                                                      ; screen (slot 6)
 164+ 0000              PAGE_LEVEL              equ 30          ; level_load.asm: level and city
 165+ 0000                                                      ; files (slot 6); pages 18-29 are
 166+ 0000                                                      ; the Layer 2 buffers
 167+ 0000
 168+ 0000              ; Layer 2 double buffer, in 16K banks (NextReg $12 / $13 take banks; the
 169+ 0000              ; pages are bank * 2).  Layer 2 is clipped to 192 rows, so each buffer
 170+ 0000              ; uses three banks.
 171+ 0000              L2_BANK_A               equ 9           ; 16K banks 9-11 (pages 18-23)
 172+ 0000              L2_BANK_B               equ 12          ; 16K banks 12-14 (pages 24-29)
 173+ 0000              PAGE_L2_A               equ L2_BANK_A*2
 174+ 0000              PAGE_L2_B               equ L2_BANK_B*2
 175+ 0000
 176+ 0000              PAGE_ROM                equ $FF         ; MMU value: ROM in slots 0-1

  90  0000
  91  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  92  0000              ; Tuning constants
  93  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  94  0000              ; Scale: one map tile (cell) is 20 m x 20 m = 256 world units, and one
  95  0000              ; height unit (building heights, the ceiling, the pad) is 10 m = 128 world
  96  0000              ; units.  World units are the same size on every axis, so 1 m = 12.8 units
  97  0000              ; and 1 unit = 7.8 cm.  The city is 64 x 64 tiles = 1280 m.
  98  0000              ; Speeds are per rendered frame, so real speed depends on the frame rate
  99  0000              ; (figures below are at 14 fps).
 100  0000              GRID            equ 64          ; the city is GRID x GRID tiles (gentables.py)
 101  0000              ; A city_map byte: bits 0-4 the cell code (0 road, 1-15 building height
 102  0000              ; level, PAD_CODE, TERRACE_CODE, VOID_CODE: out of bounds), bit 6 set while a human waits in the cell
 103  0000              ; (human.asm, hum_flags), bit 7 while a zombie or special monster stands in
 104  0000              ; it (zombie.asm, zflags; its type is in its record).  Bit 5 is free.  So
 105  0000              ; every reader masks with CELL_CODE before testing for road or a code.
 106  0000              CELL_CODE       equ %00011111
 107  0000              CELL_FLAGS      equ %11100000       ; (the marks, kept when the code changes)
 108  0000              CELL_HUMAN_B    equ 6
 109  0000              CELL_ZOMBIE_B   equ 7
 110  0000              CELL_HUMAN      equ 1<<CELL_HUMAN_B
 111  0000              CELL_ZOMBIE     equ 1<<CELL_ZOMBIE_B
 112  0000              TILE_M          equ 20          ; metres per tile (reference scale)
 113  0000              TILE_UNITS      equ 256         ; world units per tile
 114  0000              HEIGHT_M        equ 10          ; metres per height unit
 115  0000              HEIGHT_UNITS    equ 128         ; world units per height unit
 116  0000              NEAR            equ 16          ; near clip plane: 1.25 m
 117  0000              VIEW_R          equ 6           ; most draw distance: buildings within +/- 6
 118  0000                                              ; tiles (120 m).  Each level sets its own,
 119  0000                                              ; 2..VIEW_R (view_r; night, fog), and the
 120  0000                                              ; street dots' radius one less (dot_r)
 121  0000              PMAX            equ 24          ; pitch limit (256 = 360 deg) - match gentables.py
 122  0000              SPEED_MAX       equ 28          ; units/frame: 2.2 m/frame, ~31 m/s (110 km/h)
 123  0000              SPEED_MIN       equ -6          ; reverse: 0.47 m/frame, ~6.6 m/s
 124  0000              YAW_RATE        equ $0180       ; turn per frame, 8.8 fixed (1.5 units;
 125  0000                                              ; 256 units = 360 degrees)
 126  0000              YAW_FINE        equ 256*256/360 ; the first frame of a turn: 1 degree
 127  0000                                              ; (182: 0.711 units, 8.8 fixed)
 128  0000              CLIMB_RATE      equ 4           ; units/frame: 0.31 m/frame, ~4.4 m/s
 129  0000              SPEED_STEP      equ 1           ; Q / A: speed change a frame, units/frame
 130  0000                                              ; (1.1 m/s; player.asm uses inc / dec)
 131  0000                      ASSERT SPEED_STEP == 1
 132  0000              ; Air brake (Z): the speed falls by twice the Q / A step every frame, to 0
 133  0000              AIRBRAKE_STEP   equ 2*SPEED_STEP    ; 2 units/frame (2.2 m/s)
 134  0000              ; Booster module (a salvage reward, fitted at once: boost_fitted).  The
 135  0000              ; boost control (K_BOOST, X) puts the speed straight to BOOST_SPEED, twice
 136  0000              ; SPEED_MAX, if going forwards at BOOST_MIN or more with fuel left; again,
 137  0000              ; or out of fuel, puts back the speed it had (boost_spd).  Q, A and Z don't
 138  0000              ; change the speed while boosting.  Each boosted frame burns 1 fuel
 139  0000              ; (boost_fuel, at most BOOST_FUEL_MAX); landed on the pad it refuels 1 a
 140  0000              ; frame (pad_service).  HUD: the B gauge, and the speed bar amber.
 141  0000              BOOST_SPEED     equ 2*SPEED_MAX     ; 56 units/frame
 142  0000              BOOST_MIN       equ SPEED_MAX/2     ; 14: at least half speed, forwards
 143  0000              BOOST_FUEL_MAX  equ 200
 144  0000                      ASSERT BOOST_SPEED < 128 && BOOST_FUEL_MAX < 256
 145  0000              ; Pitch damper: with neither E nor D held, the nose eases back to level.
 146  0000              ; Every PDAMP_FRAMES frames the 8.8 pitch moves towards 0 by
 147  0000              ; max(PDAMP_MIN, |pitch| * PDAMP_K) in 1/256ths of a pitch unit.  With
 148  0000              ; PDAMP_K 0 that is a steady PDAMP_MIN a frame: half a pitch unit, half the
 149  0000              ; rate of the nose keys (1 unit a frame), however far it is from level.  (A
 150  0000              ; PDAMP_K above 0 adds a share of what is left, faster when far off: 43, as
 151  0000              ; it was, returned up to 4 units a frame from full pitch.)
 152  0000              PDAMP_FRAMES    equ 1           ; frames between damping steps
 153  0000              PDAMP_K         equ 0           ; no share: a steady rate
 154  0000              PDAMP_MIN       equ 128         ; 128/256: half a pitch unit a frame
 155  0000              MIN_Y           equ 8           ; lowest flight: 0.6 m
 156  0000              MAX_Y           equ 3*HEIGHT_UNITS/2  ; ceiling 1.5 height units: 15 m
 157  0000              BLD_MAX_H       equ 7*HEIGHT_UNITS  ; tallest building 7.0 height units: 70 m
 158  0000                                              ; (htab level 15, gentables.py; 4.7 m a level)
 159  0000              WORLD_MIN       equ 64
 160  0000              WORLD_MAX       equ GRID*256-64
 161  0000              DMA_SPAN_MIN    equ 20          ; spans this wide or wider are filled by DMA
 162  0000              ; The VTOL (the player's craft): 10 m long by 3 m wide.  Its position
 163  0000              ; (cam_x, cam_z, the camera) is its centre; the hit box against buildings is
 164  0000              ; that rectangle turned to the heading (vtol_ground), and the camera stays
 165  0000              ; COLL_H above any roof under it.
 166  0000              VTOL_LEN_M      equ 10
 167  0000              VTOL_WID_M      equ 3
 168  0000              VTOL_HL         equ VTOL_LEN_M*TILE_UNITS/(TILE_M*2)  ; half length: 64 units
 169  0000              VTOL_HW         equ VTOL_WID_M*TILE_UNITS/(TILE_M*2)  ; half width: 19 units
 170  0000              COLL_H          equ 12          ; clearance above a roof: 0.94 m
 171  0000
 172  0000              ; Weapons: 5 slots, 2 bytes each (type, ammo) in wpn_slots.  Slot 0 is the
 173  0000              ; centre gun; slots 1-4 are the wing pylon hard points (limited ammo).
 174  0000              WPN_SLOTS       equ 5
 175  0000              WPN_CENTRE      equ 0           ; slot index of the centre gun
 176  0000              WPN_PYLON1      equ 1           ; first of the 4 wing pylons (slots 1-4)
 177  0000              WPN_TYPE        equ 0           ; offset of the type byte in a slot
 178  0000              WPN_AMMO        equ 1           ; offset of the ammo counter in a slot
 179  0000              AMMO_INF        equ 255         ; ammo counter 255 = infinite ammo (never
 180  0000                                              ; decremented); 0 = empty
 181  0000              ; weapon types (placeholders until the weapons exist)
 182  0000              WPN_NONE        equ 0           ; empty slot / nothing fitted
 183  0000              WPN_GUN         equ 1           ; machine gun (centre slot)
 184  0000              WPN_LASER       equ 2           ; pulse laser (centre slot)
 185  0000              WPN_CHAIN       equ 3           ; chain gun (centre slot)
 186  0000              WPN_ROCKETS     equ 4           ; unguided rocket pod (wing pylons)
 187  0000              WPN_MISSILE     equ 5           ; missile pod (wing pylons)
 188  0000              WPN_BOMB        equ 6           ; bomb (placeholder)
 189  0000              WPN_BOFORS      equ 7           ; Bofors cannon (wing pylons)
 190  0000              WPN_PROX        equ 8           ; proximity cannon (wing pylons)
 191  0000              WPN_LAST        equ WPN_PROX    ; (the highest type: the tables by type)
 192  0000              ; Weapon type details: wpn_cfg, WCFG_SIZE bytes per type (wpn_cfg_ptr)
 193  0000              WCFG_LOAD       equ 0           ; full load (AMMO_INF: infinite)
 194  0000              WCFG_RELOAD     equ 1           ; frames to reload a shot on the pad (0: none)
 195  0000              WCFG_SLOTS      equ 2           ; the slots it may be fitted in: bit n =
 196  0000                                              ; slot n (0 = the centre slot, key 1)
 197  0000              WCFG_SIZE       equ 3
 198  0000              WS_CENTRE       equ %00001      ; slot masks: the centre slot (key 1),
 199  0000              WS_PYLONS       equ %11110      ;   the wing pylons (keys 2-5),
 200  0000              WS_ANY          equ %11111      ;   any slot
 201  0000
 202  0000              ; Machine gun rounds: NBULLETS records of BREC bytes in `bullets`
 203  0000              NBULLETS        equ 24          ; rounds in flight (the chain gun needs most)
 204  0000              BREC            equ 27
 205  0000              B_STATE         equ 0           ; 0 free, 1 in flight, 2 hit (shown, then freed),

 558  0000              ; = page 5), so the entry point is this stub in PAGE_BOOT at $C000.  It maps
 559  0000              ; the resident page into slot 5 and jumps to start.

 578  A057                      INCLUDE "levels.asm"            ; the current level's record
# file opened: levels.asm
   1+ A057              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A057              ; Z-POLICE - the current level's settings (resident, so any page can read
   3+ A057              ; them)
   4+ A057              ;
   5+ A057              ; level_cur holds the record of the level being played, loaded from its file
   6+ A057              ; ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPL by load_level (level_load.asm).  LV_SIZE bytes:
   7+ A057              ;   +0  LV_NUM          level number
   8+ A057              ;   +1  LV_NAME         city name, 8 characters (ASCII, space padded)
   9+ A057              ;   +9  LV_ZOMBIES      number of zombies a wave (at most NZOMB)
  10+ A057              ;   +10 LV_WAVES        number of zombie waves (1..LV_MAX_WAVES)
  11+ A057              ;   +11 LV_FAST         number of fast zombies (of LV_ZOMBIES)
  12+ A057              ;   +12 LV_VIEW_R       draw distance in tiles, 2..VIEW_R (fewer: night or
  13+ A057              ;                       fog); load_level sets view_r / dot_r from it
  14+ A057              ;   +13 LV_WAVE_DATA    the special monsters of each wave, waves 1 to
  15+ A057              ;                       LV_MAX_WAVES (wave 1 is the level's start), LV_WAVE_REC
  16+ A057              ;                       bytes each:
  17+ A057              ;         +0  LV_SPECIAL_ID   LV_SPEC_SLOTS special types (SPEC_*;
  18+ A057              ;                             SPEC_NONE, 255: none in that place)
  19+ A057              ;         +5  LV_SPECIAL      how many of each (in the same places)
  20+ A057              ; The levels and their cities are made by gentables.py (ZPDATA/); a level
  21+ A057              ; file can be replaced by a hand-made one (or its text form, .TXL, edited).
  22+ A057              ;==============================================================================
  23+ A057
  24+ A057              LV_NUM          equ 0
  25+ A057              LV_NAME         equ 1
  26+ A057              LV_NAME_LEN     equ 8
  27+ A057              LV_ZOMBIES      equ LV_NAME+LV_NAME_LEN
  28+ A057              LV_WAVES        equ LV_ZOMBIES+1
  29+ A057              LV_FAST         equ LV_WAVES+1
  30+ A057              LV_VIEW_R       equ LV_FAST+1
  31+ A057              LV_WAVE_DATA    equ LV_VIEW_R+1
  32+ A057              LV_MAX_WAVES    equ 10              ; waves a level can have specials for
  33+ A057              LV_SPEC_SLOTS   equ 5               ; special types a wave
  34+ A057              LV_SPECIAL_ID   equ 0               ; (in a wave's data) the types,
  35+ A057              LV_SPECIAL      equ LV_SPEC_SLOTS   ;   then how many of each
  36+ A057              LV_WAVE_REC     equ 2*LV_SPEC_SLOTS
  37+ A057              LV_SIZE         equ LV_WAVE_DATA+LV_MAX_WAVES*LV_WAVE_REC   ; 113 bytes
  38+ A057                      ASSERT LV_SIZE == 113           ; (gentables.py writes it)
  39+ A057              ; Special monster types in the level files (specials.asm: spec_types)
  40+ A057              SPEC_GHOST      equ 0
  41+ A057              SPEC_BANSHEE    equ 1
  42+ A057              SPEC_GHOUL      equ 2
  43+ A057              SPEC_IDS        equ 3               ; (how many types)
  44+ A057              SPEC_NONE       equ 255
  45+ A057
  46+ A057              ; -> HL = the current level's record
  47+ A057              level_entry:
  48+ A057 21 5B A0             ld hl,level_cur
  49+ A05A C9                   ret
  50+ A05B
  51+ A05B 00 00 00...  level_cur:  ds LV_SIZE                  ; the level being played (load_level)
  52+ A0CC
# file closed: levels.asm
 579  A0CC                      INCLUDE "text.asm"              ; text screens: menu, load-out
# file opened: text.asm
   1+ A0CC              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A0CC              ; Z-POLICE - text screens (resident): the ULA routines the menu screens
   3+ A0CC              ; (menu.asm) and the load-out screen (loadout.asm) share, from whichever
   4+ A0CC              ; page is in slot 6.  Layer 2 hidden, the ULA screen with opaque paper,
   5+ A0CC              ; 8x8 characters (font8, ASCII 32-95) by row and column with an attribute.
   6+ A0CC              ;==============================================================================
   7+ A0CC
   8+ A0CC              MENU_ATTR       equ P_PANEL<<3 | 7          ; white on the panel colour
   9+ A0CC              MENU_TITLE      equ P_PANEL<<3 | C_YEL      ; yellow
  10+ A0CC              MENU_OK         equ P_PANEL<<3 | C_OK       ; green
  11+ A0CC              MENU_BAD        equ P_PANEL<<3 | C_WARN     ; red
  12+ A0CC
  13+ A0CC              ; Hide Layer 2, silence the AY chips, and blank the ULA screen with opaque
  14+ A0CC              ; paper
  15+ A0CC              menu_clear:
  16+ A0CC ED 91 57 0D          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES   ; no HUD sprites over the menu
  17+ A0D0 CD E5 E0             call spr_hide_all
  18+ A0D3 CD 2E E0             call spr_update
  19+ A0D6 ED 91 57 11          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_AUDIO     ; and silence: the engines off
  20+ A0DA CD 00 E0             call init_audio                 ; (audio.asm)
  21+ A0DD ED 91 57 0C          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INPUT     ; (the menu reads the keys)
  22+ A0E1 01 3B 12             ld bc,$123B
  23+ A0E4 AF                   xor a
  24+ A0E5 ED 79                out (c),a
  25+ A0E7 21 00 80             ld hl,ULA_BMP
  26+ A0EA 11 01 80             ld de,ULA_BMP+1
  27+ A0ED 01 FF 17             ld bc,$1800-1
  28+ A0F0 36 00                ld (hl),0
  29+ A0F2 ED B0                ldir
  30+ A0F4 21 00 98             ld hl,ULA_ATTR
  31+ A0F7 11 01 98             ld de,ULA_ATTR+1
  32+ A0FA 01 FF 02             ld bc,$300-1
  33+ A0FD 36 0F                ld (hl),MENU_ATTR
  34+ A0FF ED B0                ldir
  35+ A101 C9                   ret
  36+ A102
  37+ A102              ; D = character row, E = column, C = attribute, HL -> text ending 0.
  38+ A102              ; Prints it; HL ends past the 0.
  39+ A102              menu_print:
  40+ A102 7E           .ch:    ld a,(hl)
  41+ A103 23                   inc hl
  42+ A104 B7                   or a
  43+ A105 C8                   ret z
  44+ A106 E5                   push hl
  45+ A107 D5                   push de
  46+ A108 C5                   push bc
  47+ A109 CD 12 A1             call menu_char
  48+ A10C C1                   pop bc
  49+ A10D D1                   pop de
  50+ A10E E1                   pop hl
  51+ A10F 1C                   inc e
  52+ A110 18 F0                jr .ch
  53+ A112
  54+ A112              ; A = ASCII 32-95, D = row, E = column, C = attribute: draw one character
  55+ A112              menu_char:
  56+ A112 D6 20                sub 32
  57+ A114 6F                   ld l,a
  58+ A115 26 00                ld h,0
  59+ A117 29                   add hl,hl
  60+ A118 29                   add hl,hl
  61+ A119 29                   add hl,hl
  62+ A11A D5                   push de
  63+ A11B 11 7B A1             ld de,font8
  64+ A11E 19                   add hl,de                       ; HL -> its 8 bytes
  65+ A11F D1                   pop de
  66+ A120 D5                   push de
  67+ A121 7A                   ld a,d                          ; attribute: ULA_ATTR + row*32 + col
  68+ A122 0F                   rrca
  69+ A123 0F                   rrca
  70+ A124 0F                   rrca
  71+ A125 47                   ld b,a
  72+ A126 E6 E0                and %11100000
  73+ A128 B3                   or e
  74+ A129 E5                   push hl
  75+ A12A 6F                   ld l,a
  76+ A12B 78                   ld a,b
  77+ A12C E6 03                and %00000011
  78+ A12E C6 98                add a,high ULA_ATTR
  79+ A130 67                   ld h,a
  80+ A131 71                   ld (hl),c
  81+ A132 E1                   pop hl
  82+ A133 D1                   pop de
  83+ A134 7A                   ld a,d                          ; bitmap: third, row in third, column
  84+ A135 E6 18                and %00011000
  85+ A137 C6 80                add a,high ULA_BMP
  86+ A139 47                   ld b,a
  87+ A13A 7A                   ld a,d
  88+ A13B E6 07                and 7
  89+ A13D 0F                   rrca
  90+ A13E 0F                   rrca
  91+ A13F 0F                   rrca
  92+ A140 B3                   or e
  93+ A141 5F                   ld e,a
  94+ A142 50                   ld d,b                          ; DE -> the cell's top line
  95+ A143 06 08                ld b,8
  96+ A145 7E           .l:     ld a,(hl)
  97+ A146 12                   ld (de),a
  98+ A147 23                   inc hl
  99+ A148 14                   inc d
 100+ A149 10 FA                djnz .l
 101+ A14B C9                   ret
 102+ A14C
 103+ A14C              ; Wait for the start of the next video frame (the raster reaching line 192)
 104+ A14C              menu_frame:
 105+ A14C CD 57 A1     .in:    call menu_line                  ; let any current blanking end
 106+ A14F 30 FB                jr nc,.in
 107+ A151 CD 57 A1     .out:   call menu_line                  ; then wait for the next one
 108+ A154 38 FB                jr c,.out
 109+ A156 C9                   ret
 110+ A157
 111+ A157              ; Carry clear if the raster is at line 192 or later (blanking).  The line is
 112+ A157              ; read as high byte ($1E), low byte ($1F), high byte again: if the high
 113+ A157              ; byte changed in between (line 255 -> 256) the pair is torn, so read again.
 114+ A157              menu_line:
 115+ A157 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 116+ A15A 3E 1E                ld a,$1E
 117+ A15C ED 79                out (c),a
 118+ A15E 04                   inc b
 119+ A15F ED 58                in e,(c)                        ; high byte
 120+ A161 05                   dec b
 121+ A162 3E 1F                ld a,$1F
 122+ A164 ED 79                out (c),a
 123+ A166 04                   inc b
 124+ A167 ED 50                in d,(c)                        ; low byte
 125+ A169 05                   dec b
 126+ A16A 3E 1E                ld a,$1E
 127+ A16C ED 79                out (c),a
 128+ A16E 04                   inc b
 129+ A16F ED 78                in a,(c)
 130+ A171 BB                   cp e
 131+ A172 20 E3                jr nz,menu_line                 ; torn: again
 132+ A174 E6 01                and 1
 133+ A176 C0                   ret nz                          ; line >= 256 (carry clear)
 134+ A177 7A                   ld a,d
 135+ A178 FE C0                cp 192
 136+ A17A C9                   ret

   1+ A37B              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A37B              ; Z-POLICE - sound effect data (resident: the main page, slot 5, always
   3+ A37B              ; mapped, so the interrupt routine can read it whatever else is paged in)
   4+ A37B              ;
   5+ A37B              ; Played on AY 2 by sfx_tick (interrupts.asm); the game asks for one with
   6+ A37B              ; ld a,SFX_n / ld (sfx_req),a (the numbers are in audio.asm).  A sound is a
   7+ A37B              ; list of steps, one an interrupt (20 ms): each step is AY register / value
   8+ A37B              ; pairs, ended by SFX_STEP (the next step next interrupt) or SFX_END (over).
   9+ A37B              ; The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is 109375/P Hz; a
  10+ A37B              ; lower noise period is a brighter hiss.
  11+ A37B              ;==============================================================================
  12+ A37B
  13+ A37B              ; One step of a zap: channel A at tone period p, channel B 2 periods flat
  14+ A37B              ; (the two beat: a buzz), volumes v and v-2
  15+ A37B                  MACRO SFX_ZAP p, v
  16+ A37B ~                    db AY_TONE_A, low (p), AY_TONE_A+1, high (p)
  17+ A37B ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low ((p)+2), AY_TONE_B+1, high ((p)+2)
  18+ A37B ~                    db AY_VOL_A, v, AY_VOL_B, (v)-2, SFX_STEP
  19+ A37B                  ENDM
  20+ A37B
  21+ A37B              ; One step of a woosh: channel A's noise at period n, volume v
  22+ A37B                  MACRO SFX_WOOSH n, v
  23+ A37B ~                    db AY_NOISE, n, AY_VOL_A, v, SFX_STEP
  24+ A37B                  ENDM
  25+ A37B
  26+ A37B              ; An explosion: a deep noise (channel A, darkening: period 16 up to 30) over
  27+ A37B              ; a low rumble (channel B, BOOM_RUMBLE), both from volume peak (B 2 less)
  28+ A37B              ; fading to nothing over len steps.  (A falling level is an exponential fade:
  29+ A37B              ; the AY's levels are logarithmic.)
  30+ A37B              BOOM_RUMBLE     equ 2735            ; 109375 / 2735 = 40 Hz
  31+ A37B                  MACRO SFX_BOOM peak, len
  32+ A37B ~                    db AY_MIXER, SFX_MIX_BOOM       ; (channel C: the splats', left alone)
  33+ A37B ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low BOOM_RUMBLE, AY_TONE_B+1, high BOOM_RUMBLE
  34+ A37B ~            BOOM_I  DEFL 0
  35+ A37B ~                    DUP len
  36+ A37B ~                    db AY_NOISE, 16 + (BOOM_I*15)/(len)
  37+ A37B ~                    db AY_VOL_A, ((peak)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  38+ A37B ~                    db AY_VOL_B, (((peak)-2)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  39+ A37B ~                    db SFX_STEP
  40+ A37B ~            BOOM_I  DEFL BOOM_I+1
  41+ A37B ~                    EDUP
  42+ A37B ~                    db AY_VOL_A, 0, AY_VOL_B, 0, SFX_END
  43+ A37B                  ENDM
  44+ A37B
  45+ A37B              ; One step of a splat: channel C (only: see sfx_tick) at tone period p,
  46+ A37B              ; volume v
  47+ A37B                  MACRO SFX_SPLAT_STEP p, v
  48+ A37B ~                    db AY_TONE_C, low (p), AY_TONE_C+1, high (p), AY_VOL_C, v, SFX_STEP
  49+ A37B                  ENDM
  50+ A37B
  51+ A37B              ; The sounds, by number (SFX_*, from 1)
  52+ A37B              sfx_table:
  53+ A37B 91 A3                dw sfx_mg                       ; SFX_MG
  54+ A37D 07 A7                dw sfx_laser                    ; SFX_LASER
  55+ A37F B8 A3                dw sfx_chain                    ; SFX_CHAIN
  56+ A381 06 A4                dw sfx_rocket                   ; SFX_ROCKET
  57+ A383 41 A4                dw sfx_missile                  ; SFX_MISSILE
  58+ A385 DF A3                dw sfx_bofors                   ; SFX_BOFORS
  59+ A387 77 A5                dw sfx_boom_rocket              ; SFX_BOOM_ROCKET
  60+ A389 9A A4                dw sfx_boom_missile             ; SFX_BOOM_MISSILE
  61+ A38B 2A A6                dw sfx_boom_bofors              ; SFX_BOOM_BOFORS
  62+ A38D 89 A6                dw sfx_boom_prox                ; SFX_BOOM_PROX
  63+ A38F CC A6                dw sfx_splat                    ; SFX_SPLAT
  64+ A391                      ASSERT SFX_MG == 1 && SFX_LASER == 2 && SFX_CHAIN == 3
  65+ A391                      ASSERT SFX_ROCKET == 4 && SFX_MISSILE == 5 && SFX_BOFORS == 6
  66+ A391                      ASSERT SFX_BOOM_ROCKET == 7 && SFX_BOOM_MISSILE == 8
  67+ A391                      ASSERT SFX_BOOM_BOFORS == 9 && SFX_BOOM_PROX == 10 && SFX_SPLAT == 11
  68+ A391                      ASSERT ($ - sfx_table)/2 == SFX_LAST
  69+ A391
  70+ A391              ; The machine gun, heavy: a sharp crack (bright noise) dropping into a deep
  71+ A391              ; boom (noise, channel A) over a low thump (about 70 Hz, channel B), gone in
  72+ A391              ; 80 ms
  73+ A391              MG_THUMP        equ 1563            ; tone period: 109375 / 1563 = 70 Hz
  74+ A391              sfx_mg:
  75+ A391 07 35                db AY_MIXER, SFX_MIX_NOISE_A_TONE_B
  76+ A393 02 1B 03 06          db AY_TONE_B, low MG_THUMP, AY_TONE_B+1, high MG_THUMP
  77+ A397 0A 00                db AY_VOL_C, 0
  78+ A399 06 04 08 0D          db AY_NOISE, 4, AY_VOL_A, 13, AY_VOL_B, 11, SFX_STEP     ; crack
  78+ A39D 09 0B FE
  79+ A3A0 06 12 08 0A          db AY_NOISE, 18, AY_VOL_A, 10, AY_VOL_B, 9, SFX_STEP     ; boom
  79+ A3A4 09 09 FE
  80+ A3A7 06 1A 08 06          db AY_NOISE, 26, AY_VOL_A, 6, AY_VOL_B, 5, SFX_STEP
  80+ A3AB 09 05 FE
  81+ A3AE 08 03 09 02          db AY_VOL_A, 3, AY_VOL_B, 2, SFX_STEP
  81+ A3B2 FE
  82+ A3B3 08 00 09 00          db AY_VOL_A, 0, AY_VOL_B, 0, SFX_END
  82+ A3B7 FF
  83+ A3B8
  84+ A3B8              ; The chain gun: the machine gun's sound 25% higher in pitch (every period
  85+ A3B8              ; 4/5 of it: the thump about 88 Hz).  It fires every game frame, so each
  86+ A3B8              ; round cuts the last one's tail: a rattle.
  87+ A3B8              CHAIN_THUMP     equ MG_THUMP*4/5    ; 1250: 87.5 Hz
  88+ A3B8              sfx_chain:
  89+ A3B8 07 35                db AY_MIXER, SFX_MIX_NOISE_A_TONE_B
  90+ A3BA 02 E2 03 04          db AY_TONE_B, low CHAIN_THUMP, AY_TONE_B+1, high CHAIN_THUMP
  91+ A3BE 0A 00                db AY_VOL_C, 0
  92+ A3C0 06 03 08 0D          db AY_NOISE, 3, AY_VOL_A, 13, AY_VOL_B, 11, SFX_STEP     ; crack
  92+ A3C4 09 0B FE
  93+ A3C7 06 0E 08 0A          db AY_NOISE, 14, AY_VOL_A, 10, AY_VOL_B, 9, SFX_STEP     ; boom
  93+ A3CB 09 09 FE
  94+ A3CE 06 15 08 06          db AY_NOISE, 21, AY_VOL_A, 6, AY_VOL_B, 5, SFX_STEP
  94+ A3D2 09 05 FE
  95+ A3D5 08 03 09 02          db AY_VOL_A, 3, AY_VOL_B, 2, SFX_STEP
  95+ A3D9 FE
  96+ A3DA 08 00 09 00          db AY_VOL_A, 0, AY_VOL_B, 0, SFX_END
  96+ A3DE FF
  97+ A3DF
  98+ A3DF              ; The Bofors cannon (and the proximity cannon, its shells fired the same
  99+ A3DF              ; way): the machine gun's sound deeper (the thump 30 Hz, the noise periods
 100+ A3DF              ; doubled) and louder (every volume 2 levels up: about twice as loud).  The
 101+ A3DF              ; noise period can't go past 31, so the boom's later steps (18, 26 doubled)

 155+ A49A              ; Explosions (rocket_blast, weapons.asm; on AY 3).  Each one's loudness in
 156+ A49A              ; proportion to its blast's size, damage x reach (game units):
 157+ A49A              ;   missile 15 x 256 = 3840, rocket 20 x 64 = 1280, Bofors 4 x 38 = 152,
 158+ A49A              ;   proximity 3 x 25 = 75.
 159+ A49A              ; Sound level is logarithmic (about 2 AY levels each doubling), so the peak
 160+ A49A              ; is 15 + 2*log2(size / the missile's): 15, 12, 6, 4; and the bigger the

 819  A94F              ;==============================================================================
 820  A94F              ; Frames per second, shown on the ULA layer above Layer 2.
 821  A94F              ;
 822  A94F              ; Interrupts stay off (the span filler borrows SP), so time is taken from the
 823  A94F              ; raster: vtick reads the current video line and counts a new 50Hz video
 824  A94F              ; frame whenever the line number has gone backwards.  It must be called at
 825  A94F              ; least once per video frame (~560K T at 28MHz); the main loop and draw_cell
 826  A94F              ; do that.  Every 50 video frames (1 second) the number of frames rendered
 827  A94F              ; becomes the FPS figure.
 828  A94F              ;==============================================================================
 829  A94F                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
 830  A94F ~            vtick:
 831  A94F ~                    ld bc,$243B
 832  A94F ~                    ld a,$1E
 833  A94F ~                    out (c),a
 834  A94F ~                    inc b
 835  A94F ~                    in d,(c)                        ; line MSB
 836  A94F ~                    dec b
 837  A94F ~                    ld a,$1F
 838  A94F ~                    out (c),a
 839  A94F ~                    inc b
 840  A94F ~                    in e,(c)                        ; line LSB
 841  A94F ~                    dec b
 842  A94F ~                    ld a,$1E
 843  A94F ~                    out (c),a
 844  A94F ~                    inc b
 845  A94F ~                    in a,(c)
 846  A94F ~                    cp d
 847  A94F ~                    jr nz,vtick                     ; MSB changed mid-read: try again
 848  A94F ~                    and 1
 849  A94F ~                    ld d,a                          ; DE = video line 0..311
 850  A94F ~                    ld hl,(fps_line)
 851  A94F ~                    ld (fps_line),de
 852  A94F ~                    or a
 853  A94F ~                    sbc hl,de                       ; previous - current
 854  A94F ~                    ret c
 855  A94F ~                    ret z
 856  A94F ~                    ld hl,fps_vframes               ; line went backwards: new frame
 857  A94F ~                    inc (hl)
 858  A94F ~                    ret
 859  A94F ~
 860  A94F ~            ; Once per rendered frame, after the flip
 861  A94F ~            fps_tick:
 862  A94F ~                    call vtick
 863  A94F ~                    ld hl,fps_count
 864  A94F ~                    inc (hl)
 865  A94F ~                    ld a,(fps_vframes)
 866  A94F ~                    cp 50
 867  A94F ~                    ret c
 868  A94F ~                    sub 50
 869  A94F ~                    ld (fps_vframes),a
 870  A94F ~                    ld a,(fps_count)
 871  A94F ~                    ld (fps_value),a
 872  A94F ~                    xor a
 873  A94F ~                    ld (fps_count),a
 874  A94F ~                    jp fps_draw                     ; HUD page (paged in by main_loop)
 875  A94F                  ENDIF
 876  A94F
 877  A94F              ; A = NextReg number -> A = its value
 878  A94F              read_nextreg:
 879  A94F 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 880  A952 ED 79                out (c),a
 881  A954 04                   inc b
 882  A955 ED 78                in a,(c)
 883  A957 C9                   ret
 884  A958
 885  A958              ; Select the shadow Layer 2 buffer for drawing: remember the 8K page of its
 886  A958              ; first row.  Sections are then paged in on demand by seg_map / line_seg.
 887  A958              map_shadow:
 888  A958 3E 13                ld a,$13
 889  A95A CD 4F A9             call read_nextreg
 890  A95D 87                   add a,a                         ; 16K bank -> 8K page
 891  A95E 32 7F B4             ld (seg_base),a
 892  A961 C9                   ret
 893  A962
 894  A962              ; Show the shadow buffer and make the old active buffer the new shadow
 895  A962              l2_flip:
 896  A962 3E 12                ld a,$12
 897  A964 CD 4F A9             call read_nextreg
 898  A967 5F                   ld e,a                          ; old active
 899  A968 3E 13                ld a,$13
 900  A96A CD 4F A9             call read_nextreg
 901  A96D ED 92 12             nextreg $12,a                   ; shadow -> active
 902  A970 7B                   ld a,e
 903  A971 ED 92 13             nextreg $13,a                   ; old active -> shadow
 904  A974 C9                   ret
 905  A975
 906  A975              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 907  A975              ; Layer 2 writes go through MMU slot 0 ($0000-$1FFF) only.  Each 8K page of
 908  A975              ; the buffer is a 32-row section, so row y is page seg_base + y/32 and its
 909  A975              ; pixels are at (y & 31)*256 + x.  Sections are paged in as drawing reaches
 910  A975              ; them.  Slots 4-5 keep the ULA screen.
 911  A975              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 912  A975
 913  A975              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 914  A975              ; Wait until the raster is outside the display area (line >= 192)
 915  A975              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 916  A975              wait_vblank:
 917  A975 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 918  A978 3E 1E                ld a,$1E
 919  A97A ED 79                out (c),a
 920  A97C 04                   inc b
 921  A97D ED 78                in a,(c)
 922  A97F E6 01                and 1
 923  A981 C0                   ret nz                          ; line >= 256
 924  A982 05                   dec b
 925  A983 3E 1F                ld a,$1F
 926  A985 ED 79                out (c),a
 927  A987 04                   inc b
 928  A988 ED 78                in a,(c)
 929  A98A FE C0                cp 192
 930  A98C 38 E7                jr c,wait_vblank
 931  A98E C9                   ret
 932  A98F
 933  A98F              ; HL -> map byte for the cell the camera is in
 934  A98F              cam_cell_ptr:
 935  A98F 3A 28 AE             ld a,(cam_z+2)
 936  A992 6F                   ld l,a
 937  A993 26 00                ld h,0
 938  A995                      ROWOFS
 938  A995 29          >        add hl,hl
 938  A996 29          >        add hl,hl
 938  A997 29          >        add hl,hl
 938  A998 29          >        add hl,hl
 938  A999 29          >        add hl,hl
 938  A99A 29          >        add hl,hl
 939  A99B 3A 25 AE             ld a,(cam_x+2)
 940  A99E ED 31                add hl,a
 941  A9A0 11 00 70             ld de,city_map
 942  A9A3 19                   add hl,de
 943  A9A4 C9                   ret
 944  A9A5
 945  A9A5              ; A = damage to the VTOL (a building crash, a ghost): its hit points
 946  A9A5              ; (vtol_hp) fall by that, not below 0.  At 0 it is destroyed (vtol_dead): it
 947  A9A5              ; spins down out of control (vtol_wreck, player.asm), then the game is over.
 948  A9A5              vtol_damage:
 949  A9A5 B7                   or a
 950  A9A6 C8                   ret z
 951  A9A7 4F                   ld c,a
 952  A9A8 3A 40 AE             ld a,(vtol_hp)
 953  A9AB 91                   sub c
 954  A9AC 30 01                jr nc,.hp
 955  A9AE AF                   xor a
 956  A9AF 32 40 AE     .hp:    ld (vtol_hp),a
 957  A9B2 C0                   ret nz
 958  A9B3 3E 01                ld a,1
 959  A9B5 32 41 AE             ld (vtol_dead),a
 960  A9B8 C9                   ret
 961  A9B9
 962  A9B9              ; HL = the height the VTOL rests at: MIN_Y when its whole footprint is over
 963  A9B9              ; road, or just clear (COLL_H) of the highest roof under it
 964  A9B9              floor_y:
 965  A9B9 CD DF AB             call vtol_ground
 966  A9BC 21 08 00             ld hl,MIN_Y
 967  A9BF C8                   ret z
 968  A9C0 2A C9 AE             ld hl,(vg_max)
 969  A9C3 11 0D 00             ld de,COLL_H+1
 970  A9C6 19                   add hl,de
 971  A9C7 C9                   ret
 972  A9C8
 973  A9C8              ; Weapon type details, by WPN_*: its full load, reload frames a shot (0:
 974  A9C8              ; doesn't reload; the AMMO_INF weapons) and the slots it may be fitted in
 975  A9C8              ; (resident, for the weapons page and the load-out screen)
 976  A9C8 00 00 1F     wpn_cfg:    db 0, 0, WS_ANY                             ; WPN_NONE (empty)
 977  A9CB FF 00 01                 db AMMO_INF, 0, WS_CENTRE                   ; WPN_GUN
 978  A9CE FF 00 1F                 db AMMO_INF, 0, WS_ANY                      ; WPN_LASER
 979  A9D1 FF 00 01                 db AMMO_INF, 0, WS_CENTRE                   ; WPN_CHAIN
 980  A9D4 0C 0F 1E                 db ROCKET_SHOTS, ROCKET_RELOAD, WS_PYLONS   ; WPN_ROCKETS
 981  A9D7 04 1E 1E                 db MISSILE_SHOTS, MISSILE_RELOAD, WS_PYLONS ; WPN_MISSILE
 982  A9DA 00 00 00                 db 0, 0, 0                                  ; WPN_BOMB (none yet)
 983  A9DD 32 07 1E                 db BOFORS_SHOTS, BOFORS_RELOAD, WS_PYLONS   ; WPN_BOFORS
 984  A9E0 32 07 1E                 db PROX_SHOTS, PROX_RELOAD, WS_PYLONS       ; WPN_PROX
 985  A9E3                      ASSERT WPN_ROCKETS == 4 && WPN_MISSILE == 5 && WPN_BOFORS == 7
 986  A9E3                      ASSERT WPN_PROX == 8
 987  A9E3                      ASSERT $ - wpn_cfg == WCFG_SIZE*(WPN_LAST+1)
 988  A9E3
 989  A9E3              ; A = weapon type -> HL = its wpn_cfg entry.  Preserves BC, DE.
 990  A9E3              wpn_cfg_ptr:
 991  A9E3 6F                   ld l,a
 992  A9E4 87                   add a,a
 993  A9E5 85                   add a,l                         ; * WCFG_SIZE
 994  A9E6 21 C8 A9             ld hl,wpn_cfg
 995  A9E9 ED 31                add hl,a
 996  A9EB C9                   ret
 997  A9EC                      ASSERT WCFG_SIZE == 3
 998  A9EC
 999  A9EC              ; A = weapon type, C = slot (0 = the centre slot): carry set if the weapon
1000  A9EC              ; may be fitted in that slot (WCFG_SLOTS).  Preserves DE.
1001  A9EC              wpn_fits:
1002  A9EC CD E3 A9             call wpn_cfg_ptr
1003  A9EF 3E 02                ld a,WCFG_SLOTS
1004  A9F1 ED 31                add hl,a
1005  A9F3 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1006  A9F4 41                   ld b,c
1007  A9F5 04                   inc b
1008  A9F6 0F           .sh:    rrca                            ; bit C into carry
1009  A9F7 10 FD                djnz .sh
1010  A9F9 C9                   ret
1011  A9FA
1012  A9FA              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1013  A9FA              ; From the LEVEL COMPLETE screen (menu.asm, slot 6): page the load-out screen
1014  A9FA              ; into slot 6 (from here, resident) and show it; it goes on to next_level
1015  A9FA              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1016  A9FA              loadout_go:

1019  AA01
1020  AA01              ; From the main menu (menu.asm, slot 6): the redefine keys screen
1021  AA01              keydef_go:

1023  AA05 C3 00 C0             jp keydef_screen
1024  AA08
1025  AA08              ; Back to the main menu, from another slot 6 page (the redefine keys screen)
1026  AA08              menu_go:

1028  AA0C C3 00 C0             jp main_menu
1029  AA0F
1030  AA0F              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1031  AA0F              ; Paused (main_loop: the pause control, K_PAUSE, BREAK or a Mega Drive pad's
1032  AA0F              ; START by default): PAUSED over the view, white on an opaque black ULA box,
1033  AA0F              ; and under it S: SAVE AND QUIT, until the pause control is pressed again.
1034  AA0F              ; Nothing moves meanwhile and the screen keeps its last frame.  S (fixed:
1035  AA0F              ; only while paused) saves the game (save_game) and goes back to the main
1036  AA0F              ; menu; if it can't be saved, SAVE FAILED, and it stays paused.  (Not in a
1037  AA0F              ; wreck: nothing to save.)  Needs the input page in slot 7.
1038  AA0F              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1039  AA0F              PAUSE_ROW       equ 7               ; ULA character row and column of the box
1040  AA0F              PAUSE_COL       equ 12
1041  AA0F              PAUSE_ROW2      equ 9               ; and of the save line
1042  AA0F              PAUSE_COL2      equ 7
1043  AA0F              PAUSE_ATTR      equ 2<<3 | 7        ; paper 2 (opaque black), ink 7 (white)
1044  AA0F              VIEW_ATTR       equ %01000111       ; the viewport's own (ula_init): transparent
1045  AA0F              game_pause:
1046  AA0F 21 7C AA             ld hl,txt_paused
1047  AA12 11 0C 07             ld de,PAUSE_ROW<<8 | PAUSE_COL
1048  AA15 0E 17                ld c,PAUSE_ATTR
1049  AA17 CD 02 A1             call menu_print
1050  AA1A 3A 41 AE             ld a,(vtol_dead)
1051  AA1D B7                   or a
1052  AA1E 20 0B                jr nz,.w                        ; (a wreck: no saving)
1053  AA20 21 8E AA             ld hl,txt_pause_save
1054  AA23 11 07 09             ld de,PAUSE_ROW2<<8 | PAUSE_COL2
1055  AA26 0E 17                ld c,PAUSE_ATTR
1056  AA28 CD 02 A1             call menu_print
1057  AA2B CD 4C A1     .w:     call menu_frame
1058  AA2E CD 00 E0             call kbd_scan
1059  AA31 3A 41 AE             ld a,(vtol_dead)
1060  AA34 B7                   or a
1061  AA35 20 08                jr nz,.np
1062  AA37 21 02 01             ld hl,KB_S                      ; save and quit
1063  AA3A CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
1064  AA3D 20 1D                jr nz,.save
1065  AA3F 3E 12        .np:    ld a,K_PAUSE
1066  AA41 CD CF E0             call key_pressed
1067  AA44 28 E5                jr z,.w
1068  AA46 21 85 AA             ld hl,txt_unpaused              ; the box gone: the view again
1069  AA49 11 0C 07             ld de,PAUSE_ROW<<8 | PAUSE_COL
1070  AA4C 0E 47                ld c,VIEW_ATTR
1071  AA4E CD 02 A1             call menu_print
1072  AA51 21 B4 AA             ld hl,txt_unpaused2
1073  AA54 11 07 09             ld de,PAUSE_ROW2<<8 | PAUSE_COL2
1074  AA57 0E 47                ld c,VIEW_ATTR
1075  AA59 C3 02 A1             jp menu_print
1076  AA5C CD 11 AB     .save:  call save_game                  ; (pages the file handler in)
1077  AA5F 38 0A                jr c,.fail
1078  AA61 ED 91 56 08          nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_MENU     ; saved: the main menu
1079  AA65 31 85 B5             ld sp,stack_top
1080  AA68 C3 00 C0             jp main_menu
1081  AA6B ED 91 57 0C  .fail:  nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INPUT     ; couldn't: say so, still paused
1082  AA6F 21 A1 AA             ld hl,txt_save_fail
1083  AA72 11 07 09             ld de,PAUSE_ROW2<<8 | PAUSE_COL2
1084  AA75 0E 17                ld c,PAUSE_ATTR
1085  AA77 CD 02 A1             call menu_print
1086  AA7A 18 AF                jr .w
1087  AA7C
1088  AA7C 20 50 41 55  txt_paused:     db " PAUSED ", 0
1088  AA80 53 45 44 20
1088  AA84 00
1089  AA85 20 20 20 20  txt_unpaused:   db "        ", 0
1089  AA89 20 20 20 20
1089  AA8D 00
1090  AA8E                      ASSERT txt_unpaused - txt_paused == $ - txt_unpaused
1091  AA8E 20 53 3A 20  txt_pause_save: db " S: SAVE AND QUIT ", 0
1091  AA92 53 41 56 45
1091  AA96 20 41 4E 44
1091  AA9A 20 51 55 49
1091  AA9E 54 20 00
1092  AAA1 20 20 20 53  txt_save_fail:  db "   SAVE FAILED    ", 0
1092  AAA5 41 56 45 20
1092  AAA9 46 41 49 4C
1092  AAAD 45 44 20 20
1092  AAB1 20 20 00
1093  AAB4 20 20 20 20  txt_unpaused2:  db "                  ", 0
1093  AAB8 20 20 20 20
1093  AABC 20 20 20 20
1093  AAC0 20 20 20 20
1093  AAC4 20 20 00
1094  AAC7                      ASSERT txt_save_fail - txt_pause_save == txt_unpaused2 - txt_save_fail
1095  AAC7                      ASSERT txt_unpaused2 - txt_save_fail == $ - txt_unpaused2
1096  AAC7
1097  AAC7              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1098  AAC7              ; Save games: ZPDATA/SAVEGAME.ZPS (beside the level files), one game.  Written
1099  AAC7              ; by save and quit (game_pause: save_game), read by CONTINUE on the main menu
1100  AAC7              ; (load_save, continue_game).  "ZPSV", SG_VERSION, then the fields in
1101  AAC7              ; sg_fields, in order: the level and wave, the salvage, the VTOL's integrity
1102  AAC7              ; (vtol_hp), its weapon slots (type and ammo each) and the selected one, the
1103  AAC7              ; store (wpn_stock, wpn_unlocked), and the booster (fitted, fuel).
1104  AAC7              ; Continued, the level starts afresh at the saved wave: its zombies, the
1105  AAC7              ; humans (and this level's rescues so far) and the base are new.
1106  AAC7              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1107  AAC7              SG_VERSION      equ 1
1108  AAC7              sg_fields:      ; address, bytes
1109  AAC7 3D AE                dw level
1110  AAC9 01                   db 1
1111  AACA 46 AE                dw wave_number
1112  AACC 01                   db 1
1113  AACD 48 AE                dw salvage_points
1114  AACF 02                   db 2
1115  AAD0 40 AE                dw vtol_hp
1116  AAD2 01                   db 1
1117  AAD3 30 AE                dw wpn_slots
1118  AAD5 0A                   db WPN_SLOTS*2
1119  AAD6 3A AE                dw wpn_sel
1120  AAD8 01                   db 1
1121  AAD9 A7 AE                dw wpn_stock
1122  AADB 09                   db WPN_LAST+1
1123  AADC B0 AE                dw wpn_unlocked
1124  AADE 09                   db WPN_LAST+1
1125  AADF B9 AE                dw boost_fitted                 ; (and boost_fuel, after it)
1126  AAE1 02                   db 2
1127  AAE2 00 00                dw 0                            ; (the end)
1128  AAE4                      ASSERT boost_fuel == boost_fitted+1
1129  AAE4              SG_SIZE         equ 5+1+1+2+1+WPN_SLOTS*2+1+2*(WPN_LAST+1)+2
1130  AAE4
1131  AAE4              ; Copy the fields: A = 0 the game's into sg_buf, 1 sg_buf's into the game
1132  AAE4              sg_copy:
1133  AAE4 32 9F AB             ld (sg_dir),a
1134  AAE7 DD 21 C7 AA          ld ix,sg_fields
1135  AAEB 11 A6 AB             ld de,sg_buf+5
1136  AAEE DD 6E 00     .lp:    ld l,(ix+0)
1137  AAF1 DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
1138  AAF4 7C                   ld a,h
1139  AAF5 B5                   or l
1140  AAF6 C8                   ret z
1141  AAF7 DD 4E 02             ld c,(ix+2)
1142  AAFA 06 00                ld b,0
1143  AAFC 3A 9F AB             ld a,(sg_dir)
1144  AAFF B7                   or a
1145  AB00 28 06                jr z,.out
1146  AB02 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; into the game: HL = sg_buf
1147  AB03 ED B0                ldir
1148  AB05 EB                   ex de,hl
1149  AB06 18 02                jr .nx
1150  AB08 ED B0        .out:   ldir                            ; out of it: HL = the field
1151  AB0A 01 03 00     .nx:    ld bc,3
1152  AB0D DD 09                add ix,bc
1153  AB0F 18 DD                jr .lp
1154  AB11
1155  AB11              ; Save the game.  Carry set (A = the esxDOS error) if it couldn't be
1156  AB11              ; written.  Leaves the file handler in slot 7.
1157  AB11              save_game:
1158  AB11 21 9B AB             ld hl,sg_magic
1159  AB14 11 A1 AB             ld de,sg_buf
1160  AB17 01 04 00             ld bc,4
1161  AB1A ED B0                ldir
1162  AB1C 3E 01                ld a,SG_VERSION
1163  AB1E 12                   ld (de),a
1164  AB1F AF                   xor a
1165  AB20 CD E4 AA             call sg_copy
1166  AB23 ED 91 57 10          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE
1167  AB27 21 87 AB             ld hl,sg_name
1168  AB2A 11 A1 AB             ld de,sg_buf
1169  AB2D 01 29 00             ld bc,SG_SIZE
1170  AB30 C3 90 E0             jp fh_save
1171  AB33
1172  AB33              ; Read the save game into sg_buf: carry set if there's none, or it isn't a
1173  AB33              ; save game this version can use (its level out of range too).  Leaves the
1174  AB33              ; file handler in slot 7.
1175  AB33              load_save:
1176  AB33 ED 91 57 10          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE
1177  AB37 21 87 AB             ld hl,sg_name
1178  AB3A 11 A1 AB             ld de,sg_buf
1179  AB3D 01 29 00             ld bc,SG_SIZE
1180  AB40 CD 81 E0             call fh_load
1181  AB43 D8                   ret c
1182  AB44 21 D7 FF             ld hl,-SG_SIZE                  ; all of it?
1183  AB47 09                   add hl,bc
1184  AB48 7C                   ld a,h
1185  AB49 B5                   or l
1186  AB4A 20 21                jr nz,.bad
1187  AB4C 21 A1 AB             ld hl,sg_buf
1188  AB4F 11 9B AB             ld de,sg_magic
1189  AB52 06 04                ld b,4
1190  AB54 1A           .m:     ld a,(de)
1191  AB55 BE                   cp (hl)
1192  AB56 20 15                jr nz,.bad
1193  AB58 23                   inc hl
1194  AB59 13                   inc de
1195  AB5A 10 F8                djnz .m
1196  AB5C 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1197  AB5D FE 01                cp SG_VERSION
1198  AB5F 20 0C                jr nz,.bad
1199  AB61 3A A6 AB             ld a,(sg_buf+5)                 ; its level (sg_fields' first)
1200  AB64 B7                   or a
1201  AB65 28 06                jr z,.bad
1202  AB67 FE 33                cp LEVEL_LAST+1
1203  AB69 30 02                jr nc,.bad
1204  AB6B B7                   or a                            ; usable: carry clear
1205  AB6C C9                   ret
1206  AB6D 37           .bad:   scf
1207  AB6E C9                   ret
1208  AB6F
1209  AB6F              ; CONTINUE (main menu, after load_save): a new game with the save game's
1210  AB6F              ; fields over it, into its level at its wave
1211  AB6F              continue_game:
1212  AB6F 31 85 B5             ld sp,stack_top
1213  AB72 CD BC A7             call game_reset
1214  AB75 3E 01                ld a,1
1215  AB77 CD E4 AA             call sg_copy
1216  AB7A 3A 46 AE             ld a,(wave_number)
1217  AB7D B7                   or a
1218  AB7E 20 01                jr nz,.w
1219  AB80 3C                   inc a
1220  AB81 32 A0 AB     .w:     ld (resume_wave),a
1221  AB84 C3 41 A8             jp next_level
1222  AB87
1223  AB87 5A 50 44 41  sg_name:    db "ZPDATA/SAVEGAME.ZPS", 0
1223  AB8B 54 41 2F 53
1223  AB8F 41 56 45 47
1223  AB93 41 4D 45 2E
1223  AB97 5A 50 53 00
1224  AB9B 5A 50 53 56  sg_magic:   db "ZPSV"
1225  AB9F 00           sg_dir:     db 0
1226  ABA0 01           resume_wave: db 1                       ; next_level's first wave (1, or a
1227  ABA1                                                      ; save game's: continue_game)
1228  ABA1 00 00 00...  sg_buf:     ds SG_SIZE
1229  ABCA
1230  ABCA              ; Z if the VTOL is landed: speed 0 and resting on the floor under it (the
1231  ABCA              ; road, the landing pad or a roof: floor_y), and not a wreck.  Landed, its
1232  ABCA              ; weapons don't fire (update_weapons) and humans can board or get off
1233  ABCA              ; (human_update).
1234  ABCA              vtol_landed:
1235  ABCA 3A 41 AE             ld a,(vtol_dead)
1236  ABCD B7                   or a
1237  ABCE C0                   ret nz                          ; a wreck
1238  ABCF 3A 2F AE             ld a,(speed)
1239  ABD2 B7                   or a
1240  ABD3 C0                   ret nz                          ; moving
1241  ABD4 CD B9 A9             call floor_y
1242  ABD7 ED 5B 29 AE          ld de,(cam_y)
1243  ABDB B7                   or a
1244  ABDC ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; Z: resting on it
1245  ABDE C9                   ret
1246  ABDF
1247  ABDF              ; The VTOL's footprint: the corners and the long-side midpoints of its
1248  ABDF              ; VTOL_HL x VTOL_HW (half size) rectangle, turned to the heading, round
1249  ABDF              ; (cam_x, cam_z).  The rectangle is smaller than a tile, so these six points
1250  ABDF              ; find every cell it overlaps (to within a tile corner nicking a long side).
1251  ABDF              ; HL = vg_max = the highest ground under them; Z if all road (0).
1252  ABDF              vtol_ground:
1253  ABDF 3A 2C AE             ld a,(yaw)                      ; forward (sin, cos), right (cos, -sin)
1254  ABE2 CD 33 AD             call get_sin
1255  ABE5 22 BD AE             ld (vg_sin),hl
1256  ABE8 3A 2C AE             ld a,(yaw)
1257  ABEB C6 40                add a,64
1258  ABED CD 33 AD             call get_sin
1259  ABF0 22 BF AE             ld (vg_cos),hl
1260  ABF3 EB                   ex de,hl
1261  ABF4 21 40 00             ld hl,VTOL_HL
1262  ABF7 CD EA AD             call fmul
1263  ABFA 22 C3 AE             ld (vg_fz),hl                   ; nose offset z = HL cos
1264  ABFD ED 5B BF AE          ld de,(vg_cos)
1265  AC01 21 13 00             ld hl,VTOL_HW
1266  AC04 CD EA AD             call fmul
1267  AC07 22 C5 AE             ld (vg_rx),hl                   ; side offset x = HW cos
1268  AC0A ED 5B BD AE          ld de,(vg_sin)
1269  AC0E 21 40 00             ld hl,VTOL_HL
1270  AC11 CD EA AD             call fmul
1271  AC14 22 C1 AE             ld (vg_fx),hl                   ; nose offset x = HL sin
1272  AC17 ED 5B BD AE          ld de,(vg_sin)
1273  AC1B 21 13 00             ld hl,VTOL_HW
1274  AC1E CD EA AD             call fmul
1275  AC21 CD DE AD             call neg_hl
1276  AC24 22 C7 AE             ld (vg_rz),hl                   ; side offset z = -HW sin
1277  AC27 21 00 00             ld hl,0
1278  AC2A 22 C9 AE             ld (vg_max),hl
1279  AC2D 2A C1 AE             ld hl,(vg_fx)                   ; nose: the front corners
1280  AC30 ED 5B C3 AE          ld de,(vg_fz)
1281  AC34 CD 58 AC             call .side
1282  AC37 21 00 00             ld hl,0                         ; the long-side midpoints
1283  AC3A 11 00 00             ld de,0
1284  AC3D CD 58 AC             call .side
1285  AC40 2A C1 AE             ld hl,(vg_fx)                   ; tail: the back corners
1286  AC43 CD DE AD             call neg_hl
1287  AC46 E5                   push hl
1288  AC47 2A C3 AE             ld hl,(vg_fz)
1289  AC4A CD DE AD             call neg_hl
1290  AC4D EB                   ex de,hl
1291  AC4E E1                   pop hl
1292  AC4F CD 58 AC             call .side
1293  AC52 2A C9 AE             ld hl,(vg_max)
1294  AC55 7C                   ld a,h
1295  AC56 B5                   or l
1296  AC57 C9                   ret
1297  AC58              ; HL, DE = an offset along the length (x, z): the points it +- the side offset
1298  AC58 E5           .side:  push hl
1299  AC59 D5                   push de
1300  AC5A ED 4B C5 AE          ld bc,(vg_rx)
1301  AC5E 09                   add hl,bc
1302  AC5F EB                   ex de,hl
1303  AC60 ED 4B C7 AE          ld bc,(vg_rz)
1304  AC64 09                   add hl,bc
1305  AC65 EB                   ex de,hl
1306  AC66 CD 7B AC             call .pt
1307  AC69 D1                   pop de
1308  AC6A E1                   pop hl
1309  AC6B ED 4B C5 AE          ld bc,(vg_rx)
1310  AC6F B7                   or a
1311  AC70 ED 42                sbc hl,bc
1312  AC72 EB                   ex de,hl
1313  AC73 ED 4B C7 AE          ld bc,(vg_rz)
1314  AC77 B7                   or a
1315  AC78 ED 42                sbc hl,bc
1316  AC7A EB                   ex de,hl
1317  AC7B              ; HL, DE = offset (x, z) from the centre: vg_max = max(vg_max, its ground)
1318  AC7B ED 4B 24 AE  .pt:    ld bc,(cam_x+1)
1319  AC7F 09                   add hl,bc
1320  AC80 7C                   ld a,h                          ; column
1321  AC81 EB                   ex de,hl
1322  AC82 ED 4B 27 AE          ld bc,(cam_z+1)
1323  AC86 09                   add hl,bc
1324  AC87 6C                   ld l,h                          ; row
1325  AC88 26 00                ld h,0
1326  AC8A                      ROWOFS
1326  AC8A 29          >        add hl,hl
1326  AC8B 29          >        add hl,hl
1326  AC8C 29          >        add hl,hl
1326  AC8D 29          >        add hl,hl
1326  AC8E 29          >        add hl,hl
1326  AC8F 29          >        add hl,hl
1327  AC90 ED 31                add hl,a
1328  AC92 11 00 70             ld de,city_map
1329  AC95 19                   add hl,de
1330  AC96 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1331  AC97 E6 1F                and CELL_CODE
1332  AC99 C8                   ret z                           ; road
1333  AC9A CD AA AC             call bld_height

1335  ACA1 B7                   or a
1336  ACA2 ED 52                sbc hl,de
1337  ACA4 D8                   ret c                           ; lower than the highest so far
1338  ACA5 19                   add hl,de
1339  ACA6 22 C9 AE             ld (vg_max),hl
1340  ACA9 C9                   ret
1341  ACAA
1342  ACAA              ; A = map byte -> HL = height in world units (levels 0-15, PAD_CODE = the
1343  ACAA              ; base landing pad, TERRACE_CODE = the terrace round it)
1344  ACAA              bld_height:
