1346  ACAC 87                   add a,a
1347  ACAD 21 31 A0             ld hl,htab
1348  ACB0 ED 31                add hl,a
1349  ACB2 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1350  ACB3 23                   inc hl
1351  ACB4 66                   ld h,(hl)
1352  ACB5 6F                   ld l,a
1353  ACB6 C9                   ret
1354  ACB7
1355  ACB7              ;==============================================================================
1356  ACB7              ; Per-frame view setup: trig, rotated building edge vectors, horizon
1357  ACB7              ;==============================================================================
1358  ACB7              setup_frame:
1359  ACB7 3A 2C AE             ld a,(yaw)
1360  ACBA CD 33 AD             call get_sin
1361  ACBD 22 59 B4             ld (sin_y),hl
1362  ACC0 3A 2C AE             ld a,(yaw)
1363  ACC3 C6 40                add a,64
1364  ACC5 CD 33 AD             call get_sin
1365  ACC8 22 5B B4             ld (cos_y),hl
1366  ACCB 3A 2E AE             ld a,(pitch)
1367  ACCE CD 33 AD             call get_sin
1368  ACD1 22 5D B4             ld (sin_p),hl
1369  ACD4 3A 2E AE             ld a,(pitch)
1370  ACD7 C6 40                add a,64
1371  ACD9 CD 33 AD             call get_sin
1372  ACDC 22 5F B4             ld (cos_p),hl
1373  ACDF
1374  ACDF                      ; ground plane relative to camera: dy = -camY
1375  ACDF 2A 29 AE             ld hl,(cam_y)
1376  ACE2 CD DE AD             call neg_hl
1377  ACE5 E5                   push hl
1378  ACE6 ED 5B 5F B4          ld de,(cos_p)
1379  ACEA CD EA AD             call fmul
1380  ACED 22 61 B4             ld (yb),hl                      ; Y contribution of ground
1381  ACF0 E1                   pop hl
1382  ACF1 ED 5B 5D B4          ld de,(sin_p)
1383  ACF5 CD EA AD             call fmul
1384  ACF8 22 63 B4             ld (zb),hl                      ; Z contribution of ground
1385  ACFB
1386  ACFB                      ; frustum cull factor c = cosP - 0.5|sinP|
1387  ACFB 2A 5D B4             ld hl,(sin_p)
1388  ACFE CD E5 AD             call abs_hl
1389  AD01 CD 1E AE             call zhalf
1390  AD04 EB                   ex de,hl
1391  AD05 2A 5F B4             ld hl,(cos_p)
1392  AD08 B7                   or a
1393  AD09 ED 52                sbc hl,de
1394  AD0B 22 75 B4             ld (cull_c),hl
1395  AD0E
1396  AD0E 21 00 01             ld hl,BLD_SIZE
1397  AD11 DD 21 65 B4          ld ix,vecs0
1398  AD15 CD 3F AD             call make_vecs
1399  AD18
1400  AD18 3A 25 AE             ld a,(cam_x+2)
1401  AD1B 32 7D B4             ld (cx),a
1402  AD1E 3A 28 AE             ld a,(cam_z+2)
1403  AD21 32 7E B4             ld (cz),a
1404  AD24
1405  AD24 3A 2E AE             ld a,(pitch)
1406  AD27 C6 18                add a,PMAX
1407  AD29 21 00 A0             ld hl,hztab
1408  AD2C ED 31                add hl,a
1409  AD2E 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1410  AD2F 32 58 B4             ld (horizon),a
1411  AD32 C9                   ret
1412  AD33
1413  AD33              ; A = angle -> HL = sin (S7.8).  Pages the sine table into slot 0 (PAGE_SIN):
1414  AD33              ; call it only outside the Layer 2 drawing (it is: setup_frame, the player,
1415  AD33              ; vtol_ground), never between a section's paging and its writes.
1416  AD33              get_sin:
1417  AD33 ED 91 50 0E          nextreg SIN_MMU,PAGE_SIN        ; the table at $0000 (slot 0)
1418  AD37 6F                   ld l,a
1419  AD38 26 00                ld h,high sin_lo
1420  AD3A 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1421  AD3B 24                   inc h
1422  AD3C 66                   ld h,(hl)
1423  AD3D 6F                   ld l,a
1424  AD3E C9                   ret
1425  AD3F
1426  AD3F              ; Rotate the building edge vectors (s,0,0) and (0,0,s) into camera space.
1427  AD3F              ; HL = s, IX -> 16 bytes: VX(X,Y,Z) VZ(X,Y,Z) corner offset (X,Z1)
1428  AD3F              make_vecs:
1429  AD3F 22 77 B4             ld (mv_s),hl
1430  AD42 ED 5B 5B B4          ld de,(cos_y)
1431  AD46 CD EA AD             call fmul
1432  AD49 22 79 B4             ld (mv_c),hl                    ; s*cosY
1433  AD4C 2A 77 B4             ld hl,(mv_s)
1434  AD4F ED 5B 59 B4          ld de,(sin_y)
1435  AD53 CD EA AD             call fmul
1436  AD56 22 7B B4             ld (mv_n),hl                    ; s*sinY
1437  AD59                      ; VX = ( s cosY, -s sinY sinP, s sinY cosP )
1438  AD59 2A 79 B4             ld hl,(mv_c)
1439  AD5C DD 75 00             ld (ix+0),l
1440  AD5F DD 74 01             ld (ix+1),h
1441  AD62 2A 7B B4             ld hl,(mv_n)
1442  AD65 ED 5B 5D B4          ld de,(sin_p)
1443  AD69 CD EA AD             call fmul
1444  AD6C CD DE AD             call neg_hl
1445  AD6F DD 75 02             ld (ix+2),l
1446  AD72 DD 74 03             ld (ix+3),h
1447  AD75 2A 7B B4             ld hl,(mv_n)
1448  AD78 ED 5B 5F B4          ld de,(cos_p)
1449  AD7C CD EA AD             call fmul
1450  AD7F DD 75 04             ld (ix+4),l
1451  AD82 DD 74 05             ld (ix+5),h
1452  AD85                      ; VZ = ( -s sinY, -s cosY sinP, s cosY cosP )
1453  AD85 2A 7B B4             ld hl,(mv_n)
1454  AD88 CD DE AD             call neg_hl
1455  AD8B DD 75 06             ld (ix+6),l
1456  AD8E DD 74 07             ld (ix+7),h
1457  AD91 2A 79 B4             ld hl,(mv_c)
1458  AD94 ED 5B 5D B4          ld de,(sin_p)
1459  AD98 CD EA AD             call fmul
1460  AD9B CD DE AD             call neg_hl
1461  AD9E DD 75 08             ld (ix+8),l
1462  ADA1 DD 74 09             ld (ix+9),h
1463  ADA4 2A 79 B4             ld hl,(mv_c)
1464  ADA7 ED 5B 5F B4          ld de,(cos_p)
1465  ADAB CD EA AD             call fmul
1466  ADAE DD 75 0A             ld (ix+10),l
1467  ADB1 DD 74 0B             ld (ix+11),h
1468  ADB4                      ; cell centre -> footprint corner (-s/2,-s/2) in yaw space
1469  ADB4 2A 7B B4             ld hl,(mv_n)
1470  ADB7 ED 5B 79 B4          ld de,(mv_c)
1471  ADBB B7                   or a
1472  ADBC ED 52                sbc hl,de
1473  ADBE CB 2C                sra h
1474  ADC0 CB 1D                rr l
1475  ADC2 DD 75 0C             ld (ix+12),l                    ; X: s/2 (sinY - cosY)
1476  ADC5 DD 74 0D             ld (ix+13),h
1477  ADC8 2A 7B B4             ld hl,(mv_n)
1478  ADCB ED 5B 79 B4          ld de,(mv_c)
1479  ADCF 19                   add hl,de
1480  ADD0 CB 2C                sra h
1481  ADD2 CB 1D                rr l
1482  ADD4 CD DE AD             call neg_hl
1483  ADD7 DD 75 0E             ld (ix+14),l                    ; Z1: -s/2 (sinY + cosY)
1484  ADDA DD 74 0F             ld (ix+15),h
1485  ADDD C9                   ret
1486  ADDE
1487  ADDE              ;==============================================================================
1488  ADDE              ; Fixed point maths
1489  ADDE              ;==============================================================================
1490  ADDE
1491  ADDE              ; HL = -HL
1492  ADDE              neg_hl:
1493  ADDE AF                   xor a
1494  ADDF 95                   sub l
1495  ADE0 6F                   ld l,a
1496  ADE1 9F                   sbc a,a
1497  ADE2 94                   sub h
1498  ADE3 67                   ld h,a
1499  ADE4 C9                   ret
1500  ADE5
1501  ADE5              ; HL = |HL|
1502  ADE5              abs_hl:
1503  ADE5 CB 7C                bit 7,h
1504  ADE7 C8                   ret z
1505  ADE8 18 F4                jr neg_hl
1506  ADEA
1507  ADEA              ; fmul: HL = HL * DE >> 8
1508  ADEA              ;   HL = signed 16-bit integer, DE = S7.8 factor in -1.0..+1.0
1509  ADEA              ;   Sign/magnitude using two 8x8 MUL D,E.  Preserves IX, IY.
1510  ADEA              fmul:
1511  ADEA 7C                   ld a,h
1512  ADEB AA                   xor d
1513  ADEC F5                   push af                         ; result sign in bit 7
1514  ADED CB 7C                bit 7,h
1515  ADEF 28 06                jr z,.ap
1516  ADF1 AF                   xor a
1517  ADF2 95                   sub l
1518  ADF3 6F                   ld l,a
1519  ADF4 9F                   sbc a,a
1520  ADF5 94                   sub h
1521  ADF6 67                   ld h,a
1522  ADF7 CB 7A        .ap:    bit 7,d
1523  ADF9 28 06                jr z,.bp
1524  ADFB AF                   xor a
1525  ADFC 93                   sub e
1526  ADFD 5F                   ld e,a
1527  ADFE 9F                   sbc a,a
1528  ADFF 92                   sub d
1529  AE00 57                   ld d,a
1530  AE01 7A           .bp:    ld a,d
1531  AE02 B7                   or a
1532  AE03 20 10                jr nz,.one                      ; |factor| == 1.0
1533  AE05 7B                   ld a,e
1534  AE06 55                   ld d,l
1535  AE07 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; lo * f
1536  AE09 4A                   ld c,d
1537  AE0A 54                   ld d,h
1538  AE0B 5F                   ld e,a
1539  AE0C ED 30                mul d,e                         ; hi * f
1540  AE0E 7B                   ld a,e
1541  AE0F 81                   add a,c
1542  AE10 6F                   ld l,a
1543  AE11 7A                   ld a,d
1544  AE12 CE 00                adc a,0
1545  AE14 67                   ld h,a
1546  AE15 F1           .one:   pop af
1547  AE16 F0                   ret p
1548  AE17 AF                   xor a
1549  AE18 95                   sub l
1550  AE19 6F                   ld l,a
1551  AE1A 9F                   sbc a,a
1552  AE1B 94                   sub h
1553  AE1C 67                   ld h,a
1554  AE1D C9                   ret
1555  AE1E
1556  AE1E              ; HL = 0.5 * HL (signed): the top/bottom frustum slope, VIEW_CY/128
1557  AE1E              zhalf:
1558  AE1E CB 2C                sra h
1559  AE20 CB 1D                rr l
1560  AE22 C9                   ret

 173+ E783              ; IX = (HL << 16) / DE   with HL < DE (unsigned) -> 0.16 fraction
 174+ E783              ; Restoring division, unrolled: each quotient bit goes in inverted, as the
 175+ E783              ; carry (set: the divisor didn't fit), 8 into A, which is complemented:
 176+ E783              ; the high byte, then the low.  Keeps BC.
 177+ E783                  MACRO DIVBIT q
 178+ E783 ~                    add hl,hl
 179+ E783 ~                    jr c,$+9                        ; (17-bit remainder: it fits)
 180+ E783 ~                    sbc hl,de                       ; (carry clear)
 181+ E783 ~                    jr nc,$+9                       ; fits: bit 1 (carry clear)
 182+ E783 ~                    add hl,de                       ; doesn't: put it back (carry set)
 183+ E783 ~                    jr $+6
 184+ E783 ~                    or a                            ; (from the jr c)
 185+ E783 ~                    sbc hl,de
 186+ E783 ~                    or a                            ; bit 1
 187+ E783 ~                    q                               ; (all the jumps land here)
 188+ E783                  ENDM

 219+ E81C              ;==============================================================================
 220+ E81C              ; Perspective projection
 221+ E81C              ;   in : HL -> X,Y,Z (camera space, inside the view frustum, Z > 0)
 222+ E81C              ;   out: A = screen x (0..255), C = screen y (0..VIEW_H-1)
 223+ E81C              ;   sx = 128 + 128*X/Z,  sy = 64 - 128*Y/Z   (90 x 53 degree field of view)

 225+ E81C              ;   log2 table) that is also applied to X and Y, which are then multiplied

 457+ E976 DD 6E 04             ld l,(ix+4)
 458+ E979 DD 66 05             ld h,(ix+5)
 459+ E97C E5                   push hl                         ; Z
 460+ E97D DD 6E 00             ld l,(ix+0)
 461+ E980 DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
 462+ E983 CD E5 AD             call abs_hl
 463+ E986 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; |X|
 464+ E987 E1                   pop hl
 465+ E988 E5                   push hl
 466+ E989 29                   add hl,hl                       ; 2Z (carry: over 65535, so more)
 467+ E98A 38 04                jr c,.g1
 468+ E98C ED 52                sbc hl,de
 469+ E98E 38 45                jr c,.out
 470+ E990 DD 6E 02     .g1:    ld l,(ix+2)
 471+ E993 DD 66 03             ld h,(ix+3)
 472+ E996 CD E5 AD             call abs_hl
 473+ E999 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; |Y|
 474+ E99A E1                   pop hl
 475+ E99B E5                   push hl
 476+ E99C B7                   or a
 477+ E99D ED 52                sbc hl,de
 478+ E99F 38 34                jr c,.out
 479+ E9A1 E1                   pop hl
 480+ E9A2 7D                   ld a,l                          ; (zpatch tests HL = 0 with A = L)
 481+ E9A3 CD 6D E8             call zpatch
 482+ E9A6 DD 6E 00             ld l,(ix+0)
 483+ E9A9 DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
 484+ E9AC 11 80 00             ld de,128
 485+ E9AF 01 01 FF             ld bc,255<<8|1                  ; x: 0..255, c2_or bits 0, 1
 486+ E9B2 CD D8 E9             call c2_scr                     ; 128 + 128X/Z
 487+ E9B5 FD 75 00             ld (iy+0),l
 488+ E9B8 FD 74 01             ld (iy+1),h
 489+ E9BB DD 6E 02             ld l,(ix+2)
 490+ E9BE DD 66 03             ld h,(ix+3)
 491+ E9C1 CD DE AD             call neg_hl
 492+ E9C4 11 40 00             ld de,VIEW_CY
 493+ E9C7 01 04 7F             ld bc,(VIEW_H-1)<<8|4           ; y: 0..VIEW_H-1, c2_or bits 2, 3
 494+ E9CA CD D8 E9             call c2_scr                     ; VIEW_CY - 128Y/Z
 495+ E9CD FD 75 02             ld (iy+2),l
 496+ E9D0 FD 74 03             ld (iy+3),h
 497+ E9D3 B7                   or a
 498+ E9D4 C9                   ret
 499+ E9D5 E1           .out:   pop hl
 500+ E9D6 37                   scf
 501+ E9D7 C9                   ret
 502+ E9D8
 503+ E9D8              ; HL = component, DE = the screen centre, B = the upper bound, C = the lower
 504+ E9D8              ; plane's c2_or bit (the upper's is the next) -> HL = DE + 128 HL / Z (the
 505+ E9D8              ; Z patched in by zpatch), and the plane it is outside, if any, into c2_or
 506+ E9D8              c2_scr:
 507+ E9D8 C5                   push bc
 508+ E9D9 D5                   push de
 509+ E9DA 7C                   ld a,h
 510+ E9DB F5                   push af
 511+ E9DC CD FD E9             call scomp16
 512+ E9DF F1                   pop af
 513+ E9E0 17                   rla
 514+ E9E1 DC DE AD             call c,neg_hl
 515+ E9E4 D1                   pop de
 516+ E9E5 19                   add hl,de
 517+ E9E6 C1                   pop bc
 518+ E9E7 7C                   ld a,h
 519+ E9E8 B7                   or a
 520+ E9E9 28 05                jr z,.z
 521+ E9EB FA F5 E9             jp m,.lo                        ; < 0
 522+ E9EE 18 03                jr .hi                          ; > 255
 523+ E9F0 78           .z:     ld a,b
 524+ E9F1 BD                   cp l
 525+ E9F2 D0                   ret nc                          ; inside
 526+ E9F3 CB 21        .hi:    sla c
 527+ E9F5 3A DB E0     .lo:    ld a,(c2_or)
 528+ E9F8 B1                   or c
 529+ E9F9 32 DB E0             ld (c2_or),a
 530+ E9FC C9                   ret
 531+ E9FD
 532+ E9FD              ; HL = signed component -> HL = round(|HL| * 128 / Z), |HL| <= 2Z: as
 533+ E9FD              ; scale_comp (the same shift and reciprocal, patched into it by zpatch),
 534+ E9FD              ; with a 10-bit Xn and a 16-bit result
 535+ E9FD              scomp16:
 536+ E9FD CD E5 AD             call abs_hl
 537+ EA00 3A D1 EA             ld a,(scale_comp.sh+1)
 538+ EA03 B7                   or a
 539+ EA04 28 10                jr z,.sd
 540+ EA06 EB                   ex de,hl
 541+ EA07 FA 10 EA             jp m,.l
 542+ EA0A 47                   ld b,a
 543+ EA0B ED 2A                bsrl de,b
 544+ EA0D EB                   ex de,hl
 545+ EA0E 18 06                jr .sd
 546+ EA10 ED 44        .l:     neg
 547+ EA12 47                   ld b,a
 548+ EA13 ED 28                bsla de,b
 549+ EA15 EB                   ex de,hl
 550+ EA16 7C           .sd:    ld a,h
 551+ EA17 FE 04                cp 4
 552+ EA19 38 03                jr c,.ok
 553+ EA1B 21 FF 03             ld hl,1023                      ; (rounding at the guard band's edge)
 554+ EA1E 44           .ok:    ld b,h                          ; bits 8-9 of Xn
 555+ EA1F 3A ED EA             ld a,(scale_comp.rl+1)
 556+ EA22 5F                   ld e,a
 557+ EA23 55                   ld d,l
 558+ EA24 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rl
 559+ EA26 4A                   ld c,d
 560+ EA27 3A F3 EA             ld a,(scale_comp.rh+1)
 561+ EA2A 5F                   ld e,a
 562+ EA2B 55                   ld d,l
 563+ EA2C ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rh
 564+ EA2E 79                   ld a,c
 565+ EA2F 83                   add a,e
 566+ EA30 6F                   ld l,a
 567+ EA31 7A                   ld a,d
 568+ EA32 CE 00                adc a,0
 569+ EA34 67                   ld h,a                          ; HL = (Xl*R) >> 8
 570+ EA35 0E 00                ld c,0
 571+ EA37 78                   ld a,b
 572+ EA38 B7                   or a
 573+ EA39 28 0A                jr z,.nh
 574+ EA3B ED 5B 03 EB          ld de,(scale_comp.r16+1)
 575+ EA3F 19           .ad:    add hl,de                       ; + (256 * Xh * R) >> 8
 576+ EA40 30 01                jr nc,.a1
 577+ EA42 0C                   inc c
 578+ EA43 10 FA        .a1:    djnz .ad
 579+ EA45 24           .nh:    inc h                           ; + rounding (0.5 after >>9)
 580+ EA46 20 01                jr nz,.nr
 581+ EA48 0C                   inc c
 582+ EA49 6C           .nr:    ld l,h
 583+ EA4A 61                   ld h,c
 584+ EA4B CB 3C                srl h
 585+ EA4D CB 1D                rr l                            ; HL = (C:H) >> 1 = P >> 9
 586+ EA4F C9                   ret
 587+ EA50
 588+ EA50              ; clip_isect for a 2D plane: the point where the edge S-E crosses it, out
 589+ EA50              ; at IY (IY and clip_on advanced).  Worked out from the edge's inside end,
 590+ EA50              ; so an edge two faces share is cut at the same point whichever way it
 591+ EA50              ; runs: t = d_in / (|dS| + |dE|), the other coordinate o_in + t (o_out -
 592+ EA50              ; o_in), this one exactly on the bound.
 593+ EA50              c2_isect:
 594+ EA50 2A CE E0             ld hl,(clip_s)
 595+ EA53 ED 5B D0 E0          ld de,(clip_e)
 596+ EA57 3A D3 E0             ld a,(clip_ds+1)
 597+ EA5A 17                   rla
 598+ EA5B 30 01                jr nc,.sin
 599+ EA5D EB                   ex de,hl                        ; S outside: E is the inside end
 600+ EA5E 3A DC E0     .sin:   ld a,(c2_off)
 601+ EA61 EE 02                xor 2                           ; the other coordinate
 602+ EA63 ED 31                add hl,a
 603+ EA65 4E                   ld c,(hl)
 604+ EA66 23                   inc hl
 605+ EA67 46                   ld b,(hl)                       ; o_in
 606+ EA68 EB                   ex de,hl
 607+ EA69 ED 31                add hl,a
 608+ EA6B 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 609+ EA6C 23                   inc hl
 610+ EA6D 66                   ld h,(hl)
 611+ EA6E 6F                   ld l,a                          ; o_out
 612+ EA6F B7                   or a
 613+ EA70 ED 42                sbc hl,bc                       ; o_out - o_in
 614+ EA72 28 26                jr z,.same                      ; (a vertical / horizontal edge: o_in)
 615+ EA74 C5                   push bc
 616+ EA75 E5                   push hl
 617+ EA76 2A D2 E0             ld hl,(clip_ds)
 618+ EA79 CD E5 AD             call abs_hl
 619+ EA7C EB                   ex de,hl
 620+ EA7D 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 621+ EA80 CD E5 AD             call abs_hl
 622+ EA83 19                   add hl,de
 623+ EA84 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; |dS| + |dE|
 624+ EA85 2A D2 E0             ld hl,(clip_ds)
 625+ EA88 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 626+ EA8A 28 03                jr z,.di
 627+ EA8C 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 628+ EA8F CD 83 E7     .di:    call div_frac                   ; t = d_in / (|dS| + |dE|)
 629+ EA92 E1                   pop hl                          ; o_out - o_in
 630+ EA93 DD E5                push ix
 631+ EA95 D1                   pop de
 632+ EA96 CD 50 E7             call mul_frac
 633+ EA99 C1                   pop bc
 634+ EA9A 09           .same:  add hl,bc                       ; o_in + t (o_out - o_in)
 635+ EA9B 3A DC E0             ld a,(c2_off)
 636+ EA9E B7                   or a
 637+ EA9F 20 12                jr nz,.y
 638+ EAA1 FD 75 02             ld (iy+2),l                     ; an x plane: y worked out
 639+ EAA4 FD 74 03             ld (iy+3),h
 640+ EAA7 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 641+ EAAA FD 77 00             ld (iy+0),a
 642+ EAAD FD 36 01 00          ld (iy+1),0
 643+ EAB1 18 10                jr .f
 644+ EAB3 FD 75 00     .y:     ld (iy+0),l                     ; a y plane: x worked out
 645+ EAB6 FD 74 01             ld (iy+1),h
 646+ EAB9 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 647+ EABC FD 77 02             ld (iy+2),a
 648+ EABF FD 36 03 00          ld (iy+3),0
 649+ EAC3 C3 3F ED     .f:     jp clip_isect.nz                ; its edge flag, IY and clip_on on
 650+ EAC6                  ENDIF
 651+ EAC6
 652+ EAC6              ; HL = signed component -> A = round(|HL| * 128 / Z)
 653+ EAC6              ; The shift and reciprocal for this Z are patched in by project.
 654+ EAC6              scale_comp:
 655+ EAC6 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 656+ EAC8 28 06                jr z,.ap
 657+ EACA AF                   xor a
 658+ EACB 95                   sub l
 659+ EACC 6F                   ld l,a
 660+ EACD 9F                   sbc a,a
 661+ EACE 94                   sub h
 662+ EACF 67                   ld h,a
 663+ EAD0              .ap:
 664+ EAD0 3E 00        .sh:    ld a,0
 665+ EAD2 B7                   or a
 666+ EAD3 28 10                jr z,.sd
 667+ EAD5 EB                   ex de,hl
 668+ EAD6 FA DF EA             jp m,.l
 669+ EAD9 47                   ld b,a
 670+ EADA ED 2A                bsrl de,b
 671+ EADC EB                   ex de,hl
 672+ EADD 18 06                jr .sd
 673+ EADF ED 44        .l:     neg
 674+ EAE1 47                   ld b,a
 675+ EAE2 ED 28                bsla de,b
 676+ EAE4 EB                   ex de,hl
 677+ EAE5 7C           .sd:    ld a,h
 678+ EAE6 FE 02                cp 2
 679+ EAE8 30 27                jr nc,.big
 680+ EAEA 44           .ok:    ld b,h                          ; bit 8 of Xn
 681+ EAEB 55                   ld d,l
 682+ EAEC 1E 00        .rl:    ld e,0
 683+ EAEE ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rl
 684+ EAF0 4A                   ld c,d
 685+ EAF1 55                   ld d,l
 686+ EAF2 1E 00        .rh:    ld e,0
 687+ EAF4 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rh
 688+ EAF6 79                   ld a,c
 689+ EAF7 83                   add a,e
 690+ EAF8 6F                   ld l,a
 691+ EAF9 7A                   ld a,d
 692+ EAFA CE 00                adc a,0
 693+ EAFC 67                   ld h,a                          ; HL = (Xl*R) >> 8
 694+ EAFD 0E 00                ld c,0
 695+ EAFF 05                   dec b
 696+ EB00 20 06                jr nz,.nh
 697+ EB02 11 00 00     .r16:   ld de,0
 698+ EB05 19                   add hl,de                       ; + (256*R) >> 8
 699+ EB06 CB 11                rl c
 700+ EB08 24           .nh:    inc h                           ; + rounding (0.5 after >>9)
 701+ EB09 20 01                jr nz,.nr
 702+ EB0B 0C                   inc c
 703+ EB0C 79           .nr:    ld a,c
 704+ EB0D 1F                   rra
 705+ EB0E 7C                   ld a,h
 706+ EB0F 1F                   rra                             ; A = (C:H) >> 1  = P >> 9
 707+ EB10 C9                   ret
 708+ EB11 21 FF 01     .big:   ld hl,511                       ; clamp (rounding at frustum edge)
 709+ EB14 18 D4                jr .ok
 710+ EB16
 711+ EB16              ;==============================================================================
 712+ EB16              ; Outcode: HL -> vertex (X,Y,Z) -> A = bits
 713+ EB16              ;   1 near (Z<NEAR)  2 left (X<-Z)  4 right (X>Z)
 714+ EB16              ;   8 top (Y>0.5Z)   16 bottom (Y<-0.5Z)
 715+ EB16              ;==============================================================================
 716+ EB16              calc_oc:
 717+ EB16 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 718+ EB17 23                   inc hl
 719+ EB18 56                   ld d,(hl)                       ; DE = X
 720+ EB19 23                   inc hl
 721+ EB1A 4E                   ld c,(hl)
 722+ EB1B 23                   inc hl
 723+ EB1C 46                   ld b,(hl)                       ; BC = Y
 724+ EB1D 23                   inc hl
 725+ EB1E 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 726+ EB1F 23                   inc hl
 727+ EB20 66                   ld h,(hl)
 728+ EB21 6F                   ld l,a                          ; HL = Z
 729+ EB22 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 730+ EB24 20 0D                jr nz,.nr
 731+ EB26 7C                   ld a,h
 732+ EB27 B7                   or a
 733+ EB28 3E 00                ld a,0
 734+ EB2A 20 09                jr nz,.n1
 735+ EB2C 7D                   ld a,l
 736+ EB2D FE 10                cp NEAR
 737+ EB2F 3E 00                ld a,0
 738+ EB31 30 02                jr nc,.n1
 739+ EB33 3E 01        .nr:    ld a,1
 740+ EB35 E5           .n1:    push hl
 741+ EB36 19                   add hl,de                       ; Z+X

 743+ EB39 28 02                jr z,.n2
 744+ EB3B F6 02                or 2
 745+ EB3D E1           .n2:    pop hl
 746+ EB3E E5                   push hl
 747+ EB3F B7                   or a
 748+ EB40 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; Z-X
 749+ EB42 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 750+ EB44 28 02                jr z,.n3
 751+ EB46 F6 04                or 4
 752+ EB48 E1           .n3:    pop hl
 753+ EB49 CB 2C                sra h
 754+ EB4B CB 1D                rr l                            ; 0.5Z
 755+ EB4D E5                   push hl
 756+ EB4E B7                   or a
 757+ EB4F ED 42                sbc hl,bc                       ; 0.5Z-Y
 758+ EB51 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 759+ EB53 28 02                jr z,.n4
 760+ EB55 F6 08                or 8
 761+ EB57 E1           .n4:    pop hl
 762+ EB58 09                   add hl,bc                       ; 0.5Z+Y
 763+ EB59 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 764+ EB5B C8                   ret z
 765+ EB5C F6 10                or 16
 766+ EB5E C9                   ret
 767+ EB5F
 768+ EB5F                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 769+ EB5F              ; plane_dist for a 2D plane (clip2d): IX -> 2D vertex -> HL = its distance
 770+ EB5F              ; inside c2_off / c2_hi (>= 0: inside)
 771+ EB5F              c2_dist:
 772+ EB5F 3A DC E0             ld a,(c2_off)
 773+ EB62 DD E5                push ix
 774+ EB64 E1                   pop hl
 775+ EB65 ED 31                add hl,a

 777+ EB68 23                   inc hl
 778+ EB69 66                   ld h,(hl)
 779+ EB6A 6F                   ld l,a
 780+ EB6B 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 781+ EB6E B7                   or a

 784+ EB71 6F                   ld l,a
 785+ EB72 26 00                ld h,0
 786+ EB74 B7                   or a

 788+ EB77 C9                   ret
 789+ EB78                  ENDIF
 790+ EB78
 791+ EB78              ; Signed distance of vertex IX to clip plane (clip_plane bit). >= 0 is inside.
 792+ EB78              plane_dist:
 793+ EB78                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 794+ EB78 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 795+ EB7B 17                   rla
 796+ EB7C 38 E1                jr c,c2_dist                    ; (bit 7: a 2D plane)
 797+ EB7E                  ENDIF

 799+ EB81 DD 66 05             ld h,(ix+5)
 800+ EB84 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 801+ EB87 FE 01                cp 1
 802+ EB89 20 05                jr nz,.p2
 803+ EB8B 11 F0 FF             ld de,-NEAR

 805+ EB8F C9                   ret
 806+ EB90 DD 5E 00     .p2:    ld e,(ix+0)
 807+ EB93 DD 56 01             ld d,(ix+1)
 808+ EB96 FE 02                cp 2
 809+ EB98 20 02                jr nz,.p3
 810+ EB9A 19                   add hl,de
 811+ EB9B C9                   ret
 812+ EB9C FE 04        .p3:    cp 4
 813+ EB9E 20 04                jr nz,.p4
 814+ EBA0 B7                   or a
 815+ EBA1 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 816+ EBA3 C9                   ret
 817+ EBA4 F5           .p4:    push af

 819+ EBA8 F1                   pop af

 826+ EBB6 C9                   ret

 828+ EBB8 C9                   ret
 829+ EBB9
 830+ EBB9              ;==============================================================================
 831+ EBB9              ; Sutherland-Hodgman clip of clip_src (clip_n verts) against clip_plane into
 832+ EBB9              ; clip_dst.  Vertex = X,Y,Z,flag,corner (8 bytes).  flag=1 means the edge from
 833+ EBB9              ; this vertex to the next is a real building edge (gets outlined); edges
 834+ EBB9              ; created along a clip plane get flag=0 so the screen border isn't outlined.
 835+ EBB9              ; corner = vtx offset of an unclipped building corner that is on screen, so
 836+ EBB9              ; its cached projection can be reused; $80 + plane bit for a vertex the
 837+ EBB9              ; clipper put on that plane; $FF for any other vertex.
 838+ EBB9              ;==============================================================================
 839+ EBB9              clip_poly:
 840+ EBB9 3A C6 E0             ld a,(clip_n)
 841+ EBBC 3D                   dec a
 842+ EBBD 87                   add a,a
 843+ EBBE 87                   add a,a
 844+ EBBF 87                   add a,a
 845+ EBC0 2A CA E0             ld hl,(clip_src)
 846+ EBC3 ED 31                add hl,a
 847+ EBC5 22 CE E0             ld (clip_s),hl
 848+ EBC8 E5                   push hl
 849+ EBC9 DD E1                pop ix
 850+ EBCB CD 78 EB             call plane_dist
 851+ EBCE 22 D2 E0             ld (clip_ds),hl
 852+ EBD1 2A CA E0             ld hl,(clip_src)
 853+ EBD4 22 D0 E0             ld (clip_e),hl
 854+ EBD7 FD 2A CC E0          ld iy,(clip_dst)
 855+ EBDB AF                   xor a
 856+ EBDC 32 C7 E0             ld (clip_on),a
 857+ EBDF 3A C6 E0             ld a,(clip_n)
 858+ EBE2 32 C8 E0             ld (clip_cnt),a
 859+ EBE5 DD 2A D0 E0  .loop:  ld ix,(clip_e)
 860+ EBE9 CD 78 EB             call plane_dist
 861+ EBEC 22 D4 E0             ld (clip_de),hl
 862+ EBEF CB 7C                bit 7,h
 863+ EBF1 20 33                jr nz,.eout
 864+ EBF3 3A D3 E0             ld a,(clip_ds+1)
 865+ EBF6 CB 7F                bit 7,a
 866+ EBF8 28 0D                jr z,.ein
 867+ EBFA                      ; S out, E in: intersection carries S's edge flag
 868+ EBFA DD 2A CE E0          ld ix,(clip_s)
 869+ EBFE DD 7E 06             ld a,(ix+6)
 870+ EC01 32 D6 E0             ld (clip_if),a
 871+ EC04 CD 62 EC             call clip_isect
 872+ EC07 2A D0 E0     .ein:   ld hl,(clip_e)                  ; whole vertex, with its corner byte
 873+ EC0A FD E5                push iy                         ; (LDI: 16 T a byte)
 874+ EC0C D1                   pop de
 875+ EC0D                      REPT 8
 876+ EC0D ED A0       >        ldi
 876+ EC0F ED A0       >        ldi
 876+ EC11 ED A0       >        ldi
 876+ EC13 ED A0       >        ldi
 876+ EC15 ED A0       >        ldi
 876+ EC17 ED A0       >        ldi
 876+ EC19 ED A0       >        ldi
 876+ EC1B ED A0       >        ldi
 877+ EC1D                      ENDR
 878+ EC1D D5                   push de
 879+ EC1E FD E1                pop iy
 880+ EC20 21 C7 E0             ld hl,clip_on
 881+ EC23 34                   inc (hl)
 882+ EC24 18 0E                jr .next
 883+ EC26 3A D3 E0     .eout:  ld a,(clip_ds+1)
 884+ EC29 CB 7F                bit 7,a
 885+ EC2B 20 07                jr nz,.next
 886+ EC2D                      ; S in, E out: intersection starts a clip-plane edge
 887+ EC2D AF                   xor a
 888+ EC2E 32 D6 E0             ld (clip_if),a
 889+ EC31 CD 62 EC             call clip_isect
 890+ EC34 2A D0 E0     .next:  ld hl,(clip_e)
 891+ EC37 22 CE E0             ld (clip_s),hl
 892+ EC3A 11 08 00             ld de,8
 893+ EC3D 19                   add hl,de
 894+ EC3E 22 D0 E0             ld (clip_e),hl
 895+ EC41 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 896+ EC44 22 D2 E0             ld (clip_ds),hl
 897+ EC47 21 C8 E0             ld hl,clip_cnt
 898+ EC4A 35                   dec (hl)
 899+ EC4B 20 98                jr nz,.loop
 900+ EC4D 3A C7 E0             ld a,(clip_on)
 901+ EC50 32 C6 E0             ld (clip_n),a
 902+ EC53 2A CA E0             ld hl,(clip_src)                ; the output is the next pass's input
 903+ EC56 ED 5B CC E0          ld de,(clip_dst)
 904+ EC5A ED 53 CA E0          ld (clip_src),de
 905+ EC5E 22 CC E0             ld (clip_dst),hl
 906+ EC61 C9                   ret
 907+ EC62
 908+ EC62              ; Output S + t*(E-S) at IY, t = dS/(dS-dE)
 909+ EC62              clip_isect:
 910+ EC62                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 911+ EC62 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 912+ EC65 17                   rla
 913+ EC66 DA 50 EA             jp c,c2_isect                   ; (bit 7: a 2D plane)

1250+ EF31              ;==============================================================================
1251+ EF31              ; Convex polygon fill from p2buf (8-bit screen coords).
1252+ EF31              ;   Each edge is walked with an exact integer DDA into one of two x tables:
1253+ EF31              ;   downward edges -> TA, upward edges -> TB.  For a convex polygon every row
1254+ EF31              ;   then has one entry in each, and the span between them is filled.
1255+ EF31              ;   Winding doesn't matter.
1256+ EF31              ;==============================================================================

1292+ EF6F 38 0A                jr c,.down
1293+ EF71 7A                   ld a,d                          ; going up: swap ends, use TB
1294+ EF72 50                   ld d,b
1295+ EF73 47                   ld b,a
1296+ EF74 7B                   ld a,e
1297+ EF75 59                   ld e,c
1298+ EF76 4F                   ld c,a
1299+ EF77 3E E3                ld a,high TB
1300+ EF79 18 02                jr .walk
1301+ EF7B 3E E2        .down:  ld a,high TA
1302+ EF7D DD E5        .walk:  push ix
1303+ EF7F CD 9A EF             call walk_edge
1304+ EF82 DD E1                pop ix
1305+ EF84 01 04 00     .nx:    ld bc,4
1306+ EF87 DD 09                add ix,bc
1307+ EF89 21 EB E0             ld hl,fe_cnt
1308+ EF8C 35                   dec (hl)
1309+ EF8D 20 D0                jr nz,.ed
1310+ EF8F
1311+ EF8F 3A 27 FF             ld a,(face_col)                 ; shaded colour of this face
1312+ EF92 32 D5 FF             ld (l2_cls_byte),a              ; DMA source byte for long spans
1313+ EF95 57                   ld d,a
1314+ EF96 5F                   ld e,a                          ; PUSH pair for short spans
1315+ EF97 C3 28 F0             jp fill_spans
1316+ EF9A
1317+ EF9A              ; Walk an edge (D=xa, E=ya) -> (B=xb, C=yb), yb > ya, into table page A.
1318+ EF9A              ; Bresenham style: x += q each row, fractional r/dy accumulated in a biased
1319+ EF9A              ; byte (carry == wrap), so the end point is hit exactly.
1320+ EF9A              walk_edge:
1321+ EF9A 67                   ld h,a
1322+ EF9B 6B                   ld l,e
1323+ EF9C 79                   ld a,c
1324+ EF9D 93                   sub e
1325+ EF9E 4F                   ld c,a                          ; C = dy (1..191)
1326+ EF9F 78                   ld a,b
1327+ EFA0 92                   sub d                           ; dx
1328+ EFA1 28 72                jr z,.vert                      ; vertical (every wall in level flight)
1329+ EFA3 38 37                jr c,.neg
1330+ EFA5 B9                   cp c
1331+ EFA6 30 07                jr nc,.pdv
1332+ EFA8 DD 6F                ld ixl,a                        ; steep: q = 0, r = dx
1333+ EFAA CD 1C F0             call .setup
1334+ EFAD 18 20                jr .p0s
1335+ EFAF CD 0B E8     .pdv:   call div8                       ; E = q, A = r
1336+ EFB2 DD 63                ld ixh,e
1337+ EFB4 DD 6F                ld ixl,a
1338+ EFB6 CD 1C F0             call .setup
1339+ EFB9 DD 7C                ld a,ixh
1340+ EFBB B7                   or a
1341+ EFBC 28 11                jr z,.p0s
1342+ EFBE 72           .pl:    ld (hl),d
1343+ EFBF 2C                   inc l
1344+ EFC0 7A                   ld a,d
1345+ EFC1 DD 84                add a,ixh
1346+ EFC3 57                   ld d,a
1347+ EFC4 7B                   ld a,e
1348+ EFC5 DD 85                add a,ixl
1349+ EFC7 30 02                jr nc,.pl1
1350+ EFC9 81                   add a,c
1351+ EFCA 14                   inc d
1352+ EFCB 5F           .pl1:   ld e,a
1353+ EFCC 10 F0                djnz .pl
1354+ EFCE C9                   ret
1355+ EFCF              ; (no x step: the accumulator kept in A and the remainder in E, not IXL)
1356+ EFCF 7B           .p0s:   ld a,e
1357+ EFD0 DD 5D                ld e,ixl
1358+ EFD2 72           .p0:    ld (hl),d
1359+ EFD3 2C                   inc l
1360+ EFD4 83                   add a,e
1361+ EFD5 30 02                jr nc,.p01
1362+ EFD7 81                   add a,c
1363+ EFD8 14                   inc d
1364+ EFD9 10 F7        .p01:   djnz .p0
1365+ EFDB C9                   ret
1366+ EFDC
1367+ EFDC ED 44        .neg:   neg
1368+ EFDE B9                   cp c
1369+ EFDF 30 07                jr nc,.ndv
1370+ EFE1 DD 6F                ld ixl,a
1371+ EFE3 CD 1C F0             call .setup
1372+ EFE6 18 20                jr .n0s
1373+ EFE8 CD 0B E8     .ndv:   call div8
1374+ EFEB DD 63                ld ixh,e
1375+ EFED DD 6F                ld ixl,a
1376+ EFEF CD 1C F0             call .setup
1377+ EFF2 DD 7C                ld a,ixh
1378+ EFF4 B7                   or a
1379+ EFF5 28 11                jr z,.n0s
1380+ EFF7 72           .nl:    ld (hl),d
1381+ EFF8 2C                   inc l
1382+ EFF9 7A                   ld a,d
1383+ EFFA DD 94                sub ixh
1384+ EFFC 57                   ld d,a
1385+ EFFD 7B                   ld a,e
1386+ EFFE DD 85                add a,ixl
1387+ F000 30 02                jr nc,.nl1
1388+ F002 81                   add a,c
1389+ F003 15                   dec d
1390+ F004 5F           .nl1:   ld e,a
1391+ F005 10 F0                djnz .nl
1392+ F007 C9                   ret
1393+ F008 7B           .n0s:   ld a,e
1394+ F009 DD 5D                ld e,ixl
1395+ F00B 72           .n0:    ld (hl),d
1396+ F00C 2C                   inc l
1397+ F00D 83                   add a,e
1398+ F00E 30 02                jr nc,.n01
1399+ F010 81                   add a,c
1400+ F011 15                   dec d
1401+ F012 10 F7        .n01:   djnz .n0
1402+ F014 C9                   ret
1403+ F015
1404+ F015              ; A vertical edge: the same x on every row (as the steep walk gives it with
1405+ F015              ; no x step: exactly)
1406+ F015 41           .vert:  ld b,c
1407+ F016 04                   inc b                           ; dy+1 rows
1408+ F017 72           .vl:    ld (hl),d
1409+ F018 2C                   inc l
1410+ F019 10 FC                djnz .vl
1411+ F01B C9                   ret
1412+ F01C
1413+ F01C              ; B = dy+1 rows, E = biased accumulator (dy/2 - dy), C = -dy
1414+ F01C 41           .setup: ld b,c
1415+ F01D 04                   inc b
1416+ F01E 79                   ld a,c
1417+ F01F CB 3F                srl a
1418+ F021 91                   sub c
1419+ F022 5F                   ld e,a
1420+ F023 79                   ld a,c
1421+ F024 ED 44                neg
1422+ F026 4F                   ld c,a
1423+ F027 C9                   ret
1424+ F028
1425+ F028              ;==============================================================================
1426+ F028              ; Span filler.  Rows fy0..fy1, x from TA/TB.  DE = colour pair.
1427+ F028              ; Short spans use the stack pointer as a 2-byte write pointer into the frame
1428+ F028              ; buffer (see push_blk), jumping into an unrolled block of PUSH DE.  Spans of
1429+ F028              ; DMA_SPAN_MIN pixels or more are written by the zxnDMA, which only needs its
1430+ F028              ; length and destination reloaded (see clear_screen).
1431+ F028              ; For speed: the stack pointer is kept in IY (ld sp,iy), the rows are
1432+ F028              ; counted down in IXH, and the table that is the left edge at the polygon's
1433+ F028              ; middle row is read first, so the left / right swap (still made whenever
1434+ F028              ; it's needed: a sliver's edges can cross) is mostly skipped.
1435+ F028              ;==============================================================================
1436+ F028              fill_spans:
1437+ F028 3A E9 E0             ld a,(fy0)
1438+ F02B CD 20 E7             call seg_map                    ; first row's section into slot 0
1439+ F02E FD 21 00 00          ld iy,0
1440+ F032 FD 39                add iy,sp                       ; the stack, for push_end
1441+ F034 3A E9 E0             ld a,(fy0)
1442+ F037 47                   ld b,a
1443+ F038 3A EA E0             ld a,(fy1)
1444+ F03B 90                   sub b
1445+ F03C 3C                   inc a
1446+ F03D DD 67                ld ixh,a                        ; rows to fill
1447+ F03F 3A EA E0             ld a,(fy1)                      ; the middle row: which table is left?
1448+ F042 80                   add a,b
1449+ F043 1F                   rra
1450+ F044 6F                   ld l,a
1451+ F045 26 E2                ld h,high TA
1452+ F047 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1453+ F048 24                   inc h
1454+ F049 BE                   cp (hl)
1455+ F04A 3E E2                ld a,high TA                    ; TA left (or level): TA first
1456+ F04C 0E 24                ld c,$24                        ;   (inc h)
1457+ F04E 38 04                jr c,.ta
1458+ F050 3E E3                ld a,high TB                    ; TB left: TB first
1459+ F052 0E 25                ld c,$25                        ;   (dec h)
1460+ F054 32 5C F0     .ta:    ld (fs_loop+1),a
1461+ F057 79                   ld a,c
1462+ F058 32 5F F0             ld (fs_loop.tb),a
1463+ F05B
1464+ F05B              fs_loop:
1465+ F05B 26 E2                ld h,high TA                    ; (patched: the left table first)
1466+ F05D 68                   ld l,b
1467+ F05E 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1468+ F05F 24           .tb:    inc h                           ; (patched: inc h, or dec h, the other)
1469+ F060 4E                   ld c,(hl)
1470+ F061 B9                   cp c
1471+ F062 38 03                jr c,.ord
1472+ F064 69                   ld l,c
1473+ F065 4F                   ld c,a
1474+ F066 7D                   ld a,l
1475+ F067 6F           .ord:   ld l,a                          ; A = left x, C = right x
1476+ F068 78                   ld a,b
1477+ F069 E6 1F                and 31
1478+ F06B 67                   ld h,a                          ; row within the paged section
1479+ F06C 79                   ld a,c
1480+ F06D 95                   sub l                           ; width-1
1481+ F06E FE 13                cp DMA_SPAN_MIN-1
1482+ F070 30 17                jr nc,.dma
1483+ F072 CB 3F        .push:  srl a
1484+ F074 38 07                jr c,.even
1485+ F076 73                   ld (hl),e                       ; odd width: single pixel first
1486+ F077 B7                   or a
1487+ F078 CA 84 E1             jp z,push_next                  ; (1 pixel: no PUSHes, so SP isn't
1488+ F07B 18 01                jr .go                          ; borrowed: see push_blk)
1489+ F07D 3C           .even:  inc a
1490+ F07E 69           .go:    ld l,c
1491+ F07F 23                   inc hl                          ; one past right edge (may be $C000)
1492+ F080 F9                   ld sp,hl
1493+ F081 6F                   ld l,a
1494+ F082 3E 80                ld a,low push_end - 1           ; (the DI before the last PUSH)
1495+ F084 95                   sub l
1496+ F085 6F                   ld l,a
1497+ F086 26 E1                ld h,high push_end
1498+ F088 E9                   jp (hl)
1499+ F089                      ASSERT high push_blk == high push_end && low push_end - 1 - 128 == low push_blk
1500+ F089
1501+ F089                      ; Long span: zxnDMA from the fixed colour byte (port A) to HL.
1502+ F089                      ; Everything but length and destination was set up by clear_screen.
1503+ F089 3C           .dma:   inc a
1504+ F08A 20 03                jr nz,.dmal
1505+ F08C 3D                   dec a                           ; 256 wide: length needs the high
1506+ F08D 18 E3                jr .push                        ; byte, so PUSH it (A = width-1)
1507+ F08F              .dmal:
1508+ F08F 4F                   ld c,a
1509+ F090 3E 25                ld a,DMA_WR0_LEN_LO
1510+ F092 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1511+ F094 79                   ld a,c
1512+ F095 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; length = width
1513+ F097 3E AD                ld a,DMA_WR4_CONT_MODE
1514+ F099 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1515+ F09B 7D                   ld a,l
1516+ F09C D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; port B = y*256 + x
1517+ F09E 7C                   ld a,h
1518+ F09F D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1519+ F0A1 3E CF                ld a,DMA_LOAD
1520+ F0A3 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1521+ F0A5 3E 87                ld a,DMA_ENABLE
1522+ F0A7 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; CPU waits until the span is written
1523+ F0A9 04                   inc b                           ; the next row (as push_next: SP was
1524+ F0AA DD 25                dec ixh                         ; never borrowed here)
1525+ F0AC C8                   ret z
1526+ F0AD 78                   ld a,b
1527+ F0AE E6 1F                and 31
1528+ F0B0 C2 5B F0             jp nz,fs_loop
1529+ F0B3 C3 8E E1             jp push_next.sect
1530+ F0B6                      ASSERT high TB == high TA + 1
1531+ F0B6
1532+ F0B6              ;==============================================================================
1533+ F0B6              ; Outline the polygon in p2buf, skipping edges flagged 0 (clip edges)
1534+ F0B6              ;==============================================================================
1535+ F0B6              outline_poly:
1536+ F0B6 DD 21 80 E0          ld ix,p2buf
1537+ F0BA 3A E8 E0             ld a,(p2n)
1538+ F0BD 47                   ld b,a
1539+ F0BE C5           .lp:    push bc
1540+ F0BF DD 7E 02             ld a,(ix+2)
1541+ F0C2 B7                   or a
1542+ F0C3 28 0F                jr z,.sk
1543+ F0C5 DD 6E 00             ld l,(ix+0)
1544+ F0C8 DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
1545+ F0CB DD 5E 04             ld e,(ix+4)
1546+ F0CE DD 56 05             ld d,(ix+5)
1547+ F0D1 CD DD F0             call draw_line
1548+ F0D4 01 04 00     .sk:    ld bc,4
1549+ F0D7 DD 09                add ix,bc
1550+ F0D9 C1                   pop bc
1551+ F0DA 10 E2                djnz .lp
1552+ F0DC C9                   ret
1553+ F0DD
1554+ F0DD              ;==============================================================================
1555+ F0DD              ; Bresenham line, on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
1556+ F0DD              ;   L = x0, H = y0, E = x1, D = y1, colour in line_col.  Preserves IX, IY.
1557+ F0DD              ;   Pages Layer 2 sections into slot 0 as the line crosses them.
1558+ F0DD              ;==============================================================================
1559+ F0DD              draw_line:
1560+ F0DD 3A EC E0             ld a,(line_col)
1561+ F0E0 4F                   ld c,a
1562+ F0E1 7B                   ld a,e
1563+ F0E2 95                   sub l
1564+ F0E3 30 06                jr nc,.xp
1565+ F0E5 ED 44                neg
1566+ F0E7 06 2D                ld b,OP_DEC_L
1567+ F0E9 18 02                jr .xd
1568+ F0EB 06 2C        .xp:    ld b,OP_INC_L
1569+ F0ED 5F           .xd:    ld e,a                          ; |dx|
1570+ F0EE 78                   ld a,b
1571+ F0EF 32 17 F1             ld (.smx1),a
1572+ F0F2 32 34 F1             ld (.smx2),a
1573+ F0F5 7A                   ld a,d
1574+ F0F6 94                   sub h
1575+ F0F7 30 06                jr nc,.yp
1576+ F0F9 ED 44                neg
1577+ F0FB 06 25                ld b,OP_DEC_H
1578+ F0FD 18 02                jr .yd
1579+ F0FF 06 24        .yp:    ld b,OP_INC_H
1580+ F101 57           .yd:    ld d,a                          ; |dy|
1581+ F102 78                   ld a,b
1582+ F103 32 1B F1             ld (.smy1),a
1583+ F106 32 2B F1             ld (.smy2),a
1584+ F109 7C                   ld a,h
1585+ F10A CD 20 E7             call seg_map                    ; page in the start row's section
1586+ F10D 67                   ld h,a                          ; y within the section
1587+ F10E 7B                   ld a,e
1588+ F10F BA                   cp d
1589+ F110 38 13                jr c,.ymaj
1590+ F112 43                   ld b,e
1591+ F113 04                   inc b
1592+ F114 CB 3F                srl a
1593+ F116 71           .xl:    ld (hl),c
1594+ F117 2C           .smx1:  inc l
1595+ F118 92                   sub d
1596+ F119 30 07                jr nc,.xs
1597+ F11B 24           .smy1:  inc h
1598+ F11C CB 6C                bit 5,h                         ; left the 32-row section?
1599+ F11E C4 37 E7             call nz,line_seg
1600+ F121 83                   add a,e
1601+ F122 10 F2        .xs:    djnz .xl
1602+ F124 C9                   ret
1603+ F125 42           .ymaj:  ld b,d
1604+ F126 04                   inc b
1605+ F127 7A                   ld a,d
1606+ F128 CB 3F                srl a
1607+ F12A 71           .yl:    ld (hl),c
1608+ F12B 24           .smy2:  inc h
1609+ F12C CB 6C                bit 5,h
1610+ F12E C4 37 E7             call nz,line_seg
1611+ F131 93                   sub e
1612+ F132 30 02                jr nc,.ys
1613+ F134 2C           .smx2:  inc l
1614+ F135 82                   add a,d
1615+ F136 10 F2        .ys:    djnz .yl
1616+ F138 C9                   ret
1617+ F139
1618+ F139              ;==============================================================================
1619+ F139              ; Clear the viewport (rows 0..VIEW_H-1) of the back buffer with the zxnDMA,
1620+ F139              ; one 8K section (32 rows) at a time through slot 0: sky above the horizon
1621+ F139              ; row, ground below.  The fills reuse the l2_fill command block from
1622+ F139              ; layer2_cls.asm, patching its destination (port B) and length; the source
1623+ F139              ; (port A) is the fixed byte l2_cls_byte.  Zero-length fills are skipped.
1624+ F139              ;==============================================================================
1625+ F139              clear_screen:
1626+ F139 0E 00                ld c,0                          ; C = first row of the section
1627+ F13B 79           .sec:   ld a,c
1628+ F13C CD 20 E7             call seg_map
1629+ F13F 3A 58 B4             ld a,(horizon)                  ; sky rows here = clamp(hz - C, 0, 32)
1630+ F142                  IFDEF SKY_IS_WALL
1631+ F142 3C                   inc a                           ; the horizon row too: at the horizon
1632+ F143                                                      ; it is all distant wall, and it hides
1633+ F143                                                      ; a 1-row rounding gap under the
1634+ F143                                                      ; wall's top edge when pitched
1635+ F143                  ENDIF
1636+ F143 91                   sub c
1637+ F144 30 01                jr nc,.s1
1638+ F146 AF                   xor a
1639+ F147 FE 21        .s1:    cp 33
1640+ F149 38 02                jr c,.s2
1641+ F14B 3E 20                ld a,32
1642+ F14D 32 EE E0     .s2:    ld (cs_sky),a
1643+ F150 B7                   or a
1644+ F151 28 0D                jr z,.gnd
1645+ F153 C5                   push bc

1647+ F155 0E 00                ld c,0
1648+ F157 21 00 00             ld hl,0
1649+ F15A                  IFDEF SKY_IS_WALL
1650+ F15A 3E 01                ld a,WALL_FAMILY*4+SHADE_FACE   ; "sky" is the perimeter wall
1651+ F15C                  ELSE
1652+ F15C ~                    ld a,SKY_COL
1653+ F15C                  ENDIF
1654+ F15C CD 88 F1             call dma_fill
1655+ F15F C1                   pop bc
1656+ F160 3A EE E0     .gnd:   ld a,(cs_sky)
1657+ F163 FE 20                cp 32
1658+ F165 28 11                jr z,.nx
1659+ F167 C5                   push bc
1660+ F168 67                   ld h,a                          ; ground: after the sky rows
1661+ F169 2E 00                ld l,0
1662+ F16B ED 44                neg
1663+ F16D C6 20                add a,32
1664+ F16F 47                   ld b,a
1665+ F170 0E 00                ld c,0
1666+ F172 3E 07                ld a,GROUND_COL
1667+ F174 CD 88 F1             call dma_fill
1668+ F177 C1                   pop bc
1669+ F178 79           .nx:    ld a,c
1670+ F179 C6 20                add a,32
1671+ F17B 4F                   ld c,a
1672+ F17C FE 80                cp VIEW_H
1673+ F17E 20 BB                jr nz,.sec
1674+ F180                      ; Leave the DMA ready for fill_spans: length high byte 0, so each span
1675+ F180                      ; only reloads length low, destination, LOAD and ENABLE.  fill_poly
1676+ F180                      ; puts each building's colour in the source byte l2_cls_byte.
1677+ F180 3E 45        .spans: ld a,DMA_WR0_LEN_HI
1678+ F182 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1679+ F184 AF                   xor a
1680+ F185 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1681+ F187 C9                   ret
1682+ F188
1683+ F188              ; DMA fill: HL = destination, BC = length (non-zero), A = colour
1684+ F188              dma_fill:
1685+ F188 32 D5 FF             ld (l2_cls_byte),a
1686+ F18B 22 E2 FF             ld (l2_fill_bstrt),hl
1687+ F18E ED 43 DD FF          ld (l2_fill_length),bc
1688+ F192 21 D6 FF             ld hl,l2_fill
1689+ F195 06 12                ld b,l2_fill_cmd_len
1690+ F197 0E 6B                ld c,IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT
1691+ F199 ED B3                otir                            ; CPU waits while the DMA runs
1692+ F19B C9                   ret
1693+ F19C
1694+ F19C              ;==============================================================================
1695+ F19C              ; City traversal - back to front without sorting.
1696+ F19C              ;   For grid-aligned boxes in separate cells, a box can only hide boxes whose
1697+ F19C              ;   cell offsets from the camera cell are larger (or equal) on both axes in
1698+ F19C              ;   the same quadrant.  So: rows from the far edges inwards, and within each
1699+ F19C              ;   row columns from the far edges inwards, the camera row/column last.
1700+ F19C              ;==============================================================================
1701+ F19C              draw_city:
1702+ F19C                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
1703+ F19C CD CC FA             call occ_begin
1704+ F19F 3A 41 FF             ld a,(occ_on)
1705+ F1A2 B7                   or a
1706+ F1A3 28 0E                jr z,draw_cells                 ; pitched: the painter's order as is
1707+ F1A5 CD 02 FB             call occ_cells                  ; front to back: keep what isn't hidden
1708+ F1A8 3A 42 FF             ld a,(occ_full)
1709+ F1AB B7                   or a
1710+ F1AC CA BE FE             jp z,occ_draw_list              ; back to front: draw it
1711+ F1AF AF                   xor a                           ; too many to keep: draw this frame
1712+ F1B0 32 41 FF             ld (occ_on),a                   ; the plain way
1713+ F1B3                  ENDIF
1714+ F1B3              draw_cells:
1715+ F1B3 3A 7E B4             ld a,(cz)
1716+ F1B6 21 3E AE             ld hl,view_r
1717+ F1B9 96                   sub (hl)
1718+ F1BA 32 22 FF             ld (cell_j),a
1719+ F1BD 3A 22 FF     .b:     ld a,(cell_j)
1720+ F1C0 21 7E B4             ld hl,cz
1721+ F1C3 BE                   cp (hl)
1722+ F1C4 28 09                jr z,.f
1723+ F1C6 CD EB F1             call draw_row
1724+ F1C9 21 22 FF             ld hl,cell_j
1725+ F1CC 34                   inc (hl)
1726+ F1CD 18 EE                jr .b
1727+ F1CF 3A 7E B4     .f:     ld a,(cz)
1728+ F1D2 21 3E AE             ld hl,view_r
1729+ F1D5 86                   add a,(hl)
1730+ F1D6 32 22 FF             ld (cell_j),a
1731+ F1D9 3A 22 FF     .f2:    ld a,(cell_j)
1732+ F1DC 21 7E B4             ld hl,cz
1733+ F1DF BE                   cp (hl)
1734+ F1E0 28 09                jr z,draw_row                   ; camera row last
1735+ F1E2 CD EB F1             call draw_row
1736+ F1E5 21 22 FF             ld hl,cell_j
1737+ F1E8 35                   dec (hl)
1738+ F1E9 18 EE                jr .f2
1739+ F1EB
1740+ F1EB              draw_row:
1741+ F1EB 3A 22 FF             ld a,(cell_j)
1742+ F1EE FE 40                cp GRID

2801+ FACC
2802+ FACC                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
2803+ FACC              ;==============================================================================
2804+ FACC              ; Occlusion culling (OCCLUSION_CULL, level flight only)
2805+ FACC              ;
2806+ FACC              ; In level flight every screen column is a vertical slice of the world through
2807+ FACC              ; the camera.  The cells are walked in exactly the reverse of the painter's
2808+ FACC              ; order, i.e. front to back.  Each building is transformed as usual, then
2809+ FACC              ; tested against OCC_YBUF, which holds per column the row from which the
2810+ FACC              ; screen is known to be covered down to the ground:
2811+ FACC              ;   * hidden - in every column it spans, its highest point is no higher than
2812+ FACC              ;     that row - it is dropped;
2813+ FACC              ;   * otherwise it lowers the row across its columns to its lowest top
2814+ FACC              ;     corner, and its corners and face settings are kept in a record.
2815+ FACC              ; The kept buildings and the zombie cells are then drawn back to front.
2816+ FACC              ; This is safe because buildings that share a column meet the walk front to
2817+ FACC              ; back (the grid order guarantees it), the camera is above the ground (what
2818+ FACC              ; is behind sits higher on screen), the cover row is the lowest top corner
2819+ FACC              ; (an underestimate) and bounds are clamped inwards to the screen.  A
2820+ FACC              ; building with a corner behind the camera is never dropped and never covers.
2821+ FACC              ;==============================================================================
2822+ FACC              OCC_YBUF        equ $4000       ; per column: covered from this row down
2823+ FACC              OCC_YBUF8       equ $42E0       ; per 8 columns: at least the most of
2824+ FACC                                              ; OCC_YBUF's 8 (in record 0's unused tail:
2825+ FACC                                              ; records use 0-133), so a hidden test can
2826+ FACC                                              ; pass 8 columns at once
2827+ FACC                      ASSERT low OCC_YBUF8 + 32 <= 256 && OR_VIS + 6 <= low OCC_YBUF8
2828+ FACC              OCC_LIST        equ $4100       ; kept buildings and zombie cells, 2 bytes each
2829+ FACC              OCC_REC0        equ $42         ; first record (high byte); 256 bytes each,
2830+ FACC              OCC_RECN        equ $60         ; up to $5F: 30 records ($6000 on: city_col)
2831+ FACC              ; Record: copy of vtx (bytes 0-8 of each 16), then
2832+ FACC              OR_VIS          equ 128         ; bld_vis, bld_mx, bld_mz, col_x, col_z, col_top
2833+ FACC              ; A list entry is a record's high byte (< $60), a cell with humans as its
2834+ FACC              ; city_col address ($6000-$6FFF) or a cell with zombies as its city_map
2835+ FACC              ; address ($7000-$7FFF).
2836+ FACC
2837+ FACC              ; Start of the city: occlusion on only in level flight
2838+ FACC              occ_begin:
2839+ FACC AF                   xor a
2840+ FACD 32 41 FF             ld (occ_on),a
2841+ FAD0 32 42 FF             ld (occ_full),a
2842+ FAD3 3A 2E AE             ld a,(pitch)
2843+ FAD6 B7                   or a
2844+ FAD7 C0                   ret nz
2845+ FAD8 3C                   inc a
2846+ FAD9 32 41 FF             ld (occ_on),a
2847+ FADC 21 00 41             ld hl,OCC_LIST
2848+ FADF 22 43 FF             ld (occ_lp),hl
2849+ FAE2 3E 42                ld a,OCC_REC0
2850+ FAE4 32 45 FF             ld (occ_rec),a
2851+ FAE7 21 00 40             ld hl,OCC_YBUF                  ; nothing covered yet
2852+ FAEA 36 80                ld (hl),VIEW_H
2853+ FAEC 11 01 40             ld de,OCC_YBUF+1
2854+ FAEF 01 FF 00             ld bc,255
2855+ FAF2 ED B0                ldir
2856+ FAF4 21 E0 42             ld hl,OCC_YBUF8                 ; (and so in every group of 8)
2857+ FAF7 36 80                ld (hl),VIEW_H
2858+ FAF9 11 E1 42             ld de,OCC_YBUF8+1
2859+ FAFC 01 1F 00             ld bc,31
2860+ FAFF ED B0                ldir
2861+ FB01 C9                   ret
2862+ FB02
2863+ FB02              ; The cells of draw_cells in exactly the reverse order.  Each half row
2864+ FB02              ; starts from the same cell as draw_row and steps the same way, so every
2865+ FB02              ; cell gets bit-identical yaw-space coordinates.
2866+ FB02              occ_cells:

2889+ FB30
2890+ FB30              occ_row:
2891+ FB30 3A 22 FF             ld a,(cell_j)
2892+ FB33 FE 40                cp GRID

2894+ FB36                      ; right half, as draw_row: start at cx+R, step down to cx
2895+ FB36 3A 7D B4             ld a,(cx)

2903+ FB4A 10 FB                djnz .d
2904+ FB4C 3A 7D B4             ld a,(cx)
2905+ FB4F 32 21 FF             ld (cell_i),a
2906+ FB52 CD 8C F2             call try_cell                   ; camera column first
2907+ FB55 3A 3E AE             ld a,(view_r)
2908+ FB58 47                   ld b,a
2909+ FB59 C5           .r:     push bc

2911+ FB5D 34                   inc (hl)
2912+ FB5E CD 9C FB             call occ_stepp

2914+ FB64 C1                   pop bc
2915+ FB65 10 F2                djnz .r
2916+ FB67                      ; left half, as draw_row: start at cx-R, step up to cx-1
2917+ FB67 3A 7D B4             ld a,(cx)

2919+ FB6D 96                   sub (hl)
2920+ FB6E 32 21 FF             ld (cell_i),a
2921+ FB71 CD 5F F2             call row_start
2922+ FB74 3A 3E AE             ld a,(view_r)
2923+ FB77 3D                   dec a
2924+ FB78 47                   ld b,a
2925+ FB79 CD 9C FB     .u:     call occ_stepp
2926+ FB7C 10 FB                djnz .u
2927+ FB7E 3A 7D B4             ld a,(cx)
2928+ FB81 3D                   dec a
2929+ FB82 32 21 FF             ld (cell_i),a
2930+ FB85 CD 8C F2             call try_cell                   ; then cx-1 .. cx-R
2931+ FB88 3A 3E AE             ld a,(view_r)
2932+ FB8B 3D                   dec a
2933+ FB8C 47                   ld b,a
2934+ FB8D C5           .l:     push bc
2935+ FB8E 21 21 FF             ld hl,cell_i
2936+ FB91 35                   dec (hl)
2937+ FB92 CD B3 FB             call occ_stepm

2939+ FB98 C1                   pop bc
2940+ FB99 10 F2                djnz .l
2941+ FB9B C9                   ret
2942+ FB9C
2943+ FB9C              ; One cell +x / -x in yaw space: (X, Z1) +/-= (cosY, sinY).  Keeps B.
2944+ FB9C              occ_stepp:

2946+ FB9F ED 5B 5B B4          ld de,(cos_y)
