   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - input: keyboard and joysticks (8K page PAGE_INPUT, runs at
   3+ E000              ; $E000 in slot 7: main_loop and the menu page it in, and the game logic
   4+ E000              ; pages in slot 6 call it)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; Redefinable controls.  An input (a key, or a joystick direction or button)
   7+ E000              ; is a 16-bit code: high byte = input bank, low byte = bit mask within it.
   8+ E000              ;   banks 0-7: the ZX Spectrum keyboard half-rows (port $xxFE, address line
   9+ E000              ;              A8+bank low): read 0 = pressed
  10+ E000              ;   bank 8:    NextReg $B0, Extended Keys 0: read 1 = pressed
  11+ E000              ;   bank 9:    NextReg $B1, Extended Keys 1: read 1 = pressed
  12+ E000              ;   bank 10:   port $1F, Kempston 1 / Mega Drive 1 (J1_*): read 1 = pressed
  13+ E000              ;   bank 11:   port $37, Kempston 2 / Mega Drive 2 (J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  14+ E000              ;   bank 12:   NextReg $B2, the 6-button Mega Drive pads' X, Y, Z and MODE
  15+ E000              ;              (left connector J1_*, right J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  16+ E000              ; A joystick bank is read only while a joystick is set (NextReg $05, the
  17+ E000              ; Next's joystick modes) to the port it reads, else it is 0: so an unused
  18+ E000              ; port can't read as everything pressed.  Joysticks in Sinclair or Cursor
  19+ E000              ; mode enter keys (6-0, 1-5, 5-8) and are read as keys.
  20+ E000              ; kbd_scan, once per frame at the top of the main loop, reads all the banks
  21+ E000              ; into key_now, inverting the ZX rows so that every bank holds 1 = pressed,
  22+ E000              ; and keeps the previous scan in key_prev.  The game asks about actions
  23+ E000              ; (K_FIRE, K_LEFT, ...), not inputs: each action has a key (key_defs) and a
  24+ E000              ; joystick input (joy_defs; 0 = none), either of which works, so both can
  25+ E000              ; be redefined (key_define) at any time.
  26+ E000              ;   key_held    A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input is down
  27+ E000              ;   key_pressed A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input went down
  28+ E000              ;               since the last scan
  29+ E000              ;   key_find    -> NZ and HL = code of an input that is down (for a
  30+ E000              ;               redefine screen); Z if none
  31+ E000              ;   key_code_pressed  HL = key code -> NZ if that key went down
  32+ E000              ; The Next normally also enters the extended keys into the 8x5 matrix (e.g.
  33+ E000              ; cursor LEFT as CAPS SHIFT + 5).  NextReg $68 bit 4 stops that: set it with
  34+ E000              ; kbd_double_on (KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = TRUE), clear it with kbd_double_off
  35+ E000              ; (FALSE, the default).
  36+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  37+ E000
  38+ E000              ; --- key codes: bank << 8 | mask ---------------------------------------------
  39+ E000              KB_SHIFT    equ $0001                   ; bank 0: $FEFE
  40+ E000              KB_Z        equ $0002
  41+ E000              KB_X        equ $0004
  42+ E000              KB_C        equ $0008
  43+ E000              KB_V        equ $0010
  44+ E000              KB_A        equ $0101                   ; bank 1: $FDFE
  45+ E000              KB_S        equ $0102
  46+ E000              KB_D        equ $0104
  47+ E000              KB_F        equ $0108
  48+ E000              KB_G        equ $0110
  49+ E000              KB_Q        equ $0201                   ; bank 2: $FBFE
  50+ E000              KB_W        equ $0202
  51+ E000              KB_E        equ $0204
  52+ E000              KB_R        equ $0208
  53+ E000              KB_T        equ $0210
  54+ E000              KB_1        equ $0301                   ; bank 3: $F7FE
  55+ E000              KB_2        equ $0302
  56+ E000              KB_3        equ $0304
  57+ E000              KB_4        equ $0308
  58+ E000              KB_5        equ $0310
  59+ E000              KB_0        equ $0401                   ; bank 4: $EFFE
  60+ E000              KB_9        equ $0402
  61+ E000              KB_8        equ $0404
  62+ E000              KB_7        equ $0408
  63+ E000              KB_6        equ $0410
  64+ E000              KB_P        equ $0501                   ; bank 5: $DFFE
  65+ E000              KB_O        equ $0502
  66+ E000              KB_I        equ $0504
  67+ E000              KB_U        equ $0508
  68+ E000              KB_Y        equ $0510
  69+ E000              KB_ENTER    equ $0601                   ; bank 6: $BFFE
  70+ E000              KB_L        equ $0602
  71+ E000              KB_K        equ $0604
  72+ E000              KB_J        equ $0608
  73+ E000              KB_H        equ $0610
  74+ E000              KB_SPACE    equ $0701                   ; bank 7: $7FFE
  75+ E000              KB_SYM      equ $0702
  76+ E000              KB_M        equ $0704
  77+ E000              KB_N        equ $0708
  78+ E000              KB_B        equ $0710
  79+ E000              KB_RIGHT    equ $0801                   ; bank 8: NextReg $B0
  80+ E000              KB_LEFT     equ $0802
  81+ E000              KB_DOWN     equ $0804
  82+ E000              KB_UP       equ $0808
  83+ E000              KB_PERIOD   equ $0810
  84+ E000              KB_COMMA    equ $0820
  85+ E000              KB_QUOTE    equ $0840
  86+ E000              KB_SEMI     equ $0880
  87+ E000              KB_EXTEND   equ $0901                   ; bank 9: NextReg $B1
  88+ E000              KB_CAPSLOCK equ $0902
  89+ E000              KB_GRAPH    equ $0904
  90+ E000              KB_TRUEVID  equ $0908
  91+ E000              KB_INVVID   equ $0910
  92+ E000              KB_BREAK    equ $0920
  93+ E000              KB_EDIT     equ $0940
  94+ E000              KB_DELETE   equ $0980
  95+ E000              JOY_BANK    equ 10                      ; the first joystick bank
  96+ E000              J1_RIGHT    equ $0A01                   ; bank 10: port $1F (Kempston 1 /
  97+ E000              J1_LEFT     equ $0A02                   ;   Mega Drive 1)
  98+ E000              J1_DOWN     equ $0A04
  99+ E000              J1_UP       equ $0A08
 100+ E000              J1_FIRE     equ $0A10                   ; (Mega Drive: B)
 101+ E000              J1_C        equ $0A20                   ; Mega Drive C, A, START
 102+ E000              J1_A        equ $0A40
 103+ E000              J1_START    equ $0A80
 104+ E000              J2_RIGHT    equ $0B01                   ; bank 11: port $37 (Kempston 2 /
 105+ E000              J2_LEFT     equ $0B02                   ;   Mega Drive 2)
 106+ E000              J2_DOWN     equ $0B04
 107+ E000              J2_UP       equ $0B08
 108+ E000              J2_FIRE     equ $0B10
 109+ E000              J2_C        equ $0B20
 110+ E000              J2_A        equ $0B40
 111+ E000              J2_START    equ $0B80
 112+ E000              J1_MODE     equ $0C01                   ; bank 12: NextReg $B2, 6-button
 113+ E000              J1_Y        equ $0C02                   ;   pads (left connector)
 114+ E000              J1_Z        equ $0C04
 115+ E000              J1_X        equ $0C08
 116+ E000              J2_MODE     equ $0C10                   ;   (right connector)
 117+ E000              J2_Y        equ $0C20
 118+ E000              J2_Z        equ $0C40
 119+ E000              J2_X        equ $0C80
 120+ E000              KEY_BANKS   equ 13
 121+ E000              JP_1F_B     equ 0                       ; joystick ports in use (joy_ports):
 122+ E000              JP_37_B     equ 1                       ;   $1F, $37, the 6-button extras
 123+ E000              JP_MD_B     equ 2
 124+ E000              FALSE       equ 0
 125+ E000              TRUE        equ 1
 126+ E000
 127+ E000              ; --- actions: index into key_defs --------------------------------------------
 128+ E000              K_SPEED_UP  equ 0
 129+ E000              K_SPEED_DN  equ 1
 130+ E000              K_AIRBRAKE  equ 2                       ; air brake: rapid stop
 131+ E000              K_LEFT      equ 3
 132+ E000              K_RIGHT     equ 4
 133+ E000              K_CLIMB     equ 5
 134+ E000              K_DESCEND   equ 6
 135+ E000              K_NOSE_UP   equ 7
 136+ E000              K_NOSE_DN   equ 8
 137+ E000              K_FIRE      equ 9
 138+ E000              K_GUN_UP    equ 10                      ; tilt the centre gun up,
 139+ E000              K_SLOT1     equ 11                      ; select weapon slots 1-5
 140+ E000              K_GUN_DN    equ 16                      ; down,
 141+ E000              K_GUN_CTR   equ 17                      ; and back to the centre
 142+ E000              K_PAUSE     equ 18                      ; pause / resume (main_loop)
 143+ E000              K_BOOST     equ 19                      ; the booster on / off (player.asm)
 144+ E000              K_ACTIONS   equ 20
 145+ E000
 146+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 147+ E000              ; Read all the input banks: key_prev = last scan, key_now = this one, every
 148+ E000              ; bit 1 = pressed
 149+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 150+ E000              kbd_scan:
 151+ E000 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 152+ E003 11 63 E1             ld de,key_prev
 153+ E006 01 0D 00             ld bc,KEY_BANKS
 154+ E009 ED B0                ldir
 155+ E00B 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 156+ E00E 01 FE FE             ld bc,$FEFE                     ; banks 0-7: half-rows $FE..$7F
 157+ E011 ED 78        .row:   in a,(c)
 158+ E013 2F                   cpl                             ; 0 = pressed -> 1 = pressed
 159+ E014 E6 1F                and %00011111
 160+ E016 77                   ld (hl),a
 161+ E017 23                   inc hl
 162+ E018 CB 00                rlc b                           ; next half-row
 163+ E01A 38 F5                jr c,.row                       ; (stops after $7F)
 164+ E01C 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B                     ; banks 8, 9: NextRegs $B0, $B1
 165+ E01F 3E B0                ld a,$B0
 166+ E021 ED 79                out (c),a
 167+ E023 04                   inc b
 168+ E024 ED 78                in a,(c)                        ; already 1 = pressed
 169+ E026 77                   ld (hl),a
 170+ E027 23                   inc hl
 171+ E028 05                   dec b
 172+ E029 3E B1                ld a,$B1
 173+ E02B ED 79                out (c),a
 174+ E02D 04                   inc b
 175+ E02E ED 78                in a,(c)
 176+ E030 77                   ld (hl),a
 177+ E031 23                   inc hl
 178+ E032                      ; banks 10-12, the joysticks: only the ports a joystick is set to
 179+ E032                      ; (NextReg $05), so an unused port can't read as all pressed
 180+ E032 05                   dec b                           ; (BC = $243B)
 181+ E033 3E 05                ld a,$05
 182+ E035 ED 79                out (c),a
 183+ E037 04                   inc b
 184+ E038 ED 58                in e,(c)                        ; the joystick modes
 185+ E03A 7B                   ld a,e                          ; joystick 1: bits 7-6, and bit 3
 186+ E03B 07                   rlca
 187+ E03C 07                   rlca
 188+ E03D E6 03                and 3
 189+ E03F CB 5B                bit 3,e
 190+ E041 28 02                jr z,.j1
 191+ E043 F6 04                or 4
 192+ E045 CD 84 E0     .j1:    call joy_ports
 193+ E048 57                   ld d,a                          ; D: the ports in use (JP_*)
 194+ E049 7B                   ld a,e                          ; joystick 2: bits 5-4, and bit 1
 195+ E04A 0F                   rrca
 196+ E04B 0F                   rrca
 197+ E04C 0F                   rrca
 198+ E04D 0F                   rrca
 199+ E04E E6 03                and 3
 200+ E050 CB 4B                bit 1,e
 201+ E052 28 02                jr z,.j2
 202+ E054 F6 04                or 4
 203+ E056 CD 84 E0     .j2:    call joy_ports
 204+ E059 B2                   or d
 205+ E05A 57                   ld d,a
 206+ E05B AF                   xor a                           ; bank 10: port $1F
 207+ E05C CB 42                bit JP_1F_B,d
 208+ E05E 28 05                jr z,.p1
 209+ E060 DB 1F                in a,($1F)
 210+ E062 CD 95 E0             call joy_sane
 211+ E065 77           .p1:    ld (hl),a
 212+ E066 23                   inc hl
 213+ E067 AF                   xor a                           ; bank 11: port $37
 214+ E068 CB 4A                bit JP_37_B,d
 215+ E06A 28 05                jr z,.p2
 216+ E06C DB 37                in a,($37)
 217+ E06E CD 95 E0             call joy_sane
 218+ E071 77           .p2:    ld (hl),a
 219+ E072 23                   inc hl
 220+ E073 AF                   xor a                           ; bank 12: NextReg $B2, the 6-button
 221+ E074 CB 52                bit JP_MD_B,d                   ; pads' extra buttons
 222+ E076 28 0A                jr z,.p3
 223+ E078 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 224+ E07B 3E B2                ld a,$B2
 225+ E07D ED 79                out (c),a
 226+ E07F 04                   inc b
 227+ E080 ED 78                in a,(c)
 228+ E082 77           .p3:    ld (hl),a
 229+ E083 C9                   ret
 230+ E084                      ASSERT KEY_BANKS == 13 && JOY_BANK == 10
 231+ E084
 232+ E084              ; A = a joystick mode (NextReg $05: 0 Sinclair 2, 1 Kempston 1, 2 Cursor,
 233+ E084              ; 3 Sinclair 1, 4 Kempston 2, 5 Mega Drive 1, 6 Mega Drive 2, 7 I/O) -> A =
 234+ E084              ; the ports it is read through (JP_* bits).  Keeps DE, HL.
 235+ E084              joy_ports:
 236+ E084 E5                   push hl
 237+ E085 21 8D E0             ld hl,joy_mode_ports
 238+ E088 ED 31                add hl,a
 239+ E08A 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 240+ E08B E1                   pop hl
 241+ E08C C9                   ret
 242+ E08D
 243+ E08D              joy_mode_ports:
 244+ E08D 00 01 00 00          db 0, 1<<JP_1F_B, 0, 0, 1<<JP_37_B
 244+ E091 02
 245+ E092 05 06 00             db 1<<JP_1F_B | 1<<JP_MD_B, 1<<JP_37_B | 1<<JP_MD_B, 0
 246+ E095
 247+ E095              ; A = a Kempston / Mega Drive port read -> A, or 0 if it reads left and
 248+ E095              ; right at once (no stick can: nothing there).  Uses C.
 249+ E095              joy_sane:
 250+ E095 4F                   ld c,a
 251+ E096 E6 03                and %00000011
 252+ E098 FE 03                cp %00000011
 253+ E09A 79                   ld a,c
 254+ E09B C0                   ret nz
 255+ E09C AF                   xor a
 256+ E09D C9                   ret
 257+ E09E
 258+ E09E              ; Stop the extended keys also appearing in the 8x5 matrix:
 259+ E09E              ; KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = TRUE, NextReg $68 bit 4 = 1
 260+ E09E              kbd_double_on:
 261+ E09E 3E 01                ld a,TRUE
 262+ E0A0 18 01                jr kbd_double
 263+ E0A2
 264+ E0A2              ; Let the extended keys also appear in the 8x5 matrix (the default):
 265+ E0A2              ; KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = FALSE, NextReg $68 bit 4 = 0
 266+ E0A2              kbd_double_off:
 267+ E0A2              kdb_double_off:                         ; (alias: the name as first asked for)
 268+ E0A2 AF                   xor a                           ; FALSE
 269+ E0A3
 270+ E0A3              ; A = TRUE / FALSE: store it, and set NextReg $68 bit 4 to match, keeping
 271+ E0A3              ; the register's other bits
 272+ E0A3              kbd_double:
 273+ E0A3 32 55 E1             ld (KBD_STOP_DOUBLING),a
 274+ E0A6 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 275+ E0A9 3E 68                ld a,$68
 276+ E0AB ED 79                out (c),a
 277+ E0AD 04                   inc b
 278+ E0AE ED 78                in a,(c)                        ; current NextReg $68
 279+ E0B0 CB A7                res 4,a
 280+ E0B2 21 55 E1             ld hl,KBD_STOP_DOUBLING
 281+ E0B5 CB 46                bit 0,(hl)
 282+ E0B7 28 02                jr z,.w
 283+ E0B9 CB E7                set 4,a
 284+ E0BB ED 79        .w:     out (c),a                       ; ($253B: still selects $68)
 285+ E0BD C9                   ret
 286+ E0BE
 287+ E0BE              ; A = action -> NZ if its key or its joystick input is down.  Preserves BC,
 288+ E0BE              ; DE, HL.
 289+ E0BE              key_held:
 290+ E0BE E5                   push hl
 291+ E0BF C5                   push bc
 292+ E0C0 4F                   ld c,a
 293+ E0C1 CD 09 E1             call key_def
 294+ E0C4 A6                   and (hl)
 295+ E0C5 20 05                jr nz,.x
 296+ E0C7 79                   ld a,c
 297+ E0C8 CD 1A E1             call joy_def
 298+ E0CB A6                   and (hl)
 299+ E0CC C1           .x:     pop bc
 300+ E0CD E1                   pop hl
 301+ E0CE C9                   ret
 302+ E0CF
 303+ E0CF              ; A = action -> NZ if its key or its joystick input is down now but wasn't
 304+ E0CF              ; at the last scan.  Preserves BC, DE, HL.
 305+ E0CF              key_pressed:
 306+ E0CF E5                   push hl
 307+ E0D0 C5                   push bc
 308+ E0D1 47                   ld b,a
 309+ E0D2 CD 09 E1             call key_def
 310+ E0D5 CD E4 E0             call def_new
 311+ E0D8 20 07                jr nz,.x
 312+ E0DA 78                   ld a,b
 313+ E0DB CD 1A E1             call joy_def
 314+ E0DE CD E4 E0             call def_new
 315+ E0E1 C1           .x:     pop bc
 316+ E0E2 E1                   pop hl
 317+ E0E3 C9                   ret
 318+ E0E4
 319+ E0E4              ; HL -> key_now[bank], A = mask -> NZ if down now but not at the last scan
 320+ E0E4              ; (a mask of 0, no input: never).  Uses C.
 321+ E0E4              def_new:
 322+ E0E4 4F                   ld c,a
 323+ E0E5 A6                   and (hl)
 324+ E0E6 C8                   ret z                           ; not down
 325+ E0E7 79                   ld a,c
 326+ E0E8 D5                   push de
 327+ E0E9 11 0D 00             ld de,KEY_BANKS
 328+ E0EC 19                   add hl,de                       ; key_prev, same bank
 329+ E0ED A6                   and (hl)
 330+ E0EE D1                   pop de
 331+ E0EF A9                   xor c                           ; down before: Z; new: NZ
 332+ E0F0 C9                   ret
 333+ E0F1
 334+ E0F1              ; HL = a key code (KB_...) -> NZ if that key went down since the last scan
 335+ E0F1              ; (for fixed keys, such as the menu's).  Preserves BC, DE, HL.
 336+ E0F1              key_code_pressed:
 337+ E0F1 E5                   push hl
 338+ E0F2 C5                   push bc
 339+ E0F3 4D                   ld c,l                          ; mask
 340+ E0F4 7C                   ld a,h                          ; bank
 341+ E0F5 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 342+ E0F8 ED 31                add hl,a
 343+ E0FA 79                   ld a,c
 344+ E0FB A6                   and (hl)
 345+ E0FC 28 08                jr z,.x                         ; not down
 346+ E0FE D5                   push de
 347+ E0FF 11 0D 00             ld de,KEY_BANKS
 348+ E102 19                   add hl,de                       ; key_prev, same bank
 349+ E103 A6                   and (hl)
 350+ E104 D1                   pop de
 351+ E105 A9                   xor c                           ; down before: Z; new: NZ
 352+ E106 C1           .x:     pop bc
 353+ E107 E1                   pop hl
 354+ E108 C9                   ret
 355+ E109
 356+ E109              ; A = action -> HL -> key_now[its key's bank], A = its key's mask
 357+ E109              key_def:
 358+ E109 21 70 E1             ld hl,key_defs
 359+ E10C                      ; fall through
 360+ E10C
 361+ E10C              ; HL = key_defs or joy_defs, A = action -> HL -> key_now[the bank], A = mask
 362+ E10C              def_at:
 363+ E10C 87                   add a,a
 364+ E10D ED 31                add hl,a
 365+ E10F 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; mask
 366+ E110 23                   inc hl
 367+ E111 F5                   push af
 368+ E112 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; bank
 369+ E113 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 370+ E116 ED 31                add hl,a
 371+ E118 F1                   pop af
 372+ E119 C9                   ret
 373+ E11A
 374+ E11A              ; A = action -> HL -> key_now[its joystick input's bank], A = its mask (0:
 375+ E11A              ; none)
 376+ E11A              joy_def:
 377+ E11A 21 98 E1             ld hl,joy_defs
 378+ E11D 18 ED                jr def_at
 379+ E11F
 380+ E11F              ; A = action, HL = an input's code: redefine the action's key, or its
 381+ E11F              ; joystick input if the code is a joystick's (bank JOY_BANK on).  Uses B.
 382+ E11F              key_define:
 383+ E11F EB                   ex de,hl
 384+ E120 87                   add a,a
 385+ E121 21 70 E1             ld hl,key_defs
 386+ E124 47                   ld b,a
 387+ E125 7A                   ld a,d
 388+ E126 FE 0A                cp JOY_BANK
 389+ E128 78                   ld a,b
 390+ E129 38 03                jr c,.k
 391+ E12B 21 98 E1             ld hl,joy_defs
 392+ E12E ED 31        .k:     add hl,a
 393+ E130 73                   ld (hl),e
 394+ E131 23                   inc hl
 395+ E132 72                   ld (hl),d
 396+ E133 EB                   ex de,hl
 397+ E134 C9                   ret
 398+ E135
 399+ E135              ; -> NZ and HL = code of an input that is down (lowest bank, lowest bit); Z
 400+ E135              ; if none.  For a redefine screen.
 401+ E135              key_find:
 402+ E135 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 403+ E138 0E 00                ld c,0                          ; bank
 404+ E13A 7E           .b:     ld a,(hl)
 405+ E13B B7                   or a
 406+ E13C 20 09                jr nz,.got
 407+ E13E 23                   inc hl
 408+ E13F 0C                   inc c
 409+ E140 79                   ld a,c
 410+ E141 FE 0D                cp KEY_BANKS
 411+ E143 20 F5                jr nz,.b
 412+ E145 AF                   xor a                           ; Z: nothing down
 413+ E146 C9                   ret
 414+ E147 06 01        .got:   ld b,1                          ; lowest bit set
 415+ E149 1F           .m:     rra
 416+ E14A 38 04                jr c,.f
 417+ E14C CB 20                sla b
 418+ E14E 18 F9                jr .m
 419+ E150 61           .f:     ld h,c
 420+ E151 68                   ld l,b
 421+ E152 F6 01                or 1                            ; NZ
 422+ E154 C9                   ret
 423+ E155
 424+ E155              ;==============================================================================
 425+ E155              ; Input data
 426+ E155              ;==============================================================================
 427+ E155              KBD_STOP_DOUBLING:
 428+ E155 00                       db FALSE                    ; TRUE: NextReg $68 bit 4 set, extended
 429+ E156                                                      ; keys kept out of the 8x5 matrix
 430+ E156 00 00 00...  key_now:    ds KEY_BANKS                ; this scan, 1 = pressed
 431+ E163 00 00 00...  key_prev:   ds KEY_BANKS                ; the scan before (must follow key_now)
 432+ E170              ; The key and the joystick input of each action, by K_*: the defaults
 433+ E170              ; (key_defaults, joy_defaults), and the ones in use (key_defs, joy_defs:
 434+ E170              ; redefinable on the redefine keys screen, keydef.asm, which can put the
 435+ E170              ; defaults back).  Each set in that order: key_defs, joy_defs, key_defaults,
 436+ E170              ; joy_defaults, one after another (keydef.asm copies all four as one).
 437+ E170                  MACRO KEY_DEFAULTS
 438+ E170 ~                        dw KB_Q                     ; K_SPEED_UP
 439+ E170 ~                        dw KB_A                     ; K_SPEED_DN
 440+ E170 ~                        dw KB_Z                     ; K_AIRBRAKE
 441+ E170 ~                        dw KB_O                     ; K_LEFT
 442+ E170 ~                        dw KB_P                     ; K_RIGHT
 443+ E170 ~                        dw KB_W                     ; K_CLIMB
 444+ E170 ~                        dw KB_S                     ; K_DESCEND
 445+ E170 ~                        dw KB_E                     ; K_NOSE_UP
 446+ E170 ~                        dw KB_D                     ; K_NOSE_DN
 447+ E170 ~                        dw KB_SPACE                 ; K_FIRE
 448+ E170 ~                        dw KB_R                     ; K_GUN_UP
 449+ E170 ~                        dw KB_1, KB_2, KB_3, KB_4, KB_5     ; K_SLOT1..5
 450+ E170 ~                        dw KB_F                     ; K_GUN_DN
 451+ E170 ~                        dw KB_V                     ; K_GUN_CTR
 452+ E170 ~                        dw KB_BREAK                 ; K_PAUSE
 453+ E170 ~                        dw KB_X                     ; K_BOOST
 454+ E170                  ENDM
 455+ E170              ; The joystick defaults: the stick flies (left / right turn, up / down climb
 456+ E170              ; and descend), FIRE (Mega Drive B) fires; a Mega Drive pad's C / A are
 457+ E170              ; speed up / down, START pauses, and a 6-button pad's X is the air brake,
 458+ E170              ; Y / Z nose up / down, MODE the boost.  0: none.
 459+ E170                  MACRO JOY_DEFAULTS
 460+ E170 ~                        dw J1_C                     ; K_SPEED_UP
 461+ E170 ~                        dw J1_A                     ; K_SPEED_DN
 462+ E170 ~                        dw J1_X                     ; K_AIRBRAKE
 463+ E170 ~                        dw J1_LEFT                  ; K_LEFT
 464+ E170 ~                        dw J1_RIGHT                 ; K_RIGHT
 465+ E170 ~                        dw J1_UP                    ; K_CLIMB
 466+ E170 ~                        dw J1_DOWN                  ; K_DESCEND
 467+ E170 ~                        dw J1_Y                     ; K_NOSE_UP
 468+ E170 ~                        dw J1_Z                     ; K_NOSE_DN
 469+ E170 ~                        dw J1_FIRE                  ; K_FIRE
 470+ E170 ~                        dw 0                        ; K_GUN_UP

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - hardware sprites, Layer 3 (8K page PAGE_SPRITES, runs at $E000
   3+ E000              ; in slot 7: page it in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; The Next has 128 hardware sprites, each 16x16 pixels from a pattern in the
   6+ E000              ; sprite pattern memory (16K, separate from the Z80's: 64 8-bit patterns of
   7+ E000              ; 256 bytes, one byte per pixel, row by row).  A pattern byte is an index
   8+ E000              ; into the sprite palette; SPR_TRANS ($E3, NextReg $4B) is transparent.  The
   9+ E000              ; sprite palette starts as the identity, so until spr_palette changes it a
  10+ E000              ; pattern byte is simply its RRRGGGBB colour.
  11+ E000              ;
  12+ E000              ; Sprites are drawn above Layer 2 and the ULA (priority S U L) and, with
  13+ E000              ; NextReg $15 bit 1 set, over the border as well, so the sprite screen is
  14+ E000              ; 320 x 256 pixels:
  15+ E000              ;
  16+ E000              ;     x 0..319, y 0..255;  (SPR_SCREEN_X, SPR_SCREEN_Y) = (32, 32) is the top
  17+ E000              ;     left of the 256x192 Layer 2 / ULA screen, (288, 224) its bottom right
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; A sprite's position is its top left pixel.  Coordinates are 9 bits and
  20+ E000              ; wrap round at 512, so they may be negative (two's complement): a sprite at
  21+ E000              ; x = -8 shows its right half at the left edge.  With overlapping sprites,
  22+ E000              ; the higher numbered one is drawn on top.
  23+ E000              ;
  24+ E000              ; Use: sprites_init once (start-up), load patterns with spr_patterns or
  25+ E000              ; from a sprite bank (sprite_data.asm: page the bank into slot 7 and call
  26+ E000              ; its spr_load_bank, from outside slot 7), and a palette with spr_palette
  27+ E000              ; if wanted, then set up sprites in the shadow
  28+ E000              ; table with spr_set / spr_pos / spr_pattern / spr_flags / spr_scale /
  29+ E000              ; spr_hide / spr_show / spr_hide_all, and copy the table to the hardware
  30+ E000              ; once a frame with spr_update.  The table holds the first SPR_COUNT sprites;
  31+ E000              ; the rest stay hidden.
  32+ E000              ;
  33+ E000              ; Attributes, SPR_ATTR (5) bytes a sprite, kept in the table as they are
  34+ E000              ; sent (the 5-byte form):
  35+ E000              ;   +0  x bits 0-7
  36+ E000              ;   +1  y bits 0-7
  37+ E000              ;   +2  bits 7-4 palette offset (added to the pattern byte's top nibble),
  38+ E000              ;       bit 3 x mirror, 2 y mirror, 1 rotate 90 degrees clockwise, 0 x bit 8
  39+ E000              ;   +3  bit 7 visible, bit 6 = 1 (byte +4 follows), bits 5-0 pattern
  40+ E000              ;   +4  bits 4-3 x scale, bits 2-1 y scale (0..3 = x1, x2, x4, x8), 0 y bit 8
  41+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  42+ E000
  43+ E000              SPR_COUNT       equ 32          ; sprites in the shadow table (max 128)
  44+ E000              SPR_HW          equ 128         ; hardware sprites
  45+ E000              SPR_ATTR        equ 5           ; attribute bytes per sprite
  46+ E000              SPR_PATTERNS    equ 64          ; 8-bit 16x16 patterns in pattern memory
  47+ E000              SPR_SIZE        equ 16          ; pixels, each way (at scale x1)
  48+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_X    equ 32          ; sprite coordinates of the 256x192
  49+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_Y    equ 32          ; screen's top left pixel
  50+ E000              SPR_TRANS       equ $E3         ; transparent pattern byte (NextReg $4B)
  51+ E000
  52+ E000              SPRF_PAL        equ $10         ; flags (attribute +2): palette offset x 16,
  53+ E000              SPRF_XMIRROR    equ $08         ; mirror left-right,
  54+ E000              SPRF_YMIRROR    equ $04         ; mirror top-bottom,
  55+ E000              SPRF_ROT        equ $02         ; rotate 90 degrees clockwise
  56+ E000
  57+ E000              SPR_SLOT_PORT   equ $303B       ; write: select sprite / pattern slot
  58+ E000              SPR_ATTR_PORT   equ $57         ; write: attributes, from the selected sprite
  59+ E000              SPR_PAT_PORT    equ $5B         ; write: pattern bytes, from the selected slot
  60+ E000
  61+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  62+ E000              ; Start-up: sprites on, shown over the border too (the full 320 x 256),
  63+ E000              ; priority S U L; the transparent index; every hardware sprite hidden and the shadow table cleared (all hidden,
  64+ E000              ; pattern 0, at 0,0).
  65+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  66+ E000              sprites_init:
  67+ E000 ED 91 15 0B          nextreg $15,%00001011           ; priority S U L, sprites over the
  68+ E004                                                      ; border (bit 1), visible (bit 0)
  69+ E004 ED 91 4B E3          nextreg $4B,SPR_TRANS
  70+ E008 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT             ; from sprite 0, the 4-byte form
  71+ E00B AF                   xor a                           ; (+3 bit 6 clear): all hidden
  72+ E00C ED 79                out (c),a
  73+ E00E 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
  74+ E010 11 00 02             ld de,SPR_HW*4
  75+ E013 ED 79        .hw:    out (c),a
  76+ E015 1B                   dec de
  77+ E016 7A                   ld a,d
  78+ E017 B3                   or e
  79+ E018 3E 00                ld a,0
  80+ E01A 20 F7                jr nz,.hw
  81+ E01C 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
  82+ E01F 06 20                ld b,SPR_COUNT
  83+ E021 77           .sh:    ld (hl),a                       ; x, y, flags 0
  84+ E022 23                   inc hl
  85+ E023 77                   ld (hl),a
  86+ E024 23                   inc hl
  87+ E025 77                   ld (hl),a
  88+ E026 23                   inc hl
  89+ E027 36 40                ld (hl),$40                     ; hidden, 5-byte form, pattern 0
  90+ E029 23                   inc hl
  91+ E02A 77                   ld (hl),a                       ; scale x1
  92+ E02B 23                   inc hl
  93+ E02C 10 F3                djnz .sh
  94+ E02E                      ; fall through: send it
  95+ E02E
  96+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  97+ E02E              ; Copy the shadow table to sprites 0..SPR_COUNT-1.  Once a frame, after the
  98+ E02E              ; changes (best just after the frame flip, so a move doesn't show half done).
  99+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 100+ E02E              spr_update:
 101+ E02E 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
 102+ E031 AF                   xor a
 103+ E032 ED 79                out (c),a                       ; from sprite 0
 104+ E034 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
 105+ E037 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
 106+ E039 16 20                ld d,SPR_COUNT
 107+ E03B 06 05        .lp:    ld b,SPR_ATTR
 108+ E03D ED B3                otir
 109+ E03F 15                   dec d
 110+ E040 20 F9                jr nz,.lp
 111+ E042 C9                   ret
 112+ E043

 115+ E043              ; pattern A (0..63).  HL ends past them.

 142+ E062              ; Sprite A (0..SPR_COUNT-1) in the shadow table.  BC = x, DE = y (sprite
 143+ E062              ; screen, signed 9 bits), H = pattern (0..63), L = flags (SPRF_*).  Shows it.

   1+ E2A0              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E2A0              ; Z-POLICE - HUD sprites (in the sprites page, PAGE_SPRITES, at $E000 in slot
   3+ E2A0              ; 7): the human status column and the compass bar, as hardware sprites on
   4+ E2A0              ; the 320 x 256 sprite screen.  hud_sprites sets both and sends the sprite
   5+ E2A0              ; table to the hardware; main_loop calls it once a frame, after the flip.
   6+ E2A0              ;
   7+ E2A0              ; Sprites used: 0..HUMAN_MAX-1 the humans, CSPR_SPR0.. the compass bar's
   8+ E2A0              ; marks, CSPR_PTR_SPR its pointer.
   9+ E2A0              ;==============================================================================

  11+ E2A0              hud_sprites:

  13+ E2A3 CD A9 E2             call compass_spr
  14+ E2A6 C3 2E E0             jp spr_update
  15+ E2A9
  16+ E2A9              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  17+ E2A9              ; The compass bar, across the top of the screen in the top border (sprite
  18+ E2A9              ; row COMP_SPR_Y): a tape of marks every 16 yaw units (22.5 degrees), at 2
  19+ E2A9              ; pixels a yaw unit, centred on the heading at sprite x COMP_SPR_CX, across
  20+ E2A9              ; the full 320-pixel width of the sprite screen: 225 degrees (+-COMP_HALF,
  21+ E2A9              ; 80 yaw units).  Marks at the very edges are half off the screen (their x
  22+ E2A9              ; wraps, as sprite x does).  The letters N,
  23+ E2A9              ; E, S, W (red) at 0, 64, 128, 192; a yellow dot at the 45 degree points;
  24+ E2A9              ; a small white dot between.  A white pointer under the bar's middle marks
  25+ E2A9              ; the heading.  Turning right (yaw up) moves the marks left.
  26+ E2A9              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  27+ E2A9              CSPR_SPR0       equ HUMAN_MAX       ; first compass mark sprite (20)
  28+ E2A9              COMP_HALF       equ 80              ; yaw units shown either side: 160 px
  29+ E2A9              CSPR_MARKS      equ 2*COMP_HALF/16+1    ; most marks in view at once (11)
  30+ E2A9              CSPR_PTR_SPR    equ CSPR_SPR0+CSPR_MARKS   ; the pointer's sprite

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - start-up initialisation (8K page PAGE_INIT, runs at $E000 in
   3+ E000              ; slot 7)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Code needed only once, at start-up, kept out of the resident page: start
   6+ E000              ; (zpolice.asm) pages this in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INIT and calls
   7+ E000              ; initgame, then slot 7 is free for the other core pages.
   8+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   9+ E000
  10+ E000              ; Hardware set-up: 28MHz, Layer 2 mode, transparency, layer priority, Layer
  11+ E000              ; 2 scroll and clip window, the memory map of the always-mapped slots, the
  12+ E000              ; peripheral settings (AY sound, turbo sound, internal speaker, no
  13+ E000              ; contention), and a black border.
  14+ E000              initgame:

  16+ E004 ED 91 70 00          nextreg $70,0                   ; Layer 2 256x192 mode
  17+ E008 ED 91 14 E3          nextreg $14,$E3                 ; global transparency colour
  18+ E00C ED 91 15 08          nextreg $15,%00001000           ; priority S U L (ULA over L2); sprites
  19+ E010                                                      ; off until sprites_init

  32+ E03C                      ; back, so the bits not named here keep their values (in $06, bit 4
  33+ E03C                      ; is the divMMC automap, which the file handler's RST $08 needs).

# file opened: file_handler.asm
   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - file handling: loading and saving on the SD card (8K page
   3+ E000              ; PAGE_FILE, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in with nextreg
   4+ E000              ; CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE before calling)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; General-purpose routines over the esxDOS / NextZXOS file API (RST $08 with
   7+ E000              ; a function code after it).  Game-specific loading and saving (save games,
   8+ E000              ; high scores, settings) go on top of these.
   9+ E000              ;
  10+ E000              ; The ROM: the divMMC only traps RST $08 while the ROM is paged in at
  11+ E000              ; $0000-$3FFF, but the game keeps other pages there (slot 0: a Layer 2
  12+ E000              ; section or the sine table; slot 1: the zombie page).  So every call pages
  13+ E000              ; the ROM into slots 0 and 1 (fh_rom_in), makes the RST $08, then puts the
  14+ E000              ; game's pages back (fh_rom_out).  Interrupts are off over the call (the
  15+ E000              ; game's IM 2 routine is in slot 1, covered by the ROM, and IY is in use and
  16+ E000              ; slot 2 holds game data, so the ROM's routine must not run either), and
  17+ E000              ; fh_rom_out turns them back on if they were on.
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; Rules for callers:
  20+ E000              ;   * page this in at $E000 (slot 7) first, and call from outside slot 7:
  21+ E000              ;     resident code or a game logic page in slot 6;
  22+ E000              ;   * file names and data buffers must be in $4000-$DFFF: not in slots 0-1
  23+ E000              ;     (the ROM and esxDOS are there during a call) nor slot 7 (this page);
  24+ E000              ;   * file names end with a 0 byte.
  25+ E000              ;
  26+ E000              ; Every routine returns carry clear on success; carry set on failure with
  27+ E000              ; A = the esxDOS error code.  A file that was opened is closed again on
  28+ E000              ; any error in fh_load / fh_save.
  29+ E000              ;
  30+ E000              ; Routines:
  31+ E000              ;   fh_init      get the default drive (call once, before the others)
  32+ E000              ;   fh_open      HL = name, B = mode (FA_*)      -> A = handle
  33+ E000              ;   fh_close     A = handle
  34+ E000              ;   fh_read      A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes read
  35+ E000              ;   fh_write     A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes written
  36+ E000              ;   fh_seek      A = handle, BCDE = offset, L = SEEK_* -> BCDE = position
  37+ E000              ;   fh_size      A = handle                      -> BCDE = file size
  38+ E000              ;   fh_load      HL = name, DE = address, BC = most bytes -> BC = bytes read
  39+ E000              ;   fh_save      HL = name, DE = address, BC = length (created / replaced)
  40+ E000              ;   fh_exists    HL = name -> carry clear if the file exists
  41+ E000              ;   fh_delete    HL = name
  42+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  43+ E000
  44+ E000              ; esxDOS function codes (the byte after RST $08)
  45+ E000              M_GETSETDRV     equ $89             ; A = 0: get the default drive
  46+ E000              F_OPEN          equ $9A
  47+ E000              F_CLOSE         equ $9B
  48+ E000              F_READ          equ $9D
  49+ E000              F_WRITE         equ $9E
  50+ E000              F_SEEK          equ $9F
  51+ E000              F_FSTAT         equ $A1
  52+ E000              F_UNLINK        equ $AD
  53+ E000
  54+ E000              ; F_OPEN modes (B)
  55+ E000              FA_READ         equ $01             ; read
  56+ E000              FA_WRITE        equ $02             ; write
  57+ E000              FA_OPEN_EX      equ $00             ; open an existing file only
  58+ E000              FA_OPEN_AL      equ $08             ; open, or create if it doesn't exist
  59+ E000              FA_CREATE_NEW   equ $04             ; create, fail if it exists
  60+ E000              FA_CREATE_AL    equ $0C             ; create, replacing any existing file
  61+ E000              FA_OVERWRITE    equ FA_WRITE|FA_CREATE_AL   ; for saving a whole file
  62+ E000
  63+ E000              ; F_SEEK modes (L)
  64+ E000              SEEK_START      equ 0               ; from the start of the file
  65+ E000              SEEK_FWD        equ 1               ; forwards from the current position
  66+ E000              SEEK_BACK       equ 2               ; backwards from the current position
  67+ E000
  68+ E000              FSTAT_SIZE      equ 7               ; F_FSTAT buffer: file size, 4 bytes
  69+ E000              FSTAT_LEN       equ 11              ; F_FSTAT buffer length
  70+ E000
  71+ E000              ESX_DEFAULT     equ '*'             ; drive: the default drive
  72+ E000
  73+ E000              ; An esxDOS call: the ROM in at $0000-$3FFF for the RST $08, the game's
  74+ E000              ; pages back after.  Registers in and out are the function's own; flags
  75+ E000              ; and A come back from esxDOS (carry set = error, A = code).
  76+ E000                      MACRO ESXDOS fn
  77+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_in
  78+ E000 ~                    rst $08
  79+ E000 ~                    db fn
  80+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_out
  81+ E000                      ENDM
  82+ E000

 232+ E0BC DD E1                pop ix
 233+ E0BE 3A 16 E1             ld a,(fh_drive)
 234+ E0C1                      ESXDOS F_UNLINK
 234+ E0C1 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 234+ E0C4 CF          >        rst $08
 234+ E0C5 AD          >        db F_UNLINK
 234+ E0C6 CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
 235+ E0C9 DD E1                pop ix
 236+ E0CB C9                   ret
 237+ E0CC
 238+ E0CC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 239+ E0CC              ; Page the ROM into slots 0 and 1 for RST $08, remembering the game's pages
 240+ E0CC              ; (fh_rom_in), and put them back (fh_rom_out).  Interrupts are off in
 241+ E0CC              ; between (the ROM covers the interrupt routine, slot 1), and back on after
 242+ E0CC              ; if they were on before.  Both keep every register and flag.
 243+ E0CC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 244+ E0CC              fh_rom_in:
 245+ E0CC F5                   push af
 246+ E0CD ED 57                ld a,i                          ; P/V: interrupts on (IFF2)
 247+ E0CF F3                   di
 248+ E0D0 3E 00                ld a,0
 249+ E0D2 E2 D6 E0             jp po,.off
 250+ E0D5 3C                   inc a
 251+ E0D6 32 1A E1     .off:   ld (fh_ints),a
 252+ E0D9 C5                   push bc
 253+ E0DA 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 254+ E0DD 3E 50                ld a,MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER        ; slot 0's page now
 255+ E0DF ED 79                out (c),a
 256+ E0E1 04                   inc b
 257+ E0E2 ED 78                in a,(c)
 258+ E0E4 32 18 E1             ld (fh_mmu0),a
 259+ E0E7 05                   dec b
 260+ E0E8 3E 51                ld a,MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER        ; slot 1's
 261+ E0EA ED 79                out (c),a
 262+ E0EC 04                   inc b
 263+ E0ED ED 78                in a,(c)
 264+ E0EF 32 19 E1             ld (fh_mmu1),a
 265+ E0F2 ED 91 50 FF          nextreg MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER,PAGE_ROM
 266+ E0F6 ED 91 51 FF          nextreg MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER,PAGE_ROM
 267+ E0FA C1                   pop bc
 268+ E0FB F1                   pop af
 269+ E0FC C9                   ret
 270+ E0FD
 271+ E0FD              fh_rom_out:
 272+ E0FD F3                   di                              ; (in case esxDOS enabled them)
 273+ E0FE F5                   push af
 274+ E0FF 3A 18 E1             ld a,(fh_mmu0)
 275+ E102 ED 92 50             nextreg MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER,a
 276+ E105 3A 19 E1             ld a,(fh_mmu1)
 277+ E108 ED 92 51             nextreg MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER,a
 278+ E10B 3A 1A E1             ld a,(fh_ints)
 279+ E10E B7                   or a
 280+ E10F 28 03                jr z,.off
 281+ E111 F1                   pop af
 282+ E112 FB                   ei                              ; on again, as they were
 283+ E113 C9                   ret
 284+ E114 F1           .off:   pop af
 285+ E115 C9                   ret

 288+ E116              ; File handler data
 289+ E116              ;==============================================================================

 291+ E117 00           fh_handle:  db 0                        ; the last file opened
 292+ E118 00           fh_mmu0:    db 0                        ; the game's slot 0 / 1 pages during
 293+ E119 00           fh_mmu1:    db 0                        ; an esxDOS call
 294+ E11A 00           fh_ints:    db 0                        ; 1: interrupts were on before it
 295+ E11B 00 00 00...  fh_stat:    ds FSTAT_LEN                ; F_FSTAT buffer (fh_size)

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - audio (8K page PAGE_AUDIO, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in
   3+ E000              ; with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_AUDIO before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Sound devices: the Next's TurboSound, three AY-3-8912 chips.  initgame
   6+ E000              ; (initialise.asm) has already set the chip mode to AY (NextReg $06),
   7+ E000              ; turned TurboSound and the internal speaker on (NextReg $08) and the AY
   8+ E000              ; outputs to stereo (NextReg $09).  init_audio then sets every chip to a
   9+ E000              ; known, silent state (at start-up, and on every menu screen: menu_clear).
  10+ E000              ; AY 1 is the VTOL's engines: engine_start here, then the interrupt routine
  11+ E000              ; plays them (engine_tick, interrupts.asm).  AY 2 is the weapons' sound
  12+ E000              ; effects, AY 3 explosions: the game asks for one with ld a,SFX_n / ld
  13+ E000              ; (sfx_req),a (AY 2), ld (sfx2_req),a (AY 3's A and B) or ld (sfx3_req),a
  14+ E000              ; (AY 3's C), and the interrupt plays it (sfx_tick).  (Music would need AY 3
  15+ E000              ; back.)  The interrupt writes the AY ports while eng_on is 1,
  16+ E000              ; so code here writes them only with eng_on 0 (or interrupts off).
  17+ E000              ;
  18+ E000              ; TurboSound ports:
  19+ E000              ;   $FFFD write %1LR111cc: select AY chip cc (AY_CHIP_1..3) with its left
  20+ E000              ;         (L) and right (R) outputs on;
  21+ E000              ;         any value 0..15: select that register of the selected chip
  22+ E000              ;   $BFFD write: the value of the selected register
  23+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  24+ E000
  25+ E000              AY_CTRL_PORT    equ $FFFD           ; chip / register select
  26+ E000              AY_DATA_PORT    equ $BFFD           ; register value
  27+ E000
  28+ E000              ; Chip select ($FFFD): AY_SELECT | AY_LEFT | AY_RIGHT | AY_CHIP_n
  29+ E000              AY_SELECT       equ %10011100       ; bit 7 and bits 4-2 must be set
  30+ E000              AY_LEFT         equ %01000000       ; left output on
  31+ E000              AY_RIGHT        equ %00100000       ; right output on
  32+ E000              AY_CHIP_1       equ %11
  33+ E000              AY_CHIP_2       equ %10
  34+ E000              AY_CHIP_3       equ %01
  35+ E000
  36+ E000              ; AY registers
  37+ E000              AY_TONE_A       equ 0               ; channel A tone period: fine, coarse (4)
  38+ E000              AY_TONE_B       equ 2
  39+ E000              AY_TONE_C       equ 4
  40+ E000              AY_NOISE        equ 6               ; noise period (5 bits)
  41+ E000              AY_MIXER        equ 7               ; tone / noise enable, 0 = on:
  42+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_A    equ %00000001       ;   bits 0-2 tone A-C off,
  43+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_B    equ %00000010
  44+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_C    equ %00000100
  45+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_A   equ %00001000       ;   bits 3-5 noise A-C off
  46+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_B   equ %00010000
  47+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_C   equ %00100000
  48+ E000              AY_VOL_A        equ 8               ; amplitude 0-15 (bit 4: use envelope)
  49+ E000              AY_VOL_B        equ 9
  50+ E000              AY_VOL_C        equ 10
  51+ E000              AY_ENV_FINE     equ 11              ; envelope period
  52+ E000              AY_ENV_COARSE   equ 12
  53+ E000              AY_ENV_SHAPE    equ 13              ; envelope shape
  54+ E000              AY_REGS         equ 14
  55+ E000
  56+ E000              AY_ENV_ATTACK_HOLD equ %1101        ; envelope: rise once, then hold
  57+ E000              AY_MIXER_INIT   equ AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  58+ E000                                                  ; tones on, noise off
  59+ E000
  60+ E000              ; The engines (AY 1): jet turbines, from n = |speed| (at least 1: the idle,
  61+ E000              ; at zero throttle, sounds as speed 1), 1..SPEED_MAX
  62+ E000              ENG_MIXER       equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  63+ E000                                                  ; A noise only, B and C tone only
  64+ E000              ENG_NOISE0      equ 29              ; A, the roar: noise period 29 - n*13/16
  65+ E000              ENG_NOISE_MUL   equ 13              ;   (29 at idle, a rumble; 7 flat out, a hiss)
  66+ E000              ENG_ROAR_VOL0   equ 4               ;   volume 4 + n*7/32 (4..10)
  67+ E000              ENG_WHINE0      equ 222             ; B, the turbine whine: period 222 - 3n
  68+ E000              ENG_WHINE_STEP  equ 3               ;   (~500 Hz at idle, ~790 Hz flat out)
  69+ E000              ENG_WHINE_VOL0  equ 2               ;   volume 2 + n*7/32 (2..8)
  70+ E000              ENG_VOL_MUL     equ 7               ; the volumes rise by n*7/32 (0..6)
  71+ E000              ENG_DETUNE      equ 2               ; C, the same whine 2 periods lower: the
  72+ E000              ENG_SHIMMER_VOL equ 2               ;   two beat (the turbines' shimmer), 2 quieter
  73+ E000              ; Sound effects (sfx_tick, interrupts.asm): their numbers, and the step codes
  74+ E000              SFX_MG          equ 1               ; the machine gun: one round
  75+ E000              SFX_LASER       equ 2               ; the pulse laser: one pulse (a zap)
  76+ E000              SFX_CHAIN       equ 3               ; the chain gun: one round
  77+ E000              SFX_ROCKET      equ 4               ; a rocket fired: a short woosh
  78+ E000              SFX_MISSILE     equ 5               ; a missile fired: a longer woosh
  79+ E000              SFX_BOFORS      equ 6               ; the Bofors / proximity cannon: one shell
  80+ E000              SFX_BOOM_ROCKET equ 7               ; explosions (AY 3, sfx2_req): a rocket's,
  81+ E000              SFX_BOOM_MISSILE equ 8              ;   a missile's,
  82+ E000              SFX_BOOM_BOFORS equ 9               ;   a Bofors shell's,
  83+ E000              SFX_BOOM_PROX   equ 10              ;   a proximity shell's
  84+ E000              SFX_SPLAT       equ 11              ; a zombie hit (AY 3 channel C, sfx3_req)
  85+ E000              SFX_LAST        equ 11              ; (sfx_table, sfx_data.asm)
  86+ E000              SFX_STEP        equ $FE             ; end of a step: the next, next interrupt
  87+ E000              SFX_END         equ $FF             ; end of the sound
  88+ E000              SFX_MIX_NOISE_A_TONE_B equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  89+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A noise only, B tone only
  90+ E000              SFX_MIX_TONE_AB equ AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  91+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A and B tones only
  92+ E000              SFX_MIX_NOISE_A equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_TONE_B|AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  93+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A noise only
  94+ E000              SFX_MIX_BOOM    equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  95+ E000                                                  ; AY 3's mixer: A noise, B tone (the
  96+ E000                                                  ; explosions), C tone (the splats)
  97+ E000                      ASSERT AY_REGS < SFX_STEP
  98+ E000
  99+ E000              ENG_FRAC        equ 16              ; the engines' speed (eng_cur) in 1/16 steps:
 100+ E000              ENG_SPIN_UP     equ 4               ;   up by at most 4/16 an interrupt (12.5 steps
 101+ E000              ENG_SPIN_DOWN   equ 2               ;   a second), down by 2/16 (6.25 a second)
 102+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_SPIN_UP > 0 && ENG_SPIN_DOWN > 0
 103+ E000                      ASSERT -SPEED_MIN <= SPEED_MAX
 104+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE0 - SPEED_MAX*ENG_WHINE_STEP > 0 && ENG_WHINE0 + ENG_DETUNE < 256
 105+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_NOISE0 < 32 && ENG_NOISE0 - (SPEED_MAX*ENG_NOISE_MUL)/16 >= 1
 106+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_ROAR_VOL0 + SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL/32 <= 15 && ENG_WHINE_VOL0 + SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL/32 <= 15
 107+ E000                      ASSERT SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL < 256
 108+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE_VOL0 >= ENG_SHIMMER_VOL

 110+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 111+ E000              ; Set up the sound devices: each AY chip selected with both outputs, every
 112+ E000              ; register 0 (silent: all volumes 0), then the mixer to tones only and the
 113+ E000              ; envelope to attack-and-hold.  AY 1 is left selected.

 115+ E000              init_audio:

 128+ E01D 3E 02                ld a,AY_CHIP_2
 129+ E01F CD 24 E0             call ay_init_chip

 133+ E024              ; A = chip (AY_CHIP_n): select it in stereo, clear it, mixer and envelope

 135+ E024 CD 5D E0             call ay_select

 149+ E041              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 150+ E041              ; The VTOL's engines: jet turbines, not rotors, so a steady roar and whine
 151+ E041              ; rather than a chop.  AY 1, all three channels, kept for them.  They never
 152+ E041              ; stop in play: at zero throttle they idle, as at speed 1.  The interrupt
 153+ E041              ; routine plays them, 50 times a second (engine_tick, interrupts.asm): the
 154+ E041              ; sound's speed spools towards the VTOL's, so pitch and volume rise and fall
 155+ E041              ; smoothly.  (The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is
 156+ E041              ; 109375/P Hz.)
 157+ E041              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 158+ E041              ; Start of each level (next_level): AY 1's mixer for the engines, the sound's
 159+ E041              ; speed 0 (they spool up to the idle), and the interrupt playing them
 160+ E041              engine_start:

 172+ E05C C9                   ret

 181+ E064 C9                   ret

 183+ E065              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 184+ E065              ; A = register, E = value: write it to the selected chip.  Keeps D, E, HL.
 185+ E065              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - player page (8K page PAGE_PLAYER, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Keyboard input, movement along the heading, world-edge clamping and
   5+ C000              ; building collision.  Paged in by main_loop with nextreg LOGIC_MMU,
   6+ C000              ; PAGE_PLAYER, with the keys page (key_held) in slot 7.
   7+ C000              ; Uses the resident helpers get_sin, fmul and bld_height; camera state (cam_x/z/y, yaw, pitch, speed) is shared and
   8+ C000              ; stays in zpolice.asm.
   9+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  10+ C000
  11+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  12+ C000              ; Player input and movement
  13+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  14+ C000              update_player:
  15+ C000 AF                   xor a
  16+ C001 D3 FE                out ($FE),a                     ; border back to black
  17+ C003                      ; remember position in case we fly into something
  18+ C003 21 23 AE             ld hl,cam_x                     ; (and the heading: turning swings
  19+ C006 11 E7 C2             ld de,old_pos                   ; the VTOL's nose and tail)

  28+ C01B              .alive:
  29+ C01B                      ; (keys: kbd_scan has read them; actions from input.asm)
  30+ C01B                      ; --- boost (zpolice.asm: BOOST_*): while on, the speed keys and the
  31+ C01B                      ; air brake don't change the speed, and each frame burns a fuel
  32+ C01B 3A BB AE             ld a,(boost_on)
  33+ C01E B7                   or a
  34+ C01F 28 25                jr z,.nb
  35+ C021 3A 2F AE             ld a,(speed)
  36+ C024 FE 38                cp BOOST_SPEED
  37+ C026 20 13                jr nz,.bend                     ; stopped meanwhile (a collision)
  38+ C028 3E 13                ld a,K_BOOST
  39+ C02A CD CF E0             call key_pressed
  40+ C02D 20 06                jr nz,.boff                     ; pressed again: off
  41+ C02F 21 BA AE             ld hl,boost_fuel
  42+ C032 35                   dec (hl)
  43+ C033 20 0A                jr nz,.bkeep                    ; still burning
  44+ C035 3A BC AE     .boff:  ld a,(boost_spd)                ; off (or out of fuel): the speed it
  45+ C038 32 2F AE             ld (speed),a                    ; had before
  46+ C03B AF           .bend:  xor a
  47+ C03C 32 BB AE             ld (boost_on),a
  48+ C03F AF           .bkeep: xor a                           ; (no air brake this frame)
  49+ C040 32 F2 C2             ld (ab_on),a
  50+ C043 C3 DE C0             jp .nw
  51+ C046 3E 13        .nb:    ld a,K_BOOST                    ; off: pressed to start it?
  52+ C048 CD CF E0             call key_pressed
  53+ C04B 28 26                jr z,.nbs
  54+ C04D 3A B9 AE             ld a,(boost_fitted)
  55+ C050 B7                   or a
  56+ C051 28 20                jr z,.nbs                       ; no booster
  57+ C053 3A BA AE             ld a,(boost_fuel)
  58+ C056 B7                   or a
  59+ C057 28 1A                jr z,.nbs                       ; no fuel
  60+ C059 3A 2F AE             ld a,(speed)
  61+ C05C CB 7F                bit 7,a
  62+ C05E 20 13                jr nz,.nbs                      ; reversing
  63+ C060 FE 0E                cp BOOST_MIN
  64+ C062 38 0F                jr c,.nbs                       ; under half speed
  65+ C064 32 BC AE             ld (boost_spd),a
  66+ C067 3E 38                ld a,BOOST_SPEED                ; on: twice the top speed at once
  67+ C069 32 2F AE             ld (speed),a
  68+ C06C 3E 01                ld a,1
  69+ C06E 32 BB AE             ld (boost_on),a
  70+ C071 18 CC                jr .bkeep
  71+ C073              .nbs:
  72+ C073                      ; --- speed ---
  73+ C073 3E 00                ld a,K_SPEED_UP                 ; (by SPEED_STEP, 1)
  74+ C075 CD BE E0             call key_held
  75+ C078 28 0B                jr z,.nq
  76+ C07A 3A 2F AE             ld a,(speed)
  77+ C07D FE 1C                cp SPEED_MAX
  78+ C07F 28 04                jr z,.nq
  79+ C081 3C                   inc a
  80+ C082 32 2F AE             ld (speed),a
  81+ C085 3E 01        .nq:    ld a,K_SPEED_DN
  82+ C087 CD BE E0             call key_held

  84+ C08C 3A 2F AE             ld a,(speed)
  85+ C08F FE FA                cp (SPEED_MIN) & $FF
  86+ C091 28 04                jr z,.na
  87+ C093 3D                   dec a
  88+ C094 32 2F AE             ld (speed),a
  89+ C097              .na:    ; --- air brake: while held, the speed falls AIRBRAKE_STEP a frame
  90+ C097                      ; towards 0, going forwards or backwards.  Each braking frame tips the
  91+ C097                      ; nose one pitch step, as a nose key press does: up when braking
  92+ C097                      ; forward motion, down when braking reverse.  The pitch damper waits
  93+ C097                      ; while it brakes (ab_on), as it does while a nose key is held.
  94+ C097 AF                   xor a
  95+ C098 32 F2 C2             ld (ab_on),a

  97+ C09D CD BE E0             call key_held
  98+ C0A0 28 3C                jr z,.nw
  99+ C0A2 3A 2F AE             ld a,(speed)
 100+ C0A5 B7                   or a
 101+ C0A6 28 36                jr z,.nw                        ; stopped: nothing to brake
 102+ C0A8 32 F2 C2             ld (ab_on),a                    ; (non-zero: braking this frame)
 103+ C0AB FA C7 C0             jp m,.rev
 104+ C0AE D6 02                sub AIRBRAKE_STEP               ; forwards: slower, not past 0
 105+ C0B0 30 01                jr nc,.fwd
 106+ C0B2 AF                   xor a
 107+ C0B3 32 2F AE     .fwd:   ld (speed),a
 108+ C0B6 AF                   xor a
 109+ C0B7 32 2D AE             ld (pitch_frac),a               ; whole steps, as the keys
 110+ C0BA 3A 2E AE             ld a,(pitch)
 111+ C0BD FE 18                cp PMAX
 112+ C0BF 28 1D                jr z,.nw
 113+ C0C1 3C                   inc a                           ; nose up
 114+ C0C2 32 2E AE             ld (pitch),a
 115+ C0C5 18 17                jr .nw
 116+ C0C7 C6 02        .rev:   add a,AIRBRAKE_STEP             ; backwards: towards 0, not past it
 117+ C0C9 30 01                jr nc,.bk
 118+ C0CB AF                   xor a
 119+ C0CC 32 2F AE     .bk:    ld (speed),a
 120+ C0CF AF                   xor a

 265+ C1FD              ; IX -> 24-bit position (frac, lo, hi). HL = signed delta in 1/256 units.
 266+ C1FD              ; Clamps the integer part to WORLD_MIN..WORLD_MAX.
 267+ C1FD              add_pos:
 268+ C1FD 7C                   ld a,h
 269+ C1FE 17                   rla
 270+ C1FF 9F                   sbc a,a
 271+ C200 4F                   ld c,a                          ; sign extension

 273+ C204 85                   add a,l
 274+ C205 DD 77 00             ld (ix+0),a

 277+ C20C DD 77 01             ld (ix+1),a
 278+ C20F DD 7E 02             ld a,(ix+2)

 319+ C254              ; Returns NZ if the VTOL hits a building: its footprint (10 m x 3 m, turned
 320+ C254              ; to the heading; vtol_ground) is over a roof less than COLL_H below it.

 335+ C26C
 336+ C26C              ; The VTOL has been destroyed (vtol_dead): the controls do nothing.  It
 337+ C26C              ; spins DEAD_SPIN a frame and falls, a unit a frame faster each frame (up
 338+ C26C              ; to DEAD_FALL_MAX), until it hits the ground under it (floor_y: the road,
 339+ C26C              ; or the highest roof under its footprint).  Once down it lies still for
 340+ C26C              ; DEAD_PAUSE frames, then sets game_over (main_loop: the GAME OVER screen,
 341+ C26C              ; then the main menu).
 342+ C26C              vtol_wreck:

 353+ C283 FE 08                cp DEAD_FALL_MAX
 354+ C285 30 04                jr nc,.vy
 355+ C287 3C                   inc a
 356+ C288 32 43 AE             ld (dead_vy),a
 357+ C28B 5F           .vy:    ld e,a
 358+ C28C 16 00                ld d,0
 359+ C28E 2A 29 AE             ld hl,(cam_y)

 361+ C292 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 362+ C294 30 03                jr nc,.y
 363+ C296 21 00 00             ld hl,0
 364+ C299 E5           .y:     push hl
 365+ C29A CD B9 A9             call floor_y                    ; HL = the ground under it
 366+ C29D EB                   ex de,hl
 367+ C29E E1                   pop hl
 368+ C29F B7                   or a
 369+ C2A0 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 370+ C2A2 19                   add hl,de
 371+ C2A3 30 06                jr nc,.set                      ; still above it
 372+ C2A5 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; hit the ground: on it
 373+ C2A6 3E 01                ld a,1
 374+ C2A8 32 42 AE             ld (dead_down),a
 375+ C2AB 22 29 AE     .set:   ld (cam_y),hl
 376+ C2AE C9                   ret
 377+ C2AF 21 44 AE     .down:  ld hl,dead_wait                 ; on the ground: the pause, then
 378+ C2B2 35                   dec (hl)                        ; GAME OVER
 379+ C2B3 C0                   ret nz
 380+ C2B4 3E 01                ld a,1
 381+ C2B6 32 47 AE             ld (game_over),a
 382+ C2B9 C9                   ret
 383+ C2BA
 384+ C2BA              ; One damping step: move the signed 8.8 pitch (pitch_frac/pitch) towards 0
 385+ C2BA              ; by max(PDAMP_MIN, |whole pitch| * PDAMP_K), stopping exactly at 0.
 386+ C2BA              ; Calculated rather than looked up: the Z80N MUL makes it as quick as a
 387+ C2BA              ; table, and the curve stays editable through the two equates.
 388+ C2BA              pitch_damp:
 389+ C2BA 2A 2D AE             ld hl,(pitch_frac)
 390+ C2BD 7C                   ld a,h
 391+ C2BE B5                   or l
 392+ C2BF C8                   ret z                           ; already level
 393+ C2C0 7C                   ld a,h
 394+ C2C1 F5                   push af                         ; sign
 395+ C2C2 CD E5 AD             call abs_hl
 396+ C2C5 54                   ld d,h                          ; whole part of |pitch|
 397+ C2C6 1E 00                ld e,PDAMP_K
 398+ C2C8 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; DE = step
 399+ C2CA 7A                   ld a,d
 400+ C2CB B7                   or a
 401+ C2CC 20 08                jr nz,.sub
 402+ C2CE 7B                   ld a,e
 403+ C2CF FE 80                cp PDAMP_MIN
 404+ C2D1 30 03                jr nc,.sub
 405+ C2D3 11 80 00             ld de,PDAMP_MIN
 406+ C2D6 B7           .sub:   or a
 407+ C2D7 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 408+ C2D9 30 03                jr nc,.sgn
 409+ C2DB 21 00 00             ld hl,0                         ; would pass level: stop at 0
 410+ C2DE F1           .sgn:   pop af
 411+ C2DF 17                   rla                             ; carry = was nose down
 412+ C2E0 DC DE AD             call c,neg_hl
 413+ C2E3 22 2D AE             ld (pitch_frac),hl
 414+ C2E6 C9                   ret

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - weapons page (8K page PAGE_WEAPONS, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Player weapons.  Paged in by main_loop with nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_WEAPONS
   5+ C000              ; (the keys page in slot 7) after
   6+ C000              ; the frame is set up (it uses sin_y/cos_y/sin_p/cos_p) and the zombies have
   7+ C000              ; moved.  Bullet state lives in the resident `bullets` table so that the city
   8+ C000              ; page can draw the tracers (draw_bullets).
   9+ C000              ;
  10+ C000              ; Keys 1-5 select the weapon slot that SPACE fires (wpn_sel: 1 = the centre
  11+ C000              ; slot, 2-5 = the wing pylons).  An empty slot isn't selected: the HUD
  12+ C000              ; flashes it instead (wflash_slot / wflash_t).  What is fitted where is set
  13+ C000              ; on the load-out screen between levels (loadout.asm).
  14+ C000              ;
  15+ C000              ; Machine gun (WPN_GUN, the centre slot): hold SPACE to fire one round every
  16+ C000              ; GUN_INTERVAL frames.  Rounds leave the ship's centre line 0.5 m below the
  17+ C000              ; camera and fly straight along the view direction at 500 m/s until they hit
  18+ C000              ; something.
  19+ C000              ;
  20+ C000              ; Collision, every frame for every round in flight: the path from its last
  21+ C000              ; position to its new one (BULLET_STEP long) is walked cell by cell through
  22+ C000              ; the city grid, in order (a 2D DDA on the horizontal distance s along the
  23+ C000              ; path).  The first thing met ends the path:
  24+ C000              ;   * a building cell: hit where the path enters the cell if it is below the
  25+ C000              ;     roof there (a wall), otherwise where it drops below the roof (the roof);
  26+ C000              ;   * a street cell marked as holding zombies (CELL_ZOMBIE): those in it, each a box
  27+ C000              ;     0.5 m wide and 2 m tall, nearest along the path first;
  28+ C000              ;   * the ground, where the path reaches height 0;
  29+ C000              ;   * leaving the GRID x GRID map: the round is gone.
  30+ C000              ; A round that hits is drawn once at the impact point, then freed.  A zombie
  31+ C000              ; that is hit loses B_DMG hit points; at 0 it is killed (its map blip
  32+ C000              ; removed, its record made inactive).  A rocket also bursts (rocket_blast).
  33+ C000              ;
  34+ C000              ; Rocket pod (WPN_ROCKETS, a wing pylon, ROCKET_SHOTS rockets): rockets are
  35+ C000              ; rounds too (B_KIND = BK_ROCKET), at 150 m/s and drawn as a short white
  36+ C000              ; streak with a yellow trail.  Wherever one stops (a building, the ground,
  37+ C000              ; a zombie) rocket_blast does BLAST_DMG to every zombie, human and base tile
  38+ C000              ; within BLAST_R on each axis, and sprays BLAST_PARTS orange particles.
  39+ C000              ;
  40+ C000              ; Bofors cannon (WPN_BOFORS, a wing pylon, BOFORS_SHOTS shells): the machine
  41+ C000              ; gun's rounds (B_KIND = BK_BOFORS, drawn as tracers) one every
  42+ C000              ; BOFORS_INTERVAL frames; each bursts where it stops: BOFORS_DMG within
  43+ C000              ; BOFORS_R (3 m) on each axis, BOFORS_PARTS particles.
  44+ C000              ;
  45+ C000              ; Proximity cannon (WPN_PROX, a wing pylon, PROX_SHOTS shells): the Bofors
  46+ C000              ; cannon (B_KIND = BK_PROX), its shells also bursting when they pass within
  47+ C000              ; PROX_R (2 m) of a monster (b_pr widens the monster hit boxes,
  48+ C000              ; cell_zombies); the burst does PROX_DMG within PROX_R on each axis.
  49+ C000              ;
  50+ C000              ; Missile pod (WPN_MISSILE, a wing pylon, MISSILE_SHOTS missiles): as the
  51+ C000              ; rockets (B_KIND = BK_MISSILE, drawn the same) at half the speed; the burst
  52+ C000              ; does MISSILE_DMG within MISSILE_R (1.0 tile) on each axis, and sprays
  53+ C000              ; MISSILE_PARTS particles.
  54+ C000              ;
  55+ C000              ; Damage: each round carries its damage (B_DMG): machine gun GUN_DMG, chain
  56+ C000              ; gun CHAIN_DMG, the laser LASER_DMG a beam frame, a rocket none directly
  57+ C000              ; (only its blast).  A zombie dies when its hit points (+18) run out.
  58+ C000              ;
  59+ C000              ; Positions are world units (1 tile = 20 m = 256 units, 1 m = 12.8).  Along the path,
  60+ C000              ; x = x0 + s*sinY, z = z0 + s*cosY and y = y0 + s*slope, with sinY/cosY the
  61+ C000              ; S7.8 heading at firing and slope = tan(pitch) in S7.8.
  62+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  63+ C000
  64+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  65+ C000              ; Per frame: fire, then move every round in flight

 202+ C110
 203+ C110              ; A chain gun round from IX: the view direction turned by a random angle
 204+ C110              ; of -CHAIN_DEV..+CHAIN_DEV steps (1/256 rad) sideways and up/down
 205+ C110              chain_round:

 213+ C122 B7                   or a

 219+ C12E DD 56 0A             ld d,(ix+B_COS+1)
 220+ C131 CD 79 C1             call dmul
 221+ C134 22 AA CC             ld (cg_s),hl

 240+ C165 7C                   ld a,h

 245+ C172 DD 75 0B             ld (ix+B_SLOPE),l
 246+ C175 DD 74 0C             ld (ix+B_SLOPE+1),h
 247+ C178 C9                   ret
 248+ C179
 249+ C179              ; HL = d * 256, DE = S7.8 value -> HL = d * value / 256, rounded
 250+ C179              dmul:
 251+ C179 CD EA AD             call fmul                       ; HL = d * value (exact)
 252+ C17C 11 80 00             ld de,128
 253+ C17F 19                   add hl,de
 254+ C180 6C                   ld l,h                          ; >> 8, keeping the sign
 255+ C181 7C                   ld a,h
 256+ C182 17                   rla
 257+ C183 9F                   sbc a,a
 258+ C184 67                   ld h,a
 259+ C185 C9                   ret
 260+ C186
 261+ C186              ; A = random byte -> A = -CHAIN_DEV..+CHAIN_DEV, evenly spread
 262+ C186              dev_n:

 264+ C187 1E 13                ld e,2*CHAIN_DEV+1
 265+ C189 ED 30                mul d,e
 266+ C18B 7A                   ld a,d
 267+ C18C D6 09                sub CHAIN_DEV
 268+ C18E C9                   ret

 270+ C18F              ; HL = HL + A (signed)
 271+ C18F              add_sa:

 273+ C190 17                   rla

 275+ C192 57                   ld d,a
 276+ C193 19                   add hl,de
 277+ C194 C9                   ret
 278+ C195
 279+ C195              ; One round from the selected slot's ammo: carry set if it is empty.
 280+ C195              ; AMMO_INF (255) is never counted down.
 281+ C195              take_ammo:

 289+ C19F C8                   ret z                           ; empty

 291+ C1A1 B7                   or a
 292+ C1A2 C9                   ret

 294+ C1A3              ; IX = a free round, carry clear; carry set if all are in flight

 305+ C1B6 C9                   ret

 342+ C20E DD 74 08             ld (ix+B_SIN+1),h

 344+ C214 DD 75 09             ld (ix+B_COS),l
 345+ C217 DD 74 0A             ld (ix+B_COS+1),h

 386+ C276              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 387+ C276              ; R / F: tilt the centre gun up / down (GUN_TILT_STEP a frame, to

 389+ C276              ; Then sight_y: the gunsight's row for the selected weapon, VIEW_CY minus

 440+ C2DC ED 44        .sd:    neg                             ; down: lower

 455+ C2F7 C9                   ret

 617+ C409
 618+ C409              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 619+ C409              ; Landed (update_weapons): on the base pad, repair and reload.  The VTOL
 620+ C409              ; gains 1 hit point every REPAIR_FRAMES frames up to VTOL_HP; each slot
 621+ C409              ; whose weapon reloads (wpn_cfg, zpolice.asm: its full load and frames a
 622+ C409              ; shot) gains a
 623+ C409              ; shot every that many frames up to its full load.  The counts start afresh
 624+ C409              ; each landing (svc_on), so a shot or hit point takes the whole interval.
 625+ C409              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 626+ C409              pad_service:
 627+ C409 CD 8F A9             call cam_cell_ptr
 628+ C40C 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 629+ C40D E6 1F                and CELL_CODE

 632+ C413 AF                   xor a                           ; landed elsewhere: nothing
 633+ C414 32 99 CC             ld (svc_on),a
 634+ C417 C9                   ret
 635+ C418 3A 99 CC     .pad:   ld a,(svc_on)
 636+ C41B B7                   or a
 637+ C41C 20 13                jr nz,.go
 638+ C41E 3C                   inc a                           ; just landed: start the counts
 639+ C41F 32 99 CC             ld (svc_on),a
 640+ C422 3E 05                ld a,REPAIR_FRAMES
 641+ C424 32 9A CC             ld (svc_rep),a
 642+ C427 21 9B CC             ld hl,svc_rel
